entries.source_title: Class polynomial obstructions to canonical congruences for the smallest parts function
entries.source_excerpt: We resolve an open conjecture by proving that the only "canonical'' Ramanujan congruence primes for the Andrews' smallest parts function, $\operatorname{spt}(n)$, are $\ell= 5, 7, 13$. Building on work of Ahlgren and Kim, we show that any such congruence forces square-index coefficients of certain weakly holomorphic forms of weight $1/2$ to vanish modulo the congruence prime. A normalized Borcherds product converts this into the vanishing of the derivative of a quotient of two oriented CM polynomials on $X_0(6)$. A quaternionic volume estimate in an Eichler order of level $6$ prevents that vanishing when a suitable inert discriminant is small. Trevi\~no's character estimate supplies such a discriminant for every prime at least $10^{11}$. The remaining range is covered by the previous calculations of Ahlgren and Kim. These results have been verified in Lean by AxiomProver.
entries.title_zh: 最小部分函数规范同余的类多项式障碍
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明 Andrews 最小部分函数 spt(n) 的规范 Ramanujan 同余素数仅为 5、7、13，从而解决一项开放猜想。证明链把同余转化为半整数权弱全纯模形式特定系数消失，再用 Borcherds 乘积联系到模曲线 X₀(6) 上定向 CM 类多项式商导数的消失；四元数体积估计与特征估计排除大素数，余下范围沿用既有计算。

entries.source_title: DStill: Trajectory Consistency Distillation for Accelerated One-Step Drafting in Block Diffusion Speculative Decoding
entries.source_excerpt: Block-diffusion speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by drafting multiple tokens in parallel. However, one-step drafting in discrete diffusion is limited by token factorization error: each token is predicted from the same masked block, without conditioning on the tokens selected at other positions in that step. This can produce inconsistent drafts and reduce acceptance length. Iterative refinement mitigates this limitation by conditioning later predictions on previously committed tokens, though additional passes increase drafting cost. To address this trade-off between draft fidelity and inference latency, we introduce DStill, a two-stage framework that distills a target-conditioned drafter's own multi-step refinement into one-step drafting. We first train the drafter to complete partially revealed blocks, then use its refinement trajectories to train a student to predict the final completion in one pass. Using a curriculum that gradually transitions from partial to fully masked inputs, we successfully transfer the multi-step refinement capabilities into one step. entries.title_zh: DStill：通过轨迹一致性蒸馏加速块扩散投机解码
entries.summary_zh: 离散块扩散投机解码能并行草拟多个 token，但一步草拟时每个位置都基于同一掩码块，忽略同一步其他位置刚选出的 token，产生因子化误差和不一致草稿；多步迭代可修正，却增加延迟。DStill 将目标条件 drafter 的多步自我细化轨迹蒸馏到一步模型，力求保留草稿一致性并减少推理轮次。

entries.source_title: Inverting Dependently Random Tournaments
entries.source_excerpt: Let $\text{inv}(T)$ be the inversion index of the tournament $T$. Answering a question of Behague, we show that $\text{inv}(T_1\to T_2)=\text{inv}(T_1)+\text{inv}(T_2)$ does not even hold asymptotically.

entries.source_title: The Price of Choice in Selective Prediction
entries.source_excerpt: A selective classifier may be claimed to satisfy a risk-coverage contract if some rule from a predeclared menu (a threshold or a union of $K$ score intervals) attains coverage at least $\kappa$ and error at most $\alpha$. Refuting this existential claim requires ruling out every permitted rule. The intersection-union test (IUT) achieves validity without a multiplicity correction, but its sample cost can increase with menu richness. We characterize this cost and compare it with the optimal audit. For a fixed interior risk target $\alpha$ and gap $\gamma$, the minimax sample size for K-interval menus at coverage floor $\kappa$ is $K(1-\kappa)/(\kappa\gamma^2)$, up to logarithmic factors, in the stated small-gap, large-menu regime; exact IUT attains this rate. The lower bound holds even with a known score distribution, while the upper bound extends to menus of VC dimension $d$. Procedures that refuse to reject whenever any rule appears feasible on the audit sample can pay a linear $K$ cost even when a square-root rate is possible. entries.title_zh: 选择性预测中的选择代价
entries.summary_zh: 若风险—覆盖率承诺声称预先菜单中的某条规则（阈值或 K 个分数区间并集）能达到指定覆盖率且错误率不超标，审计者必须排除菜单内所有规则。论文分析无需多重校正的交并检验样本成本，并与最优审计比较；在固定内部目标风险 α 和差距 γ 下，K 区间菜单的极小极大样本量为 K(1−κ)/(κγ²)，显示菜单越丰富，验证承诺越昂贵。

entries.source_title: Stability and Error Estimates for Convolution Quadrature under Radial Symbol Bounds
entries.source_excerpt: We develop stability and error estimates for multistep convolution quadrature (CQ) under general radial bounds on the Laplace symbol. Instead of the classical single-power condition $|F(z)|\leq M|z|^{-\mu}$, we assume $|F(z)|\leq C\Phi(|z|)$ and consider two classes of radial functions: monotone bounds satisfying a scaling condition and regularly varying bounds with locally bounded above and away from zero. For strongly $A(\alpha)$-stable multistep methods, we derive approximation and stability estimates for the CQ weights, as well as error bounds for power-type inputs $g_\beta(t)=t^{\beta-1}/\Gamma(\beta)$ with $\beta>0$. These estimates explicitly retain the dependence on the memory law through the factor $\Phi(t_n^{-1})$. The framework accommodates symbols whose behavior cannot be described by a global single-power. It also preserves slowly varying and multiscale factors that would be lost under a coarser power majorant. The theory is applied to fractional viscoelastic models, distributed-order operators, and logarithmic-power memory operators. entries.source_title: Cographs in chordal graphs
entries.source_excerpt: For a graph $G$, let $\text{cg}(G)$ be the maximum $k\in \mathbb N$ for which $G$ contains a $k$-vertex cograph as an induced subgraph. The Erd\H{o}s-Hajnal conjecture asserts that for every proper hereditary graph class $\mathcal{G}$, there exists $\gamma\in(0,1]$ such that every $n$-vertex graph $G\in\mathcal{G}$ satisfies $\text{cg}(G)\geq n^\gamma$. This is still open; however, for some hereditary classes, one may guarantee much stronger bounds. For instance, every chordal graph $G$ on $n\geq 2$ vertices satisfies $\text{cg}(G)\geq n/(2\log n)$. Paul Seymour asked whether this bound is optimal up to a constant factor. We answer this affirmatively, even for interval graphs: For every integer $n\geq 2$, we construct an $n$-vertex interval graph $G$ with $\text{cg}(G)<64n/\log n$.
entries.title_zh: 弦图中最大诱导余图规模的界在常数内最优

entries.source_title: Proof Perplexity: A Probabilistic Approach to Measuring non-triviality in Machine Generated Proofs
entries.source_excerpt: In this article, we propose a benchmark to quantify the non-triviality and novelty of machine-generated mathematical proofs compared to existing literature. Our core methodology uses a probabilistic measure to evaluate the non-triviality of the underlying mathematical arguments in comparison to the current \texttt{MATHLIB} library. Finally, we apply this benchmark to the recent proof generated by Claude on the complex zeros of the Riemann zeta function to test for non-trivial steps.

entries.source_title: An elementary proof of a tight $\Delta+1$ bound for the additive chromatic number
entries.source_excerpt: An additive coloring assigns positive integer labels to the vertices of a graph so that adjacent vertices have different sums of their neighbors' labels. The additive chromatic number $\eta(G)$ is the least $k$ for which labels from $[k]$ suffice. We give an elementary orientation argument proving that every finite simple graph $G$ satisfies $\eta(G) \leq \Delta(G) + 1$. This argument yields a $(\Delta(G) + 1)$-additive-coloring in polynomial time and improves upon the current best bound of $\eta(G) \leq \Delta(G)^{2} - \Delta(G) + 1$, valid for $\Delta(G) \geq 2$, from Akbari, Ghanbari, Manaviyat, and Zare.

entries.source_title: Uncertainty-Aware Budget Allocation for Efficient LLM Tree Search
entries.source_excerpt: Tree search enhances multi-step reasoning in large language models (LLMs), yet prevailing methods expand every step with a fixed budget, irrespective of the marginal utility of expansion. We first show, across existing search algorithms, that continuations sampled from a shared intermediate state are largely duplicates and collapse to a few distinct answers. Critically, we find that the semantic dispersion of sibling actions predicts the redundancy of their downstream continuations, permitting a subtree's budget to be fixed before expansion. An information-theoretic analysis motivates this: treating the per-step budget as the Monte Carlo sample size for estimating a step's residual answer entropy, we derive a sufficient budget that shrinks with sibling dispersion. We accordingly propose $\textbf{Uncertainty-Aware Allocation}$ (UAA), a training-free framework that decouples value from uncertainty: values determine which candidates are promising, while uncertainty, estimated from sibling dispersion at no additional model cost, determines how many merit expansion, via uncertainty-aware pruning and uncertainty-aware budgeting. entries.source_title: Void probabilities for perturbed lattices under mixing
entries.source_excerpt: We study void probabilities for stationary perturbed lattices with possibly dependent perturbations. Our main result gives a general upper bound in terms of two ingredients: the number of lattice sites having a uniformly positive probability of hitting the observation set, and the $\alpha$-mixing rate of the perturbation field. For unions of lattice cubes, this yields explicit bounds without moment or regularity assumptions on the marginal distribution of the perturbations. As a consequence, we obtain quantitative estimates for growing bounded Borel sets with non-empty interior, including stretched-exponential decay under exponential mixing and polynomial decay under polynomial mixing.
entries.title_zh: 混合扰动格点的空集概率
entries.summary_zh: 作者研究扰动可能相关的平稳随机格点，给出空集概率上界，以具有正概率命中观测集的格点数和扰动场 α-mixing 速率为核心量。对格点立方体并集得到无需边缘矩或正则性假设的显式界；指数混合可导出拉伸指数衰减，幂次混合则给出多项式衰减。

entries.pragmatic_review: 把依赖强度直接纳入空集概率定量界。

entries.paper_review: 摘要明确了假设弱化与衰减率类型。

entries.source_title: Cram\'{e}r-type moderate deviations and precise large deviations for the elephant random walk with random step sizes
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we focuses on how the distribution of random step sizes affects Cram\'{e}r-type moderate deviations and precise large deviations for the elephant random walk with random step sizes. First, with sub-exponential moment condition of random step sizes, we establish Cram\'{e}r-type moderate deviation results. Consequently, moderate deviation principles are obtained. Secondly, for random step sizes with sub-exponential tails, we establish a large deviation principle on tail probabilities. Finally, for random step sizes with regularly varying tails, we obtain precise large deviations.
entries.title_zh: 随机步长大象随机游走的中等与精确大偏差
entries.summary_zh: 论文系统分析随机步长分布如何影响大象随机游走的偏差行为：步长具有次指数矩时建立 Cramér 型中等偏差及相应偏差原理；步长为次指数尾时得到尾概率大偏差原理；具有正则变化重尾时则推导精确大偏差。结果凸显记忆机制与步长尾部共同决定极限尺度。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 按步长尾部分类给出中等偏差到精确大偏差的统一分析。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适用于带历史依赖、随机移动长度过程的尾风险估计。
entries.cynic_review: 不同结论由不同尾部矩条件支持，需按步长分布选用。
entries.paper_review: 清楚覆盖次指数矩、次指数尾和正则变化重尾三类机制。

entries.source_title: Normal approximation, moderate and large deviations for the elephant random walk with stops and random step sizes
entries.source_excerpt: We study the elephant random walk with stops and independent positive random step sizes. Building on fixed-movement estimates, we obtain quantitative normal approximations for an empirically normalized statistic by controlling its random denominator and the independent movement clock. A permutation comparison preserves the diffusive Kolmogorov rate, while variance matching permits third-order Zolotarev estimates. We also derive self-normalized Cram\'er-type moderate deviations. For regularly varying step-size tails, we obtain uniform precise large deviations and establish the necessity of the diffusive and critical threshold orders. Further applications of the clock representation yield large deviation principles for Weibull-type and light-tailed step sizes, and a precise light-tailed expansion in the balanced case.
entries.title_zh: 带停顿和随机步长的大象随机游走偏差
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究具有停步机制和独立正随机步长的大象随机游走，借助固定移动次数的估计、随机时钟表示和对随机分母的控制，给出经验归一化统计量的定量正态近似及自归一化 Cramér 型中等偏差。针对重尾步长，作者推导一致精确大偏差并刻画扩散与临界阈值阶；对 Weibull 型及轻尾步长，还建立大偏差原理和轻尾展开。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 将随机移动时钟与步长尾部结合，系统刻画正态、中等偏差和大偏差区间。
entries.pragmatic_review: 对带记忆随机过程的渐近推断和尾概率估计有启发。
entries.cynic_review: 各类极限结论取决于步长尾部和相应矩条件。
entries.paper_review: 覆盖多种步长尾部，并分析不同偏差尺度的边界阶。

entries.source_title: Data-driven accelerated multigrid method for Riesz space fractional diffusion equations
entries.source_excerpt: The multigrid method is one of the most efficient iterative methods for solving large structured linear systems, and its efficiency stems from the complementarity between the smoother and the coarse grid correction. In this paper, we consider the block Toeplitz linear system obtained by discretizing time dependent Riesz space fractional diffusion equations, and employ the weighted Jacobi iterative method as a smoother. The weighted Jacobi smoother features a simple structure and low computational cost, yet its smoothing property is highly dependent on the relaxation parameter. We adopt Gaussian process regression to select the relaxation parameter to accelerate the convergence of the multigrid method. Numerical experiments confirm the theoretical analysis, which simultaneously verifies the effectiveness and superiority of the data-driven parameter selection strategy.
entries.title_zh: Riesz 空间分数阶扩散的数驱加速多重网格
entries.summary_zh: 论文针对时间依赖 Riesz 空间分数阶扩散离散后形成的块 Toeplitz 线性系统，采用加权 Jacobi 作为多重网格平滑器。由于收敛对松弛参数敏感，作者用高斯过程回归数据驱动选择该参数；数值实验报告加速效果，并对理论收敛性质作验证。

entries.source_title: MAMath-Bench: Process-Aware and Robust Evaluation of Multimodal Multi-Agent Mathematical Reasoning
entries.source_excerpt: Mathematical reasoning is a fundamental capability for educational applications of Large Language Models (LLMs), where reliable problem solving requires not only correct answers but also coherent and verifiable reasoning processes. Multi-agent systems (MASs) have shown growing potential in this domain by leveraging collaboration and verification among multiple LLM agents. However, existing evaluations primarily focus on the correctness of final answers in text-only settings, offering limited insight into multimodal reasoning capabilities, the reliability of intermediate reasoning steps, and robustness against reasoning errors. To address these limitations, we introduce MAMath-Bench, a process-aware benchmark designed to evaluate the multimodal mathematical reasoning capabilities of MASs. MAMath-Bench comprises 1,003 problems spanning 11 mathematical categories, multiple difficulty levels, and several modalities, including text, images, and audio. It features fine-grained milestone annotations to evaluate systems across three dimensions: problem-solving correctness, reasoning-process reliability, and robustness to adversarial reasoning

entries.source_title: Central Limit Theorem for continuous $N$-particle systems in fixed- and high-temperature: single level
entries.source_excerpt: We characterize central limit theorems for polynomial linear statistics of continuous $N$-particle systems on $\mathbb R$, in both the fixed-temperature regime $\theta=\beta/2>0$ and the high-temperature regime $N\theta\to\gamma>0$. In each regime, we give necessary and sufficient conditions in terms of the coefficients of the logarithmic Bessel generating function, together with an explicit combinatorial formula for the limiting covariance. At fixed temperature, this formula recovers the classical second-order free moment--cumulant relation, up to the factor $1/\theta$; at high temperature, it yields new second-order free $\gamma$-cumulants and their covariance relations. The proof combines moment extraction through Dunkl operators with a topological expansion of the logarithmic multivariate Bessel function indexed by ribbon graphs on surfaces. This expansion gives a topological interpretation of the free-cumulants: only genus zero contributes at fixed temperature, whereas arbitrarily high genera contribute at high temperature. entries.source_title: GR-OPD: Group-Relative Sequence Credit for On-Policy Distillation
entries.source_excerpt: On-policy distillation (OPD) provides token-level teacher feedback, yet common sampled-token updates assign credit locally and omit the effects of earlier actions on subsequent feedback. We introduce \method{} (Group-Relative On-Policy Distillation), which decouples feedback computation from credit assignment by aggregating token feedback into calibrated sequence-level credit. We establish a theoretical basis for this approach by showing that, under ideal on-policy assumptions, broadcasting raw summed feedback to every response token yields an unbiased estimate of the negative gradient of the sequence-level reverse-KL objective. To support effective learning in practice, \method{} discounts later feedback that may become less reliable under distribution shift and uses same-prompt rollout groups to calibrate teacher guidance. entries.source_excerpt: Multi-teacher on-policy distillation (MOPD) integrates domain specialists into a shared student, but determining how strongly each teacher should supervise remains challenging. Existing discrepancy-based allocation can assign strong supervision even when the student already matches or exceeds the teacher's task performance, since behavioral mismatch does not necessarily imply a remaining capability deficit. We propose Capability-Aware Multi-Teacher On-Policy Distillation (CA-MOPD), which combines specialist merging with capability-guided allocation to account for what the student has already learned. CA-MOPD first merges reinforcement-learning specialists into a strong student initialization, then uses verifier-estimated teacher--student capability gaps to adjust domain-level distillation strength. Supervision decreases as capability gaps close and increases when estimated student capability regresses, while dense token-level guidance remains provided by the teachers. entries.source_title: Sharp asymptotics for the Lov\'asz number of random circulant graphs
entries.source_excerpt: We study the LOV\'ASZ number of dense random circulant graphs generated by independent Bernoulli bits indexed by cyclic distances. Although only $O(n)$ independent random inputs determine $O(n^2)$ globally dependent edge indicators, we prove sharp expectation asymptotics along all odd orders, including composite orders, with leading constant one. This resolves a conjecture posed for random circulant graphs in 2025. The proof combines an exact Fourier reduction and complementary duality with a positive interior smoothing that reveals a nonlinear random fixed-point equation. To analyze this equation under the strong dependence of the distance-bit model, we construct canonical tree fields, establish growing-degree Gaussian approximations through polynomial comparison and Wick/Hermite expansions, and transfer the resulting approximation back to the original sign model. A deterministic residual estimate together with an explicit exceptional-event integration yields the sharp expectation asymptotics.

entries.source_title: The integral $K_0$-ring of the stack of smooth hyperelliptic curves
entries.source_excerpt: We compute the integral $K_0$-ring of the moduli stack $\mathscr H_g$ of smooth hyperelliptic curves of genus $g\ge2$ over a field of characteristic zero. We show that it is a free abelian group of rank $8g+2$ for even $g$ and $8g+4$ for odd $g$. We use the isotypic decomposition of the $K_0$ of a related $\mu_{g+1}$-gerbe to obtain presentations for both even and odd $g$'s from the standard quotient presentation of $\mathscr H_g$. Thus, our technique differs from the $CH^\bullet(\mathscr H_g)$ computations of Edidin--Fulghesu, Fulghesu--Viviani, Di Lorenzo, and the $K_0(\mathscr M_2)$ computation of Edidin--Hu. Using Pagani's description of the inertia stack of $\mathscr H_g$, we apply Riemann--Roch to interpret the rank of $K_0(\mathscr H_g)$ as the number of inertia components. Finally, we compare the $K_0$ and Chow rings of $\mathscr H_g$ through the gamma-filtration and give presentations to the associated graded rings $\operatorname{gr}_{\gamma}K_0(\mathscr H_g)\otimes\mathbb F_p$ for every prime $p$.

entries.source_title: Unified Multiparadigm Fusion Intelligence for Rare Disease Diagnosis
entries.source_excerpt: Rare diseases (RDs) affect an estimated 300 million people globally, leaving patients to navigate a protracted diagnostic odyssey constrained by clinical scarcity and fragmented medical knowledge. Artificial intelligence (AI) has progressively advanced RD diagnostics, from symbolic methods and deep learning to large language model (LLM)-based systems. However, each paradigm carries structural limitations: symbolic methods are bounded by knowledge completeness, neural models sacrifice interpretability, and LLM-based systems are vulnerable to evaluation biases like data leakage. In this study, we introduce FusionRare, a unified multiparadigm fusion framework integrating knowledge-driven symbolic reasoning, deep-learning pattern recognition, case-based patient retrieval, and LLM-based heuristic inference via statistical meta-aggregation and knowledge-enhanced agentic reflection. Evaluated on 2,528 strictly isolated clinical cases, FusionRare achieves state-of-the-art RD prioritization, attaining a macro-averaged Recall @1 of 51% for phenotype-only diagnosis and 79% for phenotype-genotype joint analysis. entries.source_title: Auditing Conformal Prediction for Language Models Under Inference-Time Model Shift
entries.source_excerpt: Conformal prediction (CP) for language models is typically evaluated under a matched protocol, in which calibration and deployment use the same post-training inference configuration, such as quantization mode and inference temperature. In deployment, these choices often differ from those used at calibration to meet memory or throughput constraints or serving policies. We argue that this exposes a limitation in current CP evaluation protocols for language models. We formalize the underlying phenomenon as inference-time model shift: a change in the conformal score distribution induced by inference configuration rather than by the input--label distribution, and theoretically characterize how it breaks split-conformal exchangeability even when the task distribution and trained model are unchanged. We then evaluate its consequences across 8 language models, 4 finite-label benchmarks, and 12 inference configurations. We find that matched evaluation can substantially overstate deployment-time coverage, and that the effect is heterogeneous across models and datasets. We argue that inference configuration should be reported as a first-class ex

entries.source_title: Tree Lattices and the Neumann-Zagier conjecture
entries.source_excerpt: A tree with integer weights on its vertices presents an integral lattice called a tree lattice. We prove that if a tree lattice is positive definite, then one of the vertex elements is irreducible, i.e. determines a facet of its Voronoi polyhedron. As a corollary, we settle a 1985 conjecture of Neumann and Zagier: if a tree lattice is isometric to the lattice of integer points in Euclidean space, then the tree contains a vertex of weight one.
entries.title_zh: 树格与 Neumann–Zagier 猜想
entries.summary_zh: 树上顶点带整数权可定义一个整格，称为树格。论文证明若树格正定，则至少有一个顶点对应 Voronoi 多面体的不可约面（facet）；进一步推出，若树格与欧氏空间整数点格等距同构，原树必有一个权为 1 的顶点，从而解决 Neumann 与 Zagier 于 1985 年提出的猜想。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 用正定树格的 Voronoi 几何推出树结构限制，完成经典猜想证明。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合格理论、离散几何及相关拓扑结构研究。

entries.paper_review: 核心结构引理直接导出数十年未解猜想。

entries.source_title: From Hermite Chaos to an Attractive Log-Gas: Explicit High-Rank Limits of Iterated-Logarithm and Tail Constants
entries.source_excerpt: Let $Z$ be a standard Hermite process of order $m\ge2$ and Hurst index $H\in(1/2,1)$. For $d2$, let $Y$ be the variance-normalized version of the weighted integral $\int_0^1 x^{-d}\,\mathrm dZ(x)$. Its right tail satisfies $ \log\Pr\{Y>t\}\sim -\frac12\left(\frac{t}{\Lambda_m}\right)^{2m}, t\to\infty, $ where the positive constant $\Lambda_m$ admits an infinite-dimensional variational representation. The same constant governs the sharp law of the iterated logarithm for weighted sums of nonlinear functions of long-memory Gaussian sequences. A general closed-form evaluation at finite order is not known. As $m\to\infty$ with $H$ and $d$ fixed, the normalized constants $\sqrt{m!}\,\Lambda_m$ decrease to an explicit positive function of $H$ and $d$, with relative error $O(m^{-1})$. This function also gives a lower bound for the normalized constant at every finite order. An exact R\'enyi variational representation at each order yields, in the high-rank limit, the entropy--energy variational problem of an attractive logarithmic gas. entries.source_title: The exponent $1/4$ in three complexity bounds: integer bases, continued fractions, and the $(3/2)^n$ steering word
entries.source_excerpt: Let $\xi$ be a real algebraic irrational number and $p(n,\xi,b)$ the number of distinct blocks of length $n$ in its base-$b$ expansion. Bugeaud and Evertse proved in 2008 that $p(n,\xi,b)/(n(\log n)^\eta)$ is unbounded for every $\eta<1/11$. We prove this for every $\eta<1/4$. We also prove the analogous bound for the continued fraction expansion of an algebraic number of degree at least three, with every exponent $\delta<1/4$. Bugeaud announced this statement in 2013 with an unspecified $\delta>0$. Finally, the subword complexity of the steering word of $(3/2)^n$ exceeds $C\,k(\log k)^\eta$ infinitely often for every $\eta<1/4$ and every $C$. The three proofs share one count: $\varepsilon^{-1}$ classes times $\varepsilon^{-3}$ subspaces from the quantitative Subspace Theorem of Evertse and Ferretti. The subspaces are then disposed of at the cost of a logarithm, with no further power of $\varepsilon^{-1}$. All three results, and the quantitative Subspace Theorem they rest on, are machine-verified in Lean~4.

entries.source_title: The longest increasing subsequences of Luce permutations and permutons
entries.source_excerpt: We investigate the longest increasing subsequences (LIS) of random permutations distributed under the Luce model with weights $\theta_1^{(n)} \ge \ldots \ge \theta_n^{(n)}$. Our first main result provides a general formula for the growth rate of the LIS. For example, we get that the LIS of Luce permutations with Sukhatme weights $\theta_k^{(n)} = n-k+1$ grows like $\sqrt{n}$. We also give simple conditions for the LIS to be of order $n^\beta$, for any given $\beta\in[1/2,1)$. Our second main result states that, if the weights are of the form $\theta_k^{(n)} = f\big( (k-1)/n \big)$ for a sufficiently regular function $f$, then the LIS divided by $2\sqrt{n}$ converges in probability to a constant $K(f)$ described by a variational problem. Throughout, we make extensive use of coupling techniques; in particular, to prove our second main result, we argue that Luce random permutations behave similarly to random permutations sampled from the ``Luce permuton''.

entries.source_title: Sums of two dependent uniform random variables: a characterization by joint tail bounds
entries.source_excerpt: Which laws can the sum of two uniform random variables have when nothing is known about how they depend on each other? For three or more uniform summands, convex order gives the answer; for two it does not, and the question has been open. We show that the attainable laws are exactly those that satisfy a family of explicit joint bounds on sums of tail probabilities, one bound for each finite set of thresholds. For laws with a density at most one, convex order alone decides. For densities at most two, convex order implies the simplest of the joint bounds, and the constant two cannot be raised for single-threshold bounds. The number of thresholds a law needs is set by the spacing of its atoms, not by how many atoms it has.

entries.source_title: Supercritical Branching Random Walks on Nested Lattices
entries.source_excerpt: In classical models of supercritical continuous-time branching random walks (BRWs) on a $d$-dimensional lattice, the dimension $d$ is typically assumed to be fixed. To address this question, the paper introduces the concept of a ``random walk on nested lattices'' and investigates the effect of the dimension $d$ on particle population growth using the ``inheritance'' condition. For an arbitrary symmetric random walk, a limit theorem is proved on the representation of the positive eigenvalue of the evolution operator for the mean particle numbers in terms of the process parameters and the dimension $d$, as the branching source intensity $\beta \to \infty$. entries.title_zh: 嵌套格上的超临界分枝随机游走

entries.source_title: Two q-Deformations of Narayana Polynomials: Rogers Moments, Hankel Positivity, and q-Narayana Kernels
entries.source_excerpt: We study two $q$-deformations of the continuous interpolation between type $B$ and shifted type $A$ Narayana polynomials, both constructed from the continuous $q$-ultraspherical (Rogers) functional. The first consists of affine moments of ordinary powers. For fixed $0 <1$ and $-1<\beta<1$, we prove coefficientwise Hankel total positivity in the polynomial variable by a continuant comparison criterion. We also determine leading continuants, Hankel determinants, and extreme coefficients of arbitrary Hankel minors. The second deformation uses Askey--Wilson basis products and yields a basic-hypergeometric Narayana kernel. We give two independent moment evaluations and prove that its row polynomials have simple negative zeros and are $\gamma$-positive after palindromic normalization. An Askey--Wilson integral with base $q^2$ gives a continuous-parameter extension and a moment proof of the Krattenthaler--Wachs super $q$-Narayana expansion, including its integrality. An ordinary-power expansion also proves Pan's Touchard identity. For fixed $0 <1$ and $\theta>-1$, we prove total positivity of the kernel triangle by a Jackson $q$-Bessel--Edre

entries.source_title: FusionEval: Benchmarking Model Fusion for Large Language Models
entries.source_excerpt: Model fusion aims to integrate the capabilities of multi-expert models into a single model. Existing evaluations offer limited coverage of reasoning with long chains of thought and tool use, while strong average performance can mask substantial losses in individual expert capabilities. We introduce FusionEval, a benchmark that provides controlled expert pools, integrates fusion methods with and without additional training, and offers a unified evaluation suite. The pools contain domain experts independently trained from Qwen3 and Llama base models across math, code, science, instruction following, and tool use. The suite evaluates capability retention and computational cost on eight public benchmarks under comparable data access rules, reporting normalized average and worst performance, runtime, and peak GPU memory usage. Extensive experiments show that training-free methods preserve reasoning performance but substantially degrade tool use at both model scales. entries.source_excerpt: These lecture notes present an introduction to large deviations in stochastic dynamical systems, adapted from a lecture series given at the Les Houches school ``Large Deviations: Theory and Applications'' in July 2024. Second, the long-time limit combined with small noise, yielding the quasipotential formalism for metastability and transition rates in both equilibrium and nonequlibrium systems. Third, the long-time limit at finite noise, connecting to spectral methods via tilted generators and enabling reduction of multiscale systems. entries.source_title: Geometric multigrid preconditioners for unfitted discretisations of the de Rham complex
entries.source_excerpt: We propose two families of multigrid preconditioners for unfitted finite element discretisations of the Riesz maps of the de Rham complex, in H(grad), H(curl) and H(div), stabilised by cell aggregation. The first is a geometric multigrid method applied directly to the unfitted operators, on a hierarchy of background meshes that share the same boundary representation. Its smoothers are star patches built on the aggregated mesh, so that each patch captures the kernel of the stabilisation. The second is a multilevel auxiliary-space preconditioner that combines a patch smoother localised around the cut cells with the body-fitted problem on the active mesh, which is in turn solved by a non-nested geometric multigrid method. Both are used as building blocks of block-diagonal preconditioners for the mixed Hodge Laplacians. Numerical experiments in two and three dimensions, on geometries with a controlled cut fraction and on general geometries, show iteration counts that are robust with respect to the cut configuration, the mesh size and the number of levels. entries.source_title: A note on the rectangular Schoenberg-Whitney theorem for clamped B-splines
entries.source_excerpt: Wang et al.(Computer-Aided Design 40 (2008) 999-1008) proposed a knot-subsequence characterization of full row rank for rectangular B-spline collocation matrices. We identify an incorrect inequality in their Appendix proof, which invalidates the argument as written, and make explicit the endpoint and multiplicity conventions on which the criterion depends. The defect lies in the proof, not in the underlying result, which is valid under suitably stated hypotheses; in the lofting construction of Wang et al. these hypotheses are implicitly satisfied, so the lofted curves are unaffected. We state the corrected result and give a new proof, independent of the disputed argument, for clamped B-splines of arbitrary degree with continuous interior multiplicities. In our proof, sufficiency follows from inclusion of spline spaces and knot insertion; necessity selects independent columns and builds the reduced knot vector from them. The proof uses no recursive column-selection construction.

entries.source_title: A hybridization-derived interior penalty Nitsche method for heterogeneous and anisotropic diffusion
entries.source_excerpt: We develop an interior penalty Nitsche finite element formulation for heterogeneous and anisotropic diffusion problems, which is derived from an interior-penalty stabilized Lagrange multiplier method. A distinctive feature of the derived method is that it simultaneously combines two popular stabilization strategies: (i) a boundary penalty mechanism similar to Nitsche's methods and (ii) an interior penalty mechanism as for Continuous Interior Penalty (CIP) methods. Furthermore, the normal component of the numerical flux is single-valued across the mesh skeleton and available in closed form. We establish the equivalence between the hybridized Lagrange multiplier formulation and its condensed Interior Penalty Nitsche (IPN) form, and we deliver the stability and convergence analysis of the latter. For sufficiently regular solutions, we establish energy-norm error estimates for the three symmetry variants. entries.source_title: Gaps for PLRS with zero coefficients
entries.source_excerpt: Zeckendorf proved that every positive integer has a unique decomposition as a sum of non-adjacent Fibonacci numbers. Among its extensions, we focus on Positive Linear Recurrence Sequences (PLRS): fixed depth recurrences with non-negative integral coefficients whose first and last terms are positive: $G_{n+1} = c_1 G_n + \dots + c_L G_{n-L+1}$ with $c_i$ non-negative integers and $c_1 c_L \ge 1$. We again find every integer can be written uniquely as an appropriate sum of terms of the sequence, and we can study the distribution of gaps between summands in decompositions. Bower et al. (2015) proved that if each $c_i \ge 1$ then the distribution of gaps in the generalized Zeckendorf decompositions of integers in $[G_n, G_{n+1})$ converges to a geometric decay for gaps at least two. What if some of the $c_i$'s are allowed to be zero? entries.source_title: The square achievement game on $n \times n$ boards
entries.source_excerpt: Two players alternately claim cells of an $n \times n$ grid; the first to hold all four corners of an axis-parallel square wins, and a full board without one is a draw. The first player has a winning strategy if and only if $n \ge 5$, which answers a question of Erickson. For $n \ge 6$ one strategy serves every board: a rule with no lookup table whose moves after the second reply are all forcing, built around the plus, a stone with the four cells at a common distance from it along the axes, a shape proposed for this game by Sirgedas in 2010. The rule is checked on the boards of size $6$ to $17$, and a simulation theorem carries one checked run on the $23 \times 23$ board to every larger board. The proofs are formalized in Lean 4, and the theorem for the rule states that the tree of its own moves is winning.

entries.source_title: Probabilistic large deviations approach to obstacle Hamilton-Jacobi equations
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we derive a non-classical variational representation of a viscosity solution of a Hamilton-Jacobi equation with obstacle, in which the Hamiltonian may take infinite values. We study a nonlinear selection-mutation model with an exponential-decay mutation kernel, using a probabilistic Feynman-Kac representation of a pure jump process. To handle the singular character of this process, we rely on a non-standard tool from large deviations theory, which allows us to establish a Varadhan-type lemma. This, in turn, yields the variational representation of the viscosity solution.

entries.source_title: LEAN: Loss-Engineered Modulation of the Model Weight-Sensitivity Distribution for Efficient, Error-Tolerant Neural Networks
entries.source_excerpt: The weights of a trained network do not have uniform sensitivity to model accuracy: the 1% most sensitive weights carry about a fifth of the damage a bit flip can do. This distribution decides the bit-flip tolerance of a model, the fraction of weights a code must cover and the bits each weight needs; existing schemes work with the distribution training leaves. We show that we can systematically modulate or alter the weight sensitivity distribution of a trained model, thereby shifting weights from one sensitivity bin to another. entries.source_title: PORA: Learning When More Reasoning Pays Off for LLM Agents
entries.source_excerpt: LLM agents perform tasks over multiple steps and revise their actions based on feedback. As the total reasoning budget is often limited and must support future steps, the agent must choose between short and long reasoning before each action. Longer reasoning may improve the final task outcome by preventing later errors, but it also uses budget capacity that may be needed for future decisions. This creates two challenges: estimating the downstream value of long reasoning and deciding when that value is worth using the remaining budget. We propose Paired Outcome-guided Reasoning Allocation (PORA), which learns this decision by comparing short and long reasoning from the same interaction state. During training, \method{} completes the task twice from each selected state, once with a short reasoning allowance and once with a long allowance, and compares their final quality and total processing to estimate when longer reasoning is valuable. During inference, a controller weighs this estimate against learned prices on remaining-budget pressure and chooses either short or long reasoning without running both alternatives. entries.source_title: Percolation on Bidirected Graphs
entries.source_excerpt: We study bidirected percolation on an undirected graph $G$: each edge is replaced by two oppositely directed edges, each of which is open independently with probability $p$. Two vertices are strongly connected if they are mutually reachable by open directed paths. Let $p_\mathrm{sc}$ denote the threshold for the existence of an infinite strongly connected cluster, and let $p_c$ denote the usual Bernoulli percolation threshold on $G$. On every transitive amenable graph, we prove that $p_\mathrm{sc}=p_c$. In contrast, sufficiently spread-out modifications of every transitive non-amenable graph satisfy $p_\mathrm{sc}>p_c$. We also show that, on $\mathbb Z^d$ with $d\ge11$, the expected size of the strongly connected cluster is finite at $p=p_\mathrm{sc}$.

entries.source_title: What RL Brings to Reasoning: A Few Decisions the Base Model Would Not Make
entries.source_excerpt: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) substantially improves mathematical reasoning, but what it adds to the base model remains unclear. We investigate this through a sequence of generation-time interventions on Qwen3-4B-Base, measuring how much of its RL-trained counterpart's gain each intervention recovers on 120 AIME problems. Power sampling with the same 8,192-token output limit brings no gain beyond greedy decoding. Yet borrowing the RL model's token only where the two models' greedy choices differ, roughly 4% of generated positions, recovers 90.5% of the pass@1 gain, with similar recovery across three model pairs on MATH-500. We find that even a single opening token has a substantial effect: forcing the base model to begin with "Alright" recovers 35% of the RL gain. The opening alone is insufficient, however. Later replacements after the same opening add another 5.2 percentage points to pass@1, and the fixed rules we test for inserting reflective words such as "Wait" do not reproduce this benefit. entries.source_title: Couplings with prescribed maxima: A short proof of the quasi-copula characterization
entries.source_excerpt: We provide a short probabilistic proof of the classical characterization of multivariate quasi-copulas, addressing the call for a simpler and more transparent proof expressed by Sempi (2017). Our approach is based on a coupling construction for random variables with fixed marginal distributions and a prescribed distribution of their maximum. In our main result, we show that such a coupling exists if and only if the maximum is stochastically no smaller than each component and the distribution of the maximum is dominated by the sum of the marginal measures. The construction applies to arbitrary distributions and relies only on a decomposition of the maximum law and monotone quantile couplings. A direct consequence of our main result is the existence of copulas with prescribed values along an increasing track.

entries.source_title: A Gauge-Invariant Finite Element Method for the Time-Dependent Ginzburg--Landau Equations
entries.source_excerpt: It is well known that the Ginzburg--Landau equations are gauge invariant. The most popular gauge choice in practical simulations is the temporal gauge, also known as the zero electric potential gauge. However, the commonly used N\'ed\'elec approximations may produce spurious giant vortices on domains with re-entrant corners. To address this issue while retaining the N\'ed\'elec approximation, we propose a finite element scheme that preserves the gauge invariance of the time-dependent Ginzburg--Landau equations at the discrete level. Under the temporal gauge, the method employs lowest-order N\'ed\'elec edge elements for the magnetic potential and continuous piecewise-linear elements for the order parameter on triangular and tetrahedral meshes, and yields a linear, decoupled formulation that requires only the solution of linear systems at each time step. entries.source_title: Choice principles in countable partition models
entries.source_excerpt: We study the countable partition model over a set of atoms of arbitrary uncountable cardinality $\kappa$. Its supports are partitions of the atoms into countably many blocks, and a permutation fixes a support when it preserves each block setwise. This model was proposed by Bruce and studied by Banerjee. We prove that dependent choice holds for every $\kappa$, although the filter of subgroups is not closed under countable intersections. Choice for well-orderable families holds exactly when $\kappa<\aleph_{\omega_1}$; when $\kappa\ge\aleph_{\omega_1}$, an $\omega_1$-indexed family witnesses its failure. The Hartogs and Lindenbaum numbers of the set of atoms are both $\omega_1$. The proofs use permutations matching blocks of equal cardinality and establish shift completeness of the filter. Together with Banerjee's failure of $\mathsf{DC}_{\omega_1}$, these results determine which dependent choice principles hold in the model.

entries.source_title: Projected Distillation: On Learning to Solve Hard Problems from Close, Correct Targets
entries.source_excerpt: On-policy learning is central to post-training: training on a model's own generations limits distribution shift and helps preserve existing capabilities. On hard problems, however, on-policy RL provides no reward-based learning signal when all attempts fail. On-policy distillation provides next-token supervision from a teacher, but on hard problems, if a rollout goes wrong early, subsequent supervision is conditioned on prefixes that already contain the mistake. Correct behavior can instead come from a gold or teacher solution, but such off-policy targets can differ substantially from the model's generations and, as we show, may erode existing capabilities. We therefore treat on-policyness as a continuum and propose projected distillation, which minimally edits the student's failed attempts into correct targets. entries.source_title: Uniform convergence at optimal rate and scale
entries.source_excerpt: Uniform convergence asks how many random samples suffice for empirical averages to approximate expectations simultaneously over an entire class of functions. It is a central concept in probability and a foundation of statistical learning. For binary-valued classes, the Vapnik--Chervonenkis theorem characterizes uniform convergence by finiteness of the VC dimension. For dimension $d$, the sharp worst-case sample complexity for additive error $\varepsilon$ is of order $d/\varepsilon^2$. For real-valued functions, the analogous combinatorial parameter is the fat-shattering dimension, which depends on an approximation scale $\gamma$. The challenge is to achieve error $\gamma+\varepsilon$ with order $d/\varepsilon^2$ samples, matching the sample bound for binary classes, where $d$ is now the fat-shattering dimension at scale $\gamma$. Previous results achieved either the optimal scale or the optimal sample complexity, but not both. Our main result closes this gap, establishing the sharp sample complexity at the optimal scale. entries.title_zh: 最优尺度与最优速率下的一致收敛
entries.summary_zh: 对于实值函数类，论文研究以 fat-shattering 维数为 d 时，能否同时达到误差 γ+ε 与样本复杂度 O(d/ε²)；既有结果只能分别优化尺度或样本数。作者声称填补这一缺口，得到在最优尺度下匹配二值 VC 类样本界的尖锐一致收敛复杂度，并发展若干 ε-net 工具。

entries.source_title: A quaternary Diophantine inequality with prime numbers of a special form (II)
entries.source_excerpt: Let $N$ be a sufficiently large real number. In this paper, it is proved that, for $1<\frac{5179}{3909}$ and for any arbitrary large number $E>0$, the Diophantine inequality \begin{equation*} \big|p_1^c+p_2^c+p_3^c+p_4^c-N\big|<(\log N)^{-E} \end{equation*} is solvable in prime variables $p_1,p_2,p_3,p_4$ such that each of the numbers $p_i+2\,(i=1,2,3,4)$ has, counted according to multiplicity, at most $[\frac{31250}{5179-3909c}]$ prime factors, which constitutes a large improvement upon the previous results of Dimitrov [13] and Li-Xue-Zhang [22], respectively.
entries.title_zh: 特殊形式素数上的四元丢番图不等式（二）
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明：当 1<c<5179/3909 且 N 足够大时，可找到四个素数 p₁,…,p₄，使其 c 次幂之和与 N 的误差小于任意指定的负对数幂；同时每个 pᵢ+2 的素因子个数受给定上界约束。结果改进了此前相关工作，属于以素数变量逼近大实数的加法数论问题。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 给出带有额外筛选条件的素数幂逼近定量结果，适合加法数论读者比较其参数范围。
entries.pragmatic_review: 主要是理论推进，应用性较间接。
entries.cynic_review: 指数 c 有明确上界，结论依赖 N 足够大。
entries.paper_review: 把近似精度与平移素数因子约束同时纳入分析。

entries.source_title: Non-aware computable presentations of randomizations
entries.source_excerpt: Let 2 be the two-element structure in the empty signature. We build a computable presentation Q of the Borel randomization $2^{[0,1)}$ in which neither constant random variable is a computable point. Consequently, Q is not aware. This gives a negative answer to a question of Cuervo Ovalle and Goldbring \cite{CG}. We also construct a countable structure $M$ with no computable presentation but $M^{[0,1)}$ has a computable presentation. This answers another question and establishes the necessity of the awareness condition stated in one of the main theorems in \cite{CG}.

entries.source_title: Dihedral fields with Bloch lattice index five and quadratic subfield Q(i)
entries.source_excerpt: We construct infinitely many Galois extensions $M/\mathbb{Q}$ with dihedral group of order ten, quadratic subfield $\mathbb{Q}(i)$, and Bloch lattice index $Q_2(M)=5$. More precisely, we specify a Chebotarev set of rational primes of density $1/50$. For every prime $\ell$ in this set, at least two of four mixed cyclic quintic extensions of $\mathbb{Q}(i)$ of conductor $(25\ell)$ have this index and satisfy $K_2(O_M)(5)\simeq(\mathbb{Z}/5)^2$. A two-dimensional cup-product pencil selects the extensions. Generalized Bockstein maps, integral co-descent, and a motivic genus formula then determine the tame kernel and the subfield Bloch-lattice index. The result is unconditional.
entries.title_zh: Bloch 格指标为 5 且二次子域为 Q(i) 的二面体域
entries.summary_zh: 作者无条件构造无穷多个 Galois 扩张 M/Q，其群为阶 10 二面体群、二次子域为 Q(i)，Bloch 格指标 Q₂(M)=5；对应素数来自密度 1/50 的 Chebotarev 集。对其中每个素数，至少两个导子为 (25ℓ) 的混合五次扩张还满足 K₂(O_M)(5) 同构于 (Z/5)²，证明使用 cup-product pencil、Bockstein 映射及积分下降。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数数论读者关注 K₂、Bloch 格与显式 Galois 扩张的交叉构造。

entries.paper_review: 摘要陈述了无条件存在结果及主要代数工具。

entries.source_title: Training with Ciphers to Enhance In-Context Terminology Learning For Translation from Rare Languages
entries.source_excerpt: Fine-tuning LLMs with in-context examples (IC-Train) lets translation models adapt to new parallel data at deployment, but it is unclear whether they actually learn the translations of rare terms from those examples. We formalize this capability as in-context term learning (ICTL). We show that standard IC-Train develops this capability only weakly, and propose RareCipherFT, which strengthens it without any lexical resources. RareCipherFT pairs each training target with in-context examples that share a rare term with it. It then replaces that term with a character-shuffled cipher in both the context and the reference, so the term can only be recovered by copying from context. The ciphered fraction of training data is annealed to preserve translation quality. Across seven translation directions between English and Tamil, Assamese, Mizo, Nepali and Hausa, and four models from 1B to 7B parameters, RareCipherFT raises term recall over standard IC-Train by 5-15 absolute points without lowering COMET. entries.title_zh: 通过密码训练增强稀有语言翻译的上下文术语学习
entries.summary_zh: RareCipherFT 在训练中为目标文本和共享稀有词的上下文示例同时替换成字符打乱密码，使模型只能从上下文复制恢复术语，并逐步退火密码比例以保留译文质量。跨英语与泰米尔语、阿萨姆语、米佐语、尼泊尔语、豪萨语的七个翻译方向及 1B–7B 模型，论文报告术语召回率较标准 IC-Train 提升 5–15 个百分点，COMET 未下降。

entries.source_title: Rational analytic prismatization
entries.source_excerpt: We develop a general theory of analytic prismatization with $\mathbb{Q}_p$-coefficients in rigid analytic geometry over $\mathbb{Q}_p$. We prove an equivalence of perfect complexes on the perfect analytic prismatization modulo Frobenius with perfect complexes on the relative Fargues--Fontaine curve for any smooth partially proper rigid analytic variety. In particular, we explain how this equivalence conceptualizes the decompletion techniques by passing to locally analytic vectors which appear in (geometric) Sen theory
entries.title_zh: 有理系数的解析棱柱化理论
entries.summary_zh: 论文在 Q_p 上的刚性解析几何中发展带 Q_p 系数的解析棱柱化理论，并证明对任意光滑、部分适当的刚性解析簇，完美解析棱柱化模 Frobenius 的完美复形范畴等价于相对 Fargues–Fontaine 曲线上的完美复形范畴。该等价也为几何 Sen 理论中通过局部解析向量进行的降完备化技术提供概念解释。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 建立棱柱上同调与相对 Fargues–Fontaine 曲线之间的范畴对应。
entries.pragmatic_review: 对 p 进几何、棱柱上同调和 Sen 理论研究者有价值。

entries.paper_review: 给出范畴等价并解释已有降完备化方法的几何来源。

entries.source_title: Pearl-Chat: Engineering a native Luganda language model from first principles in JAX and Flax NNX
entries.source_excerpt: Autoregressive foundation language models predominantly target high-resource Indo-European languages, imposing computational and morphological penalties on under-represented African languages. Generic multilingual tokenizers routinely exceed fertility rates of 3.2 tokens per word on agglutinative Bantu languages, degrading context efficiency and inflating latency. We present Pearl-Chat, an 8,473,122-parameter ($\sim$8.5M) causal decoder-only transformer engineered for Luganda (Oluganda, ISO 639-2: lg), a low-resource Niger-Congo Bantu language spoken by over 10 million people in East Africa. Built from first mathematical principles in JAX and Flax NNX, Pearl-Chat uses explicit functional state decomposition (nnx.split and nnx.merge), deterministic resumable data streaming via Google Grain, and SPMD tensor parallelism using jax.sharding.Mesh. We introduce a byte-level byte-pair encoding (BPE) subword tokenizer trained from scratch on curated Luganda corpora ($V = 8,192$), achieving 4.88 characters per token compression and 1.60 tokens per word fertility, a two-fold compression improvement over LLaMA-3 (128K) and Gemma (256K). The model
entries.title_zh: Pearl-Chat：从头用 JAX/Flax NNX 构建卢干达语模型

entries.source_title: Quadratic mixing for the Lee--Sidford Dikin walk
entries.source_excerpt: Let $K=\{x\in\R^d:Ax\ge b\}$ be a bounded full-dimensional polytope with $m$ inequalities. For targets on $K$ with density proportional to $\exp(-\vartheta^\transpose x)$, we prove a $\widetilde O(d^2)$ bound, measured in Markov chain iterations, for the chi-square mixing of the $1/2$-lazy Metropolis Dikin walk based on a polylogarithmically rescaled Lee--Sidford metric. The estimate holds for every initial law with finite chi-square divergence. The proof controls the reverse Gaussian proposal through a quantitative average self-concordance estimate at the required $O(1/d)$ scale. We establish this estimate from uniform analytic derivative bounds for the Lewis-weight subspace and an all-order projection-weighted contraction inequality for Gaussian chaoses. For order $j$, the latter bounds each base-point polynomial at scale $d^{j/2}$, up to $j$-dependent and logarithmic factors. Truncating at logarithmic order then absorbs the remaining pathwise loss. entries.title_zh: Lee–Sidford Dikin 随机游走的二次混合时间界
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究有界满维多面体上的 Lee–Sidford 度量 Dikin 随机游走，证明半惰性 Metropolis 链对目标密度 exp(−θᵀx) 的卡方混合时间为 Õ(d²) 次迭代，适用于任意具有有限初始卡方散度的分布。核心技术是以定量平均自协调性控制反向高斯提议，并结合 Lewis 权重导数界与高斯混沌的全阶投影收缩不等式；作者称这解决了此前 rigorously established 最好为 Õ(d^(9/4)) 的开放问题，摘要同时注明证明由 ChatGPT 5.6 Pro 找到，数学结论仍应按论文证明审查。

entries.source_title: Edit, Don't Imitate: Minimal-Edit On-Policy Distillation for Multimodal Reasoning
entries.source_excerpt: Visual mathematical reasoning can fail before reasoning begins: when a vision-language model (VLM) misreads a diagram, subsequent reasoning proceeds from false premises. This perceptual bottleneck is especially pronounced in smaller models, while accurate textual descriptions can substantially narrow the gap to larger models. Because obtaining such descriptions at inference requires additional annotation or model calls, we propose minimal-edit corrective on-policy distillation. Using reference figure descriptions and verified reference solutions as training-only information, a teacher scores incorrect student rollouts under a minimal-edit objective, and only teacher-disfavored tokens contribute to the corrective loss. Correct rollouts receive task-reward reinforcement learning. This preserves on-policy supervision while avoiding full-response imitation. Across model scales, the method requires no descriptions at test time and meets or exceeds the corresponding base model supplied with a reference figure description at inference. It also improves perception-oriented performance, particularly low-level geometric perception, and transfer
entries.title_zh: 最小编辑蒸馏：纠正视觉数学推理的错误环节

entries.source_title: The Schubert bialgebra
entries.source_excerpt: We introduce a Schubert bialgebra $\mathcal{A}=\bigoplus_{n\geq 0}\mathbb{Z}[x_1,\ldots,x_n]$, in which polynomials in different numbers of variables multiply to zero and the coproduct splits the variables into two consecutive blocks, and study its graded dual $\mathcal{D}$, whose product is concatenation of weak compositions. The Schubert polynomials $\mathfrak{S}_u^n$ form a basis of $\mathcal{A}$; we give an explicit formula for the dual Schubert basis $\Xi_u^n$ of $\mathcal{D}$ via a transition formula to an elementary symmetric basis, and show that the Schubert structure constants $c_{u,v}^w$ are the coefficients of the coproduct of $\mathcal{D}$ in the dual Schubert basis. The product of $\mathcal{D}$ is then lifted to an associative product $\sqcup$ on the free abelian group $\mathcal{BRC}$ of bounded RC graphs, built from a transition map $\mathcal{Z}$ on RC graphs that realizes the Lascoux-Sch\"utzenberger transition formula and generalizes Little's bumping algorithm. Quotienting $\mathcal{BRC}$ by ideals coming from Demazure crystal equivalence, Nadeau-Tewari forest equivalence, and quasi-Yamanouchi equivalence yields manife
entries.title_zh: Schubert 双代数与组合图上的正 Littlewood–Richardson 规则
entries.summary_zh: 论文构造由不同变量数多项式组成的 Schubert 双代数及其分次对偶，给出对偶 Schubert 基的显式公式，并把 Schubert 结构常数表示为对偶代数余乘积的系数。作者再把对偶乘法提升到有界 RC 图的自由阿贝尔群上，利用实现 Lascoux–Schützenberger 转移公式的图转移映射，经过若干等价关系商化后得到 dual Schubert、key、forest 和 slide 基的显式正 Littlewood–Richardson 规则；在 Schubert 情形对应 GL_p×GL_q 嵌入 GL_{p+q} 的分支系数。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数组合与表示论读者了解 Schubert 系数如何通过 RC 图和双代数结构获得正组合公式。

entries.source_title: RoleFlow: Self-Evolving Multi-Role Agentic Collaboration via Structural Adaptation
entries.source_excerpt: Large language model (LLM) based multi-agent systems often rely on predefined collaboration structures, limiting their adaptability to evolving task requirements. Although recent approaches enable dynamic orchestration, trajectory-level rewards they apply assign one outcome to each decision, ofen struggling to identify the contributions of individual structural changes. We propose RoleFlow, a self-evolving multi-role agentic system that refines collaboration structures through feedback-driven atomic edits and on-demand role synthesis. To make structural adaptation learnable, we introduce Single-Edit Counterfactual Policy Optimization (SECPO), which evaluates each edit against its no-edit counterpart at the same chain state and assigns targeted credit to edit-specific tokens. Across seven benchmarks spanning four domains, RoleFlow achieves the optimal average performance, surpassing the strongest competitor by 4.7 points. It leads on all three multi-hop QA benchmarks by 3.2-7.5 F1 points and also shows supremacy on mathematical reasoning, web interaction, and code generation. Further analyses demonstrate cross-benchmark transferability

entries.source_title: Certified neural approximations for parabolic obstacle problems
entries.source_excerpt: Residual-trained neural surrogates carry no error guarantee, a limitation for free-boundary problems such as phase change and contact. We derive guaranteed error bounds for neural approximations of parabolic obstacle problems in first-order state--flux--multiplier form. The main result bounds the flux error of the network and the energy error of its feasible projection $\max\{v,g\}$ by the constitutive residual, the initial mismatch, the complementarity defect, and the PDE residual weighted by $c_F^2/\alpha$, without the coercivity and norm-equivalence constants of the first-order formulation. It extends the Apushkinskaya--Repin majorant for the heat operator to general coefficients, free multipliers and a flux bound. A penetration-consistency result shows that neural triples with arbitrarily small bound exist. Outward-rounded cellwise Taylor-model enclosures turn the bound into a finite computation valid on any adaptive partition. The flux and gradient errors of the projected output are certified below $0.27$ and $0.33$ of the solution scale for a one-dimensional Stefan problem and, after adaptive refinement, below one half for all t
entries.title_zh: 抛物障碍问题的可认证神经近似
entries.summary_zh: 论文为抛物障碍问题的一阶状态—通量—乘子形式神经近似推导严格误差上界，把通量误差和可行投影 max{v,g} 的能量误差控制在本构残差、初值偏差、互补缺陷及 PDE 残差等量之内。通过向外舍入的逐单元 Taylor 模型包络，可在自适应网格上有限计算认证；Stefan 一维问题示例中投影输出的通量和梯度误差界分别低于解尺度的 0.27 和 0.33。

entries.source_title: Set-theoretic inevitability
entries.source_excerpt: After defining the concept of inevitability for statements with the modal logic of forcing, we raise the question of which statements are inevitable under $\mathsf{ZFC}$ and under large cardinal hypotheses. We show that $\mathsf{SOA}$ (defined as $\mathsf{ZFC}^-$ + $\mathsf V=\mathsf{HC}$) plus the $\boldsymbol\Sigma^1_2$-perfect set property is $\mathsf{ZFC}$-inevitable, and that Projective Determinacy is inevitable in the theory of $\mathsf{ZFC}$ with a proper class of Woodin cardinals. We then discuss the possible conceptual significance of these results for the foundations of set theory.
entries.title_zh: 集合论中的必然性：强迫模态逻辑的视角
entries.summary_zh: 论文通过强迫的模态逻辑定义集合论命题的必然性，给出 ZFC 下一个含完美集性质的理论的必然性结果。摘要还称在存在真类 Woodin 基数的 ZFC 中射影决定性必然，并讨论这些结论的基础意义。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合理解强迫、模态算子与公理选择。

entries.source_title: Lax descent and foliated Verdier duality
entries.source_excerpt: Higher categorical methods allow us to view recollements as lax descent data and build a corresponding descent theory governed by an $\infty$-bicategorical theory of limits. We demonstrate some concrete innovations brought along by these new techniques in the classical context of constructible and perverse sheaves on stratified spaces. Our first application uses partially (op)lax descent to recover the famous result of Beilinson telling us how to glue perverse sheaves in terms of vanishing and nearby cycles. The remainder of the article is concerened with establishing a uniform view on a series of classification results for perverse sheaves culminating in recent work of Kapranov-Schechtman. Namely, we use lax descent to establish a ``foliated'' variant of Verdier duality which, informally speaking, identifies the derived constructible category of a suitably foliated space with sections of a categorical cosheaf on the leaf space whose stalks are the categories of sheaves along the leaves. Again, this is obtained as an application of lax descent, and seems to provide a reasonable framework to formalize the idea of ``mixed sheaf-cosheaf
entries.title_zh: Lax 下降与叶状 Verdier 对偶
entries.summary_zh: 论文把 recollement 视为高阶范畴中的 lax 下降数据，建立由 ∞-双范畴极限控制的下降理论，并用它重述 Beilinson 关于 vanishing/nearby cycles 粘合 perverse sheaves 的结果。进一步，作者构造叶状 Verdier 对偶：在适当叶状空间上，整体导出可构造层范畴可描述为叶空间上一个范畴余层的截面，其 stalk 对应沿叶的层范畴。

entries.source_title: Sch\"affer's conjecture for even $k \le 42$
entries.source_excerpt: In 1956, Sch\"affer made a conjecture on the whole number solutions to the Diophantine equation $S_k(x):=1^k+2^k+\cdots+x^k=y^n$. In this paper we show how for even $k$, we can descend to a long list of three coupled equations of the form $Ax^p-By^p=1$, where $A,B\in\mathbb{Q}$. To this system, we apply the modular method, linear forms in logarithms, and local methods. As a result, we prove Sch\"affer's conjecture for even $k \le 42$.

entries.source_title: WaveCommitments: Private and Verifiable Speech-Agent Marketplaces
entries.source_excerpt: Modern speech systems are evolving into ecosystems of autonomous speech agents that interact, negotiate, and trade assets such as embeddings, spectrograms, or raw data. In such markets, sellers cannot reveal assets for evaluation due to privacy constraints, and buyers cannot price what they cannot test. Thus, we introduce WaveCommitments, an end-to-end design that couples multivariate polynomial commitments with confidential asset valuation via Data Shapley inside a trusted execution environment. It enables selective openings and tamper-evident provenance to prove that a delivered asset matches the valuation while hiding everything else. Our extensive experiments across three standard datasets and various tasks with state-of-the-art encoders, including Whisper, reveal that we speed up the strongest baselines by up to 18.1x while reducing their proof sizes by up to 43.2x. We also analyze how a speaker's value shifts across tasks and encoders, revealing agent-level market prices.

entries.source_title: Low-weight compactly supported cohomology of $\mathcal M_{g,n}^{ct}$ and the extended Torelli morphism
entries.source_excerpt: We study the weight zero and weight two graded pieces of the compactly supported cohomology of the moduli space $\mathcal M_{g,n}^{ct}$ of stable $n$-pointed curves of genus $g$ of compact type and show that they are computed by bridgeless graph complexes. In weight two, we construct a natural embedding of shifted weight zero cohomology from lower genus. For unmarked curves, we construct canonical classes represented by pinched odd wheel graphs and prove that distinct wheel monomials give linearly independent classes in the dual of $W_0H_c^{2g}(\mathcal M_g^{ct};\mathbb Q)$. By relating the bridgeless graph complex to the $K$-theory of graphs and the Quillen spectral sequence, we show that these classes remain linearly independent after pushforward along the extended Torelli morphism $\mathcal M_g^{ct}\to\mathcal A_g$. Finally, we prove that the realizations of the motivic Lie algebra arising from $\mathcal M_g$ and $\mathcal A_g$ have the same image in the weight zero compactly supported cohomology of $\mathcal M_g^{ct}$.

entries.source_title: Rapid convergence of Langevin AIS for multimodal distributions on $\mathbb{R}^d$
entries.source_excerpt: We study annealed importance sampling (AIS) driven by the overdamped Langevin diffusion, targeting a multimodal Gibbs measure $\pi_\varepsilon \propto e^{-U/\varepsilon}$ on $\mathbb{R}^d$ at low temperature $\varepsilon$. For a potential $U$ with nondegenerate critical points, finitely many wells of comparable mass, and at least quadratic growth at infinity, we show that AIS with a harmonically spaced temperature schedule produces a weighted empirical measure that approximates $\pi_\varepsilon$ to accuracy $\delta$ at a total cost of order $\varepsilon^{-2}\delta^{-2}$, up to logarithmic factors, and the exponents do not depend on the dimension. This is an exponential improvement over plain Langevin Monte Carlo, whose relaxation time obeys the Arrhenius law. The assumptions cover, in particular, the potentials of Gaussian mixtures, as long as their critical points are nondegenerate and their wells carry comparable mass. The analysis extends that of arXiv:2604.17526 [math.PR] from the torus $\mathbb{T}^d$ to the noncompact state space $\mathbb{R}^d$. entries.source_title: Planar Disk Filters and Real Chromatic Roots at Beraha Numbers
entries.source_excerpt: We construct simple plane triangulations whose chromatic polynomials have real roots accumulating at every noninteger Beraha number $B_\ell=4\cos^2(\pi/\ell)$; the integer values $0,1,2,3$ are roots of $K_4$. The construction rests on the observation that a triangulated disk with four boundary vertices acts, inside a larger triangulation, as a transfer operator lying in a commutative three-parameter algebra. Rotating such disks by a quarter turn and composing them in series moves their eigenvalue triples around this algebra in a controllable way, and for every fixed $q\in(B_{10},4)$ one can manufacture a finite disk whose two competing local eigenvalues are strictly dominated by the third -- a physical filter. Closing a grid of such disks between two poles produces a sphere triangulation, and a fused Temperley-Lieb trace identity accounts for its chromatic polynomial completely, sector by sector, with no appeal to semisimplicity at the root of unity itself -- generic semisimplicity enters only through polynomial identities continued from $\delta>2$ -- and no singular higher Jones-Wenzl projectors. entries.source_title: The Rules Cannot Change Only for Young Mathematicians: AI and the future of a mathematical career

entries.paper_review: 对证明贡献归属与青年学者评价提出了制度问题。

entries.source_title: On a conjecture of Velani
entries.source_excerpt: We investigate the approximation of elements of the middle-third Cantor set by dyadic rationals, and natural extensions. We prove a conjecture of Velani, completing the metric theory for the Cantor measure. Our key method enables a quantitative study of the incommensurability of binary and ternary expansions of integers, initiated by Furstenberg. The method has other applications, e.g. $\sum_{k} |\hat{\mu}(2^k)|^\sigma < \infty$ for any $\sigma > 0$, where $\mu$ is the Cantor measure.
entries.title_zh: 关于 Velani 猜想
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究三分 Cantor 集中的点由二进有理数逼近的问题，证明了 Velani 关于 Cantor 测度的猜想，从而完成该测度对应的度量理论。关键方法定量分析整数二进展开与三进展开的不相容性，并推出 Cantor 测度 Fourier 系数沿 2 的幂次取样后满足任意正幂的可和性。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 展示数字展开不相容性如何控制分形测度的丢番图逼近与 Fourier 衰减。
entries.pragmatic_review: 为 Cantor 测度的逼近问题补齐了理论结论。
entries.cynic_review: 应用结论依赖特定 Cantor 测度和二进取样序列。
entries.paper_review: 完成猜想并导出 Fourier 系数可和性等应用。

entries.source_title: Models of Arbitrary Sets
entries.source_excerpt: There is a growing literature on arbitrary objects as other types of mathematical objects, besides particular mathematical objects. In this paper we study arbitrary sets in the context of ZFC set theory. An arbitrary object is one that is determined by a state space across which it varies and by its instantiations. We compare two semantic strategies. First, we analyse the possibility of modeling arbitrary sets using direct powers of a ZFC structure. This yields a natural setting, but one where Extensionality and, crucially, the full Separation scheme fail. Second, we consider structures composed of arbitrary sets using a direct power construction evaluated in a Boolean-valued semantics. Within this setting, we develop the cumulative hierarchy of arbitrary sets, arbitrary ordinals, cardinals, and filtrations of the structure of arbitrary sets. The final section develops a combinatorial interpretation in terms of independent assignments across a fixed state space. Its connection with the iterative conception is then discussed.
entries.title_zh: 任意集合的模型
entries.summary_zh: 论文在 ZFC 集合论中研究由状态空间和具体取值共同刻画的“任意对象”，并比较两种语义建模。直接对 ZFC 结构取幂虽自然，却会失去外延公理和完整分离模式；作者转而在布尔值语义下构造任意集合的累积层级、序数、基数与过滤结构，并讨论独立赋值的组合解释及其与迭代集合观的联系。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合集合论与数学哲学读者了解“对象随状态变化”这一建模方式对公理性质的影响。
entries.pragmatic_review: 两种语义路线的比较能提醒建模者检查哪些 ZFC 原理仍成立。
entries.cynic_review: “任意对象”的技术框架与应用范围需结合全文定义理解。
entries.paper_review: 摘要明确给出失败公理和替代语义构造，证明细节仍需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: Moduli spaces of logarithmic connections associated with difference Painlev\'e equations of type $E^{(1)}_n$
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we provide an explicit correspondence between moduli spaces of parabolic logarithmic connections on the projective line with spectral type $(2^2,1^4,1^4)$ and $(3^2, 2^3, 1^6)$, and the spaces of initial conditions for difference Painlev\'e equations with symmetry of type $E^{(1)}_7$ and $E^{(1)}_8$, respectively. Furthermore, we realize the extended affine Weyl group symmetries of the space of initial conditions in terms of connections.
entries.title_zh: 与 E₇^(1)、E₈^(1) 差分 Painlevé 方程相关的对数联络模空间
entries.summary_zh: 论文为两类射影直线上带抛物结构的对数联络模空间，建立其与 E₇^(1)、E₈^(1) 对称差分 Painlevé 方程初值空间的显式对应。它还把初值空间上的扩展仿射 Weyl 群对称性实现为联络变换。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把差分 Painlevé 动力系统、模空间和联络几何之间的对应关系具体化。
entries.pragmatic_review: 主要面向几何与可积系统研究者。
entries.cynic_review: 对应依赖摘要所列谱型和对称类型。
entries.paper_review: 将仿射 Weyl 对称提升到模空间联络描述。

entries.source_title: Breaking the high-degree barrier in Lehmer's problem with a human-AI discovery loop
entries.source_excerpt: While artificial intelligence has made rapid progress in mathematical reasoning, many open problems depend on structure that is revealed only through large-scale computational exploration and analytical synthesis. One such example is Lehmer's problem from 1933. It asks whether the Mahler measure of an integer polynomial, which measures how far its roots stray from the unit circle, can be made arbitrarily small. Previously, constructing irreducible polynomials with integer coefficients and small Mahler measure has been carried out systematically only for even degrees $d \le 180$. At higher degrees, Boyd's analytical one-parameter family frequently factors, skipping nearly 50% of target degrees and leaving no general construction for arbitrary $d$. Here, we address the high-degree regime through a human-AI discovery loop, in which we extend the conversational prompting with a fast numerical pipeline, an exact symbolic verifier, and large-scale distributed search. The AI agent prototypes numerical and symbolic solvers locally, launches parallel searches across distributed clusters and works with the human researcher to extract and verify
entries.title_zh: Lehmer 问题中的高次数人机发现循环
entries.summary_zh: 论文围绕构造高次数、低 Mahler 测度整系数不可约多项式，介绍数值流水线、精确符号验证与分布式搜索结合的人机协作。现有摘录在结果前截断，只说明既有构造会漏过很多次数；不能据标题声称解决 Lehmer 问题或给出未见的性能数字。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究计算探索如何转化为可核验数论构造。
entries.pragmatic_review: 数值候选与精确验证的分工值得借鉴。

entries.paper_review: 应查看完整构造和不可约性验证。

entries.source_title: An Exact 93-Move Solution to a Nonlocal Crystal-Exchange Puzzle
entries.source_excerpt: We determine the minimum number of directional commands needed to solve alevel of Order of the Sinking Star, modeled as a crystal-exchangepuzzle on an 11*11 board. A command swapsthe player with the nearest crystal in the selected row or column, regardlessof distance; only an empty ray permits an ordinary unit walk. Two gates admitthe player to the exit exactly while all sixteen crystals occupy their targetcells. We give an explicit 93-command solution and exclude every shortersolution by an exact, cost-bounded breadth-first search. The search representsa position by its seventeen occupied cells and one active cell. Its admissibleheuristic partitions command costs between a compressed core abstraction andresidual motion, strengthened by a necessary activation detour and a cornervisit condition. The completed computation retained 605,349,215 occupied setsand 1,863,925,136 states. We prove the reductions and pruning conditions,describe the exact storage scheme, and provide source code, execution logs,and a reproduction driver. The result is a computer-assisted proof for thespecified instance, with an explicit implementation trust bounda
entries.title_zh: 非局部晶体交换谜题的精确 93 步解
entries.summary_zh: 论文把《Order of the Sinking Star》一个 11×11 棋盘关卡形式化为晶体交换谜题：方向指令会把玩家与同行最近晶体互换，只有射线上无晶体时才能普通移动，目标是让 16 个晶体归位并通过出口。作者给出 93 条指令的解，并以带成本上界的精确广度优先搜索排除所有更短解，状态编码只需 17 个占据位置和玩家位置。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 将非局部交换规则转成有限状态最短路，并同时给出构造解与最优性证明。

entries.paper_review: 不只找到解，还用穷举搜索证明指令数最小。

entries.source_title: The domination number of the $k$-token graph of the complete bipartite graph $K_{m,n}$
entries.source_excerpt: This paper is about token graphs and domination number. Let $G=(X,E)$ denote an undirected graph that is connected, with no loops or multiple edges, vertex set $X$, and edge set $E$. Pick a positive integer $k\leq \vert X\vert$. The $k$-token graph of $G$, denoted by $F_k(G)$, is defined as follows. The vertex set $\mathcal{X}$ consists of all $k$-subsets of $X$. Two vertices $x,y\in \mathcal{X}$ are adjacent whenever the symmetric difference of $x$ and $y$ consists of two vertices that form an edge in $E$. In this paper, we compute the exact value for the domination number of $F_2(K_{m,n})$ where $K_{m,n}$ is the complete bipartite graph with parameters $m,n$. We present some bounds for the domination number of $F_k(K_{m,n})$ when $k\geq 3$.
entries.title_zh: 完全二部图 k-token 图的支配数
entries.summary_zh: 论文把图的顶点替换为原图的 k 元子集，当两个子集仅交换一条边的端点时连边，得到 token 图 F_k(G)。作者精确计算 F₂(K_{m,n}) 的支配数，并在 k≥3 时给出上下界；摘要没有列出闭式公式及界的具体数值。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把组合移动图上的支配问题落实到完全二部图，精确结果与高阶界可作为后续研究基线。
entries.pragmatic_review: k=2 的精确公式可直接用于相应参数实例。
entries.cynic_review: k≥3 目前是界而非完整精确刻画。
entries.paper_review: 将 token 图的支配参数细化到完全二部图族。

entries.source_title: On the Ramanujan-Ligozat modular unit
entries.source_excerpt: Let $\chi$ be the quadratic Dirichlet character of conductor $N$ associated with a given real quadratic field $k$ and let $X_\chi(N)$ be the double covering of $X_0(N)$ associated with $\chi$. In this note, we study a modular unit $f$ on the curve $X_\chi(N)$. We prove that the transform of $f$ by the Fricke involution $\mathscr{w}_N$ is the level $N$ analogue of the Rogers-Ramanujan continued fraction introduced by Lee and Park. Furthermore, if $N$ is a positive prime discriminant, then $f$ is Ligozat's modular unit, which is known from Mazur's work on the Eisenstein ideal. We extend Ligozat's construction to any positive fundamental discriminant $N$.
entries.title_zh: Ramanujan–Ligozat 模单位
entries.summary_zh: 作者研究与实二次域相关的曲线 Xχ(N) 上的模单位 f，证明其经 Fricke 对合变换后是 Lee 与 Park 提出的 Rogers–Ramanujan 连分数的 N 级推广。若 N 为正素判别式，f 恰为 Mazur Eisenstein 理论中已知的 Ligozat 模单位，并把 Ligozat 构造推广到任意正基本判别式 N。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合模曲线、模单位与连分数研究者了解经典构造的统一推广。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把 Fricke 对合、连分数和经典模单位构造联系起来。
entries.cynic_review: 属于特定模曲线与判别式设定下的构造性结果。
entries.paper_review: 结论陈述具体，函数归一化与证明需查看原文。

entries.source_title: Normal approximation for subgraph counts in random intersection graphs: the case of cliques
entries.source_excerpt: Let $X^{(r)}_n$ denote the number of copies of a complete graph $K_r$ in the random intersection graph model on $n$ vertices. We derive upper bounds on the distance between the standardized version of $X^{(r)}_n$ and the standard normal distribution, measured in both the Kolmogorov and Wasserstein metrics. We complement these results with necessary and sufficient conditions for asymptotic normality. As a byproduct, we provide precise estimates for the variance of $X^{(r)}_n$. In the process, we develop new general techniques for analysing so--called clique covers, which play a crucial role in the study of subgraph probabilities in random intersection graphs.
entries.title_zh: 随机交图团计数的正态近似
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究随机交图中 r 团数量 X_n^(r) 的渐近分布，给出标准化计数到标准正态的 Kolmogorov 与 Wasserstein 距离上界，并给出渐近正态成立的充要条件。过程中还得到团计数方差的精确估计，并发展分析团覆盖的新技术。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 同时刻画团计数的误差率、正态性条件和方差，完善随机交图局部结构理论。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适用于随机网络中团数量的统计近似和参数分析。
entries.cynic_review: 渐近正态性受模型参数区间制约，使用时要核对充要条件。
entries.paper_review: 给出双度量误差控制与正态性的必要充分刻画。
