entries.source_title: Africa-Papers: A 10-Billion-Token Multi-Domain Academic Corpus for African Foundation Language Models
entries.source_excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) depend fundamentally on the diversity, depth, and factual rigor of their pre-training corpora. However, contemporary foundational pre-training datasets (such as The Pile, S2ORC, and Dolma) exhibit a severe structural omission: African scientific, medical, legal, and agricultural scholarship constitutes less than 0.5% of global pre-training tokens. Consequently, state-of-the-art models suffer from systematic failure modes when reasoning about tropical epidemiology, localized smallholder agro-ecologies, regional economic governance, and indigenous linguistic structures. To resolve this representation deficit and advance African intellectual sovereignty in artificial intelligence, we introduce Africa-Papers, the largest curated multi-domain Pan-African academic pre-training corpus to date. Comprising over 844,807 full-text papers spanning 10.15 billion tokens across 879 Parquet shards, Africa-Papers unifies four primary scientific streams: (1) continental peer-reviewed journals indexed in DOAJ across 31 African nations, (2) the CGIAR CGSpace agricultural repository, (3) African-authored and African-focused ST
entries.title_zh: Africa-Papers：面向非洲基础模型的百亿 token 多领域学术语料
entries.summary_zh: 作者指出主流预训练语料中非洲科学、医学、法律与农业研究占比不足，导致模型在热带流行病学、小农农业生态、区域治理和本土语言等场景出现系统性缺口。Africa-Papers 被介绍为经整理的多领域学术语料，规模达 100 亿 token，目标是提升非洲知识在基础模型训练中的代表性与学术自主性；数据来源、许可和质量需按数据集说明核查。

entries.source_title: The Navier-Stokes Announcement: A case study in mathematical values
entries.source_excerpt: On September 8, 2026, OpenAI announced a resolution of the Navier-Stokes problem. I had expected to feel excitement if a solution was announced. Instead, my reaction was one of grief and revulsion. I will use the announcement to explore the universal human desires that underlie my reaction, I hope in a fashion that will reach beyond mathematicians.

entries.source_title: Metric Poissonian Pair Correlation Property Part 2: The Case \(n\log n\)
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that $(\alpha n\log n)_{n\ge1}$ has Poissonian pair correlation for almost every real $\alpha$, solving a Problem posed by Aistleitner, El-Baz and Munsch [Open Problem 3, Geom. Funct. Anal. 2021]. Our main contribution is a new four-point counting estimate with a fixed power saving over $N^{7/3}$ at tolerance $N^{-1}$, valid on the ranges left after a first-moment and Borel--Cantelli argument. Its proof reduces the counting condition to the required proximity of an implicitly defined real root to an integer; a Fej\'er kernel majorizes this condition, and multidimensional van der Corput $A$- and $B$-processes supply the saving. A localized Mellin argument then yields the second-moment estimate needed for the metric conclusion.
entries.title_zh: 度量 Poisson 配对相关性（二）：αn log n 序列
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明，对几乎所有实数 α，序列 (α n log n) 的 Poissonian pair correlation 成立，从而解决 Aistleitner、El-Baz 与 Munsch 2021 年提出的开放问题。证明关键是建立四点计数估计，在 N^(7/3) 上取得固定幂次节省，再用 Fejér 核、多维 van der Corput A/B 过程和局部 Mellin 方法得到所需二阶矩估计。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究均匀分布与数论序列局部统计的读者，展示四点计数如何导出几乎处处的配对相关结论。

entries.source_title: General function bases moment models for suspended sediment with vertical profile of concentration
entries.source_excerpt: We introduce a general hydrostatic shallow moment framework for suspended sediment transport with vertically varying horizontal velocity and concentration profiles. The formulation is constructed over arbitrary vertical functional bases that are numerically orthogonalised via the Gram-Schmidt algorithm. This approach allows the approximation spaces for the vertical profile to be adapted to the specific structure of each physical variable, where also the velocity and sediment concentration can be projected onto different functional spaces. To overcome the limitations due to the inherent oscillatory nature of global Legendre polynomials, we explore a specific continuous piecewise linear $\mathbb{P}_1$ finite-element basis. Furthermore, non-uniform vertical partitions are considered, enabling an enhanced representation of the vertical profiles in specific regions. Numerical experiments involving boundary layers and suspended sediment transport demonstrate that the proposed framework is accurate to reproduce the expected vertical profiles. entries.source_title: Letter to a worried student
entries.source_excerpt: I don't know how it will all turn out, so I certainly can't promise you anything. But I do know that “understanding” is a human activity — something computers cannot do for us (even if they solve problems better than we do, it serves no purpose unless there are humans who actually understand).
entries.title_zh: 写给一位忧虑的学生
entries.summary_zh: 作者承认无法保证未来如何发展，但强调“理解”是人的活动：即便计算机能更好地解题，若没有人真正理解，结果也失去意义。文章以安慰学生的书信方式讨论数学学习和 AI 能力之间的关系，属于观点表达而非经验研究。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合正在面对 AI 与数学学习焦虑的学生和导师。
entries.pragmatic_review: 用简洁观点区分问题求解能力与人的理解活动。
entries.cynic_review: 哲学立场具有启发性，但不构成对 AI 能力的实证判断。
entries.paper_review: 摘录短，作者论证和建议需读全文。

entries.source_title: From Stories to Features: Scaling Concept Vectors for AI Alignment & Interpretability
entries.source_excerpt: We study feature vectors: directions in a language model's activation space that correspond to human-interpretable concepts, such as honesty or deception. Existing unsupervised methods like sparse autoencoders attempt to recover the whole feature space, often at the cost of feature quality and interpretability. We take a more pragmatic route: focusing on concepts relevant to AI safety and alignment, we generate synthetic concept-antagonist story pairs and use the difference of their mean model activations as a feature vector. We scale this approach to 1,036 alignment-relevant concepts using 2M synthetic stories across multiple languages and genres, which we publicly release. Across six models from three model families, our feature vectors reliably generalize to detecting their corresponding concepts in chat dialogues and web text. They form an interpretable geometry shared across models and can causally steer model behavior when injected into activations. We further use these features to analyze model representations during jailbreak attacks, mathematical and agentic reasoning. Our targeted feature construction thus offers a scalable
entries.title_zh: 从故事到特征：扩展用于 AI 对齐与可解释性的概念向量
entries.summary_zh: 作者用合成的“概念—反概念”故事对比模型平均激活，构造表示诚实、欺骗等概念的方向向量；规模扩展至 1036 个概念、200 万条多语言多体裁故事，并公开数据。跨三个模型家族的六个模型实验显示这些向量可检测对话/网页文本中的相应概念，也能因果性地引导模型行为；作者还用它们分析 jailbreak、数学和 agent 推理。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合可解释性、对齐机制和激活干预研究者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 以定向构造替代恢复整个特征空间，并同时测试检测与干预。
entries.cynic_review: 概念真实性受合成故事和标注定义影响，干预也可能改变无关行为。
entries.paper_review: 数据规模、模型数量和用途均有交代，独立复现重要。

entries.source_title: The Power of Beauty and Elegance
entries.source_excerpt: What machines have: colossal knowledge and massive compute power. What humans have: intuition for beauty and elegance. The ultimate question is whether colossal knowledge and massive compute power wins over human intuition. If no, we only face some big changes. If yes, then human mathematics will degrade into exotic art.
entries.title_zh: 美与优雅的力量
entries.summary_zh: Márton Balázs 对比大模型广博知识与算力、以及人类数学家对美与优雅的直觉，认为这种审美曾帮助研究者从庞大可能性中挑选值得追求的构造与定理。他把“机器搜索与组合能否在所有领域取代人的审美引导”视为核心问题，并提出自己的判断；文章属于研究观念评论，不是对 AI 能力的系统实验。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 讨论在模型搜索能力增长时，数学审美如何继续承担筛选研究方向的作用。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可引导关于数学研究品味、目标选择与 AI 协作的讨论。
entries.cynic_review: 审美优势是作者提出的判断，尚非可量化的普遍比较结论。
entries.paper_review: 重点在研究价值观和方法论思考。

entries.source_title: A note on functional non-central limit theorem for periodic regime-switching stable-like processes
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we establish a functional non-central limit theorem for regime-switching stable-like processes with periodic coefficients. Our approach relies on stochastic analysis methods, in particular semimartingale characteristics, combined with the ergodic theory of Markov processes. If the set on which the order function achieves its minimum value $\underline{\alpha}$ has positive Lebesgue measure, then the limit is a rotationally invariant $\underline{\alpha}$-stable L\'evy process. Otherwise, the limit is the zero process.
entries.title_zh: 周期状态切换稳定型过程的函数型非中心极限定理
entries.summary_zh: 论文结合半鞅特征与 Markov 过程遍历理论，研究周期系数状态切换稳定型过程的缩放极限。摘要称阶函数取最小值的集合若有正测度，极限为相应指数的旋转不变稳定 Lévy 过程；否则为零过程。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合异常扩散与随机环境的极限理论。
entries.pragmatic_review: 刻画不同微观区域如何主导宏观极限。
entries.cynic_review: 极限类型取决于最小值集合的测度。
entries.paper_review: 非高斯极限与退化极限形成条件分界。

entries.source_title: TinyFish Makes Search Free: What It Really Costs an AI Agent to Read the Web
entries.title_zh: TinyFish 搜索成本：AI 代理读取网页究竟要花多少
entries.summary_zh: 当前 bundle 只提供 MarkTechPost 的标题，没有正文摘录、成本数字或测算方法，因此无法确认 TinyFish 所谓“免费搜索”由谁承担成本，也不能据标题推导代理读取网页的真实费用。可将它列为网页检索代理成本分析的待读材料，阅读全文时重点核对计价口径、失败率和网页类型。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 网页搜索成本会直接影响代理规模化使用，值得追踪，但目前证据不足以支持结论。
entries.pragmatic_review: 若有透明的单位成本测算，会帮助选型和预算。
entries.cynic_review: “免费”可能只是价格包装，需看成本转移与限制条件。
entries.paper_review: 没有正文和测量数据，不能验证标题中的成本判断。

entries.source_title: Atomic limits of empirical measures of interacting particle systems with self-duality
entries.source_excerpt: Authors: Mario Ayala , Nicolas Dirr , Johannes Zimmer; Subjects: Probability (math.PR) ; Statistical Mechanics (cond-mat.stat-mech); Mathematical Physics (math-ph); This listing provides paper metadata; open the original for the abstract.
entries.title_zh: 固定粒子数相互作用系统经验测度的原子极限
entries.summary_zh: 论文对独立游走、对称排斥和对称吸引过程，在固定 k 粒子扩散缩放下证明经验测度收敛到 k 个独立扩散的原子测度。自对偶性和两粒子 Green 函数估计说明近碰撞贡献消失；该固定粒子结论不同于密度随规模增长的流体极限。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合粒子系统、自对偶与 Dean–Kawasaki 方程研究。
entries.pragmatic_review: 提供相互作用何时在极限消失的例子。
entries.cynic_review: 固定 k 的尺度限定至关重要。
entries.paper_review: 统一证明展示三类过程共享原子极限。

entries.source_title: Galois Groups of Trinomials with Small Coefficients
entries.source_excerpt: We calculate the Galois group of $f = x^n + ax^k + b \in \mathbb{Z}\left[ x \right]$ over $\mathbb{Q}$ for all $1 \leq \left| ab \right| \leq 3$, $n$ sufficiently large and $k$ coprime to $n$. In particular, we prove that the Galois group of $f$ is the maximal one that its factorization type allows. We do it by proving a new sufficient condition for the Galois group of a factor of a trinomial to be symmetric, which perhaps can be used to derive stronger results of this kind in the future.
entries.title_zh: 小系数三项式的伽罗瓦群
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究 f=xⁿ+a xᵏ+b∈Z[x]，在 1≤|ab|≤3、n 充分大且 k 与 n 互素时，计算其在 Q 上的伽罗瓦群。作者证明该群达到由多项式因式分解类型所允许的最大群，并为三项式因子的伽罗瓦群为对称群给出新的充分条件；摘要称这一条件或可用于进一步推广。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合代数数论读者了解小系数稀疏多项式的伽罗瓦群何时达到分解类型允许的上限。
entries.pragmatic_review: 明确的参数范围为后续验证其他系数与指数情形提供参照。
entries.cynic_review: 结果局限于小 |ab|、互素指数和充分大 n。
entries.paper_review: 摘要陈述主范围与关键充分条件，但具体例外和阈值需读论文。

entries.source_title: General Criterion for a Poset to Admit a Partition Into $\omega$-Chains
entries.source_excerpt: Given a poset $P$ with no maximal element the question naturally arises of when $P$ can be partitioned into $\omega$-chains. In this paper we give general criterion for when this can be done. We show that in the case when a poset with no maximal element is countable or a well-founded forest, then it can always be partitioned into $\omega$-chains. We then introduce the lifting property for posets with no maximal element and show that a poset can be partitioned into $\omega$-chains if and only if it has the lifting property.
entries.title_zh: 偏序集划分为 ω 链的一般判据
entries.summary_zh: 论文讨论没有极大元的偏序集何时可划分成若干条序型为 ω 的链。作者证明可数偏序集及良基森林都可如此划分，并提出 lifting property，进而证明任意无极大元偏序集可划分为 ω 链，当且仅当它满足该性质。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 将偏序链分解问题归结为一个必要且充分的结构性质。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可作为偏序分解和序理论问题的通用判别工具。
entries.cynic_review: lifting property 的使用价值取决于在具体偏序中能否容易验证。
entries.paper_review: 既给出典型类别的存在性，也给出一般充要条件。

entries.source_title: Conditional Reflected Backward Stochastic Differential Equations
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we introduce a new type of reflected backward stochastic differential equations (reflected BSDEs), referred to as conditional reflected BSDEs, in which the conditional expectation of the Y-component of the solution with respect to a given sub-{\sigma}-algebra appears in both the generator and the obstacle. Under a Lipschitz condition on the loss function with sufficiently small Lipschitz constants, we establish the existence and uniqueness of the solution for both the case of Lipschitz generator and the case of quadratic generator, bounded terminal value and bounded loss function. When the generator has quadratic growth and the terminal value and loss function are unbounded, we establish the uniqueness with the help of {\theta}-method. Finally, a penalization approximation scheme holds under an additional monotonicity structure imposed on the generator and the loss function, without any restriction on the Lipschitz constants of the loss function.
entries.title_zh: 条件反射型倒向随机微分方程
entries.summary_zh: 论文定义条件反射 BSDE：解的 Y 分量对指定子 σ-代数的条件期望同时进入生成元和障碍。对足够小 Lipschitz 常数的损失函数，作者证明 Lipschitz 及二次生成元情形的解存在唯一；终值和损失无界、生成元为二次增长时，则用 θ 方法证明唯一性。另在生成元与损失函数满足单调结构时建立惩罚逼近，而不再限制损失函数的 Lipschitz 常数。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把条件期望反馈纳入反射 BSDE，并分别处理有界与无界设定下的适定性。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于带条件信息约束的随机最优停止或风险控制建模。
entries.cynic_review: 部分存在性结果要求小 Lipschitz 常数，惩罚逼近另需单调条件。
entries.paper_review: 对不同增长条件分别给出存在唯一性与逼近结论。

entries.source_title: FairStress: A deeper evaluation of fairness in LLM decision-making
entries.title_zh: FairStress：更深入评估大语言模型决策公平性的基准
entries.summary_zh: Ai2 发布 FairStress 基准，评估模型在招聘、借贷、医疗、教育和住房等高影响决策中是否公平，关注点超出最终选谁，还检查模型如何推理与给出理由。项目提供数据和代码，并计划接入 Olmo-eval；目前这是评测工具发布，不能单独证明现实部署中的公平性。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究 LLM 公平性评测的团队，尤其是想区分决策结果与决策过程的研究者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 补充传统身份互换基准对过程层面的覆盖。
entries.cynic_review: 基准表现不等同于现实社会中的公平保障，需审查场景覆盖。
entries.paper_review: 公开数据与工具降低复现实验门槛，指标效度仍需外部检验。

entries.source_title: On-Policy Transition Distillation
entries.source_excerpt: On-policy distillation (OPD) consolidates expert capabilities into a single student by matching teacher and student final-layer distributions on student-generated rollouts. We investigate whether depthwise prediction transitions, the changes in predictions between layers, can provide additional task-relevant supervision. Our diagnostic study finds that stronger teacher--student agreement in intermediate transitions is associated with higher answer correctness within questions, with correct responses exhibiting lower mean transition KL across all measured intermediate layer pairs. These observations motivate On-Policy Transition Distillation (OPTD), which augments final-layer distribution matching by aligning teacher and student layer-to-layer log-probability increments on student-generated rollouts. Evaluations across three backbones and eight benchmarks spanning mathematics, coding, and instruction following show that OPTD achieves the best or tied-best overall performance in both dual- and three-domain distillation. entries.title_zh: 在线策略转移蒸馏
entries.summary_zh: 在线策略蒸馏通常在学生生成的轨迹上匹配师生最终层分布；论文研究各层预测变化能否补充有用监督。诊断结果显示，在题目内部，师生中间层转移越一致的回答往往越正确，正确回答在测量的层对上具有更低平均转移 KL；据此提出 OPTD，在最终层分布匹配外增加层间对数概率转移对齐。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把隐藏层逐步形成预测的过程纳入蒸馏，而不只匹配最终输出分布。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合希望保留专家推理行为而不只复制最终答案的模型训练。
entries.cynic_review: 层间 KL 与正确率的关联不自动证明蒸馏对齐会带来因果提升。
entries.paper_review: 先用过程诊断支持设计，再提出对应蒸馏目标。

entries.source_title: A Structure-Preserving Scheme for Computing the Gradient of the Eikonal Equation
entries.source_excerpt: We propose a first-order, structure-preserving method for directly computing the normalized traveltime gradient of the eikonal equation in smooth first-arrival regions. The method combines analytical derivatives of spherical linear interpolation (SLERP) in a Godunov-type upwind discretization with spherical forward Euler (SFE) pseudo-time integration. This construction gives a tangent residual and keeps every iterate on $\mathbb{S}^2$ without projection or normalization. The SLERP discretization exactly preserves a family of curved orientation equilibria. Removing the background discretization bias improves absolute orientation accuracy near these equilibria, allowing a prescribed error tolerance to be reached on a coarser grid. We prove the equilibrium-preservation property and, separately, a smaller angular error for SFE than normalized Euler in a one-cell relaxation under the stated step-size condition. Two- and three-dimensional experiments examine convergence, geometric preservation, and computational cost. Comparisons with gradient recovery from scalar traveltimes show more accurate directions on the same grid in the curved medi
entries.title_zh: 保结构计算程函方程的梯度
entries.summary_zh: 论文提出在光滑首达区域直接计算程函方程归一化旅行时梯度的一阶方法：在 Godunov 型迎风离散中使用球面线性插值导数，再用球面前向 Euler 伪时间积分，使每次迭代都留在单位球面上，无需投影或归一化。作者证明该方案精确保持一族弯曲方向平衡态，并分析球面 Euler 的角误差；二维、三维实验显示，在所测弯曲介质中，同网格方向精度优于从标量旅行时恢复梯度的方法。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 通过把方向变量的球面几何嵌入离散和时间推进，减少弯曲介质中的方向误差。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于波传播、几何光学及伴随反演中的方向场计算。
entries.cynic_review: 精度优势由特定平衡态分析及所报告数值实验支持，适用性需看网格与介质条件。
entries.paper_review: 保结构性质有理论证明，并配有二三维数值比较。

entries.source_title: Openbroca — Lightweight AI dictation for Mac that sounds like you
entries.source_excerpt: Lightweight AI dictation for Mac that sounds like you
entries.title_zh: Openbroca：面向 Mac 的轻量 AI 听写，主打保留个人表达风格
entries.summary_zh: Product Hunt 将 Openbroca 描述为 Mac 上轻量的 AI 听写工具，强调转写结果听起来像用户本人。现有材料没有解释它如何学习风格、是否本地处理、支持哪些语言或如何保护录音；实际评价需检查转写准确度和数据处理方式。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合需要语音转写并在意口吻保留的 Mac 用户关注，尤其应核验隐私与本地运行能力。
entries.pragmatic_review: 若能稳定保留个人语气，可能减少口述后改稿时间。
entries.cynic_review: “像你”是主张，材料没有说明训练数据或隐私设计。
entries.paper_review: 没有准确率、语言覆盖或用户测试证据。

entries.source_title: On disclosure and shame
entries.source_excerpt: “The arXiv is full of papers now that include a section, usually either after the acknowledgments or at the end of the paper, entitled ‘AI disclosure’. I strongly object to this phrase and I think it is a tremendous mistake to use it. […]”
entries.title_zh: 关于 AI 使用披露与羞耻感
entries.summary_zh: Max Lieblich 认为 AI disclosure 的说法可能暗示羞耻或利益冲突，从而促使年轻研究者隐瞒工具使用，建议改称 AI contributions 并具体描述贡献。作者还提出按贡献大小考虑致谢或共同署名；这是对学术规范的主张，尚不代表期刊或数学界共识。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 有助于讨论如何透明记录 AI 贡献而不制造污名。
entries.pragmatic_review: 贡献描述比单一使用声明更具体。
entries.cynic_review: 模型署名还涉及责任与出版规则。
entries.paper_review: 可与作者资格标准和可重复性要求比较。

entries.source_title: Gaussian Lower Bounds for Distinct Subset Sums in Higher Dimensions
entries.source_excerpt: For sequences of $n$ nonnegative integer vectors in $\mathbb Z^k$ with distinct subset sums, we prove, for fixed $k$, the uniform lower bound $M\ge (C_k-o(1))2^{n/k}/\sqrt n$ for the largest coordinate, where \[ C_k=\sqrt{\frac{2k}{\pi}}\, \frac{(k+1)^{(k-1)/(2k)}}{\sqrt{\lfloor (k+1)^2/4\rfloor}}. \] The proof compares a Gaussian-kernel expectation with a sum over a translated lattice, uniformly over the vector sequence. We optimise the resulting quadratic-form constant using a vertex second-moment certificate. We show that $C_k$ also exceeds the variance constant obtained by optimising an ellipsoidal geometry.
entries.title_zh: 高维不同子集和的高斯型下界
entries.summary_zh: 论文考虑 Z^k 中 n 个非负整数向量，其所有子集和互异，并为最大坐标 M 给出固定维数 k 下的一致渐近下界 M≥(C_k−o(1))2^(n/k)/√n。证明通过高斯核期望与平移格点和比较，并用二次型顶点二阶矩证书优化常数；所得 C_k 还超过椭球几何优化给出的方差常数。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把经典不同子集和问题推广到固定高维，并给出显式维数相关常数。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合加性组合学与离散概率中的向量子集和界研究。
entries.cynic_review: 下界针对固定 k 渐近 n，有限维数或变维情形需谨慎。
entries.paper_review: 给出渐近量级并改进常数优化方法。

entries.source_title: Quasi-Monte Carlo based meshfree methods for parabolic equations on parameterized Riemannian manifolds
entries.source_excerpt: We develop and analyze a randomized path sampling framework for the pointwise approximation of linear parabolic equations on parameterized Riemannian manifolds, treating both closed manifolds and manifolds with Dirichlet boundary. Based on the Feynman-Kac representation, we construct a parameter-coordinate retraction-based discretization, referred to as the p-Ret scheme, for the manifold diffusion generated by the uniformly elliptic operator, and use it to formulate the Monte Carlo (MC) and randomized quasi-Monte Carlo (RQMC) methods. We derive the local weak consistency of the p-Ret transition and first-order weak convergence of the temporal discretization on closed manifolds. For fixed $h$, we show that RQMC sampling yields asymptotically faster variance decay than standard MC. On closed manifolds, the variance is $o(n^{-1})$ and, under additional regularity, satisfies the sharper bound $O(n^{-2+\varepsilon})$ for any $\varepsilon>0$. For Dirichlet problems, despite the discontinuities induced by numerical first exit, nested-uniformly scrambled Sobol' sampling attains $O(n^{-1-1/s+\varepsilon})$ variance for any $\varepsilon>0$ unde
entries.title_zh: 参数化黎曼流形上抛物方程的准蒙特卡洛无网格方法
entries.summary_zh: 作者基于 Feynman–Kac 表示，对参数化黎曼流形上的线性抛物方程构造重traction 离散，并发展 Monte Carlo 与随机准 Monte Carlo 路径采样。闭流形上证明时间离散一阶弱收敛；固定步长时，RQMC 方差优于 MC，闭流形可达 o(n⁻¹)，附加正则性下达到 O(n⁻²⁺ε)，带 Dirichlet 边界的问题也给出受首出不连续影响后的方差率。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合流形 PDE 与随机数值方法读者，关注避免网格剖分的点值近似。
entries.pragmatic_review: 理论覆盖闭流形和边界问题，并量化随机采样收敛。
entries.cynic_review: 几何参数化、边界首出处理和正则性要求限制直接套用。
entries.paper_review: 给出误差阶和适用情形，算法成本与维数效应需看全文。

entries.source_title: A Reverse-Gold Theorem: Positive-Data Identification by Substrate-Bounded Contrastive Learners
entries.source_excerpt: Gold's theorem shows that no learner can identify an arbitrary language in a superfinite class from positive presentations alone. We prove a positive result of a different shape. Fix an innate \emph{recursive contrast operator} $R$ mapping any string to a finite set of structurally bounded perturbations of it, and a discriminative scorer of bounded capacity trained by InfoNCE-style contrastive estimation \citep{vandenoord2018,macollins2018} on self-generated perturbations. Under a faithfulness condition relating operator, scorer, and target, the trained scorer achieves \emph{PAC conditional identification} from positive data alone: with high probability it ranks all but an $\varepsilon$-fraction of positives above every out-of-language perturbation in their own orbit, with sample complexity polynomial in the capacity, the orbit size, the score bound, and $1/\varepsilon$. The negatives are constructed by the learner, not supplied by an oracle, and no global normalizing constant over strings is ever computed. The misranking bound follows from the geometry of the contrastive loss---per-example loss floors plus a definite loss increment
entries.title_zh: 反向 Gold 定理：有界底层对比学习者的正数据识别
entries.summary_zh: Gold 定理指出，超有限语言类一般不能仅凭正例展示被识别；本文给出形状不同的正面结果。若学习者拥有递归对比算子，可对输入字符串生成结构受限扰动，并用有限容量判别器通过 InfoNCE 式对比训练，在算子、判别器与目标语言满足忠实性条件时，就能仅凭正数据实现 PAC 条件识别，样本复杂度随容量、扰动轨道大小和误差参数多项式增长。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 刻画先天结构对比机制如何改变正数据语言识别的可能性边界。
entries.pragmatic_review: 为结构化语言学习和对比式识别提供理论条件。
entries.cynic_review: 正结果依赖预设递归扰动算子及忠实性假设，并未推翻 Gold 的一般不可能性。
entries.paper_review: 在经典不可能性旁建立带明确结构假设的 PAC 正结果。

entries.source_title: OpenAI partially disproves Littlewood's 1961 $L^α$-flat theorem
entries.source_excerpt: We present a counterexample, produced by OpenAI, to Littlewood's 1961 theorem on $L^\alpha$-flat polynomials. The theorem asserts that no $L^\alpha$-flat polynomials exist within the class of trigonometric polynomials of the form$$\sum_{m=1}^{n} a_m \cos(m\theta+\alpha_m), \qquad n \in \mathbb{N}^*,$$satisfying$$k\, n^2 \sum_{m=1}^{n} a_m^2 \;\leq\; \sum_{m=1}^{n} m^2 a_m^2,$$where $k$ is an absolute constant (alternatively expressed on the right-hand side as $K = 1/k$). We show that OpenAI's counterexample is contained within the class of hyper-lacunary sequences. Consequently, it offers only a limited refutation, as such sequences fail to satisfy an implicit assumption of Littlewood's theorem. We also discuss broader questions surrounding this counterexample and provide a brief historical overview.
entries.title_zh: OpenAI 对 Littlewood 平坦多项式定理的部分反例
entries.summary_zh: 论文讨论 OpenAI 给出的三角多项式反例及其与 Littlewood 1961 年 Lα 平坦性定理的关系。摘要认为该反例属于超稀疏序列，未满足原定理的一个隐含假设，因此反驳范围有限；这是作者对定理适用条件的分析，不能简化为整条经典定理被推翻。

entries.cynic_review: 部分反例与全面推翻有本质差别。

entries.source_title: Cortex: A Fixed-Point Theory of Governed Coding Agents - Technical Report
entries.source_excerpt: A coding agent combines a large language model (LLM) with a harness that plans, edits, and executes code. We study Cortex, a supervisory layer for pre-execution governance, requirement tracking, and iterative validation and repair. We formalize requirement closure on a finite lattice. For a fixed requirement set and a sound, monotone validation rule with persistent evidence, exhaustive iteration reaches the least fixed point with no more strict increases than there are requirements. Fair consequence scheduling reaches the same closure. A separate stochastic model bounds expected completion time under a uniform positive-progress assumption. These results depend on their stated assumptions; artifact repair, fallible validation, and finite execution budgets do not satisfy them automatically. We define Gauntlet's trajectory-similarity and build-gated scores, attack-success estimators, Wilson intervals, and case-cluster bootstrap summaries. Effective-feedback accounting counts newly certified requirements, rather than estimating their information value or utility. The five evaluation families support raw-versus-governed comparisons. entries.title_zh: Cortex：治理编码智能体的一个不动点理论
entries.summary_zh: Cortex 作为代码执行前监督层，追踪需求并迭代验证修复；论文把需求闭包形式化为有限格，证明在验证规则可靠、单调且证据持久时，穷举迭代会在严格增长次数不超过需求数的情况下到达最小不动点。作者也定义 trajectory-similarity、build-gated 等评估指标，但明确指出错误验证、修复失败及执行预算会破坏理论假设。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合设计编码 agent 前置策略治理与需求验证流程的工程团队。

entries.cynic_review: 理论假设严格，真实工具链中的验证器常不可靠。
entries.paper_review: 摘要明确区分形式化保证、随机模型与实际系统限制。

entries.source_title: Classification of bipartite observables I: stable and uniformly stable observables
entries.source_excerpt: When two quantum systems are prepared independently and each is driven to an idealized limit, the expectation of a bipartite observable may depend on which system is idealized first. We call an observable stable when it does not. We show that stability is equivalent to two operational properties. First, every idealized preparation of one system can be simulated to arbitrary accuracy, uniformly over all probes, by finite mixtures of actual preparations, provided that the probing system is idealized first. Second, any two idealized preparations have a unique, symmetric independent product. Under a uniform form of stability, we prove, the number of preparations that $n$ adaptive probes can tell apart at a fixed margin is bounded by a polynomial in $n$, and responses can be learned with a bounded number of mistakes; otherwise, at some margin, protocols with $n$ probes tell apart $2^n$ preparations. The swap test, Hong--Ou--Mandel coincidences and discrete equality tests turn out to be uniformly stable, with bounds independent of the dimension, while order comparisons of discrete spectra unbounded above are unstable. entries.title_zh: 二部观测量分类 I：稳定与一致稳定观测量
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究两个量子系统分别取理想化极限时，二部观测量的期望值是否依赖先理想化哪一方，并把这种次序无关性定义为稳定性。作者证明稳定性等价于两项操作性质：理想制备可由有限实际制备的混合一致近似，且任意两个理想制备有唯一、对称的独立乘积；一致稳定时，n 次自适应探测能区分的制备数在固定误差下至多多项式增长，否则某个误差尺度下可达 2^n。交换测试、Hong–Ou–Mandel 计数及离散相等测试被证明一致稳定，而无界离散谱的顺序比较不稳定。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合数学物理与量子信息读者，文章把抽象稳定性转化为可操作的模拟性与探测复杂度结论。
entries.pragmatic_review: 探测复杂度的多项式／指数差异有助于理解哪些观测任务可有效学习。
entries.cynic_review: 结论依赖理想化制备和固定间隔等形式假设。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出等价刻画、复杂度界及典型例子，理论证明需阅读全文核对。

entries.source_title: Reflections on Trusting Lean
entries.source_excerpt: It is known, by works of Werner and Carneiro, that the type theory of Lean (and indeed of CIC plus a version of choice) is equiconsistent with ZFC plus "there are infinitely many strongly inaccessible cardinals". We prove a finer connection between these two formal systems; namely, given any formula in the language of second order arithmetic, that formula is provable in the aforementioned extension of ZFC if and only if the same formula, when viewed as a type in Lean, is inhabited.
entries.title_zh: 关于信任 Lean：与强集合论的更细对应
entries.summary_zh: 在既有 Lean 类型论与 ZFC 加无穷多个强不可达基数等一致性结果基础上，论文声称对每个二阶算术公式，集合论扩展中可证明当且仅当其 Lean 类型有项。它讨论形式系统间的证明能力，不是无条件证明 Lean 或集合论一致。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合理解证明助手的逻辑基础与信任边界。
entries.pragmatic_review: 有助于区分内核检查与基础公理。
entries.cynic_review: 相对证明能力不能消除一致性假设。
entries.paper_review: 二阶算术层面的等价强于单纯等一致性。

project_insight.limitations_zh: Codeberg 页面是只读镜像，维护、问题反馈、发布和容器镜像均已迁移到 git.b4mad.industries。服务需要 Forgejo 实例和访问令牌；HTTP 远程部署涉及主机、来源和认证配置。所给摘录未显示许可证信息，不能据此判断具体许可条款。

entries.source_title: Doing Less with More: A First-Principles Exploration of the Suitability of Agentic Computing over Alternative Architectural Choices
entries.source_excerpt: There is growing interest in automating business activities with Agentic Artificial Intelligence (AI) due to latter's seeming ease of use. Never has it been easier, or costlier, to do less with more. However, little is known about when agents are preferable to established alternatives such as local computation, Representational State Transfer (REST), the Simple Object Access Protocol (SOAP), and the Model Context Protocol (MCP), particularly when development speed, performance, and operational cost are considered. We investigate this question using a controlled mathematical task that compares seven methods on a benchmark of 1,000 arithmetic expressions where semantics of operator precedence has to be preserved. entries.title_zh: 多做反而少得：从第一原理比较智能体计算与替代架构
entries.summary_zh: 论文用 1000 道需遵守运算优先级的算术任务，比较本地确定性计算、REST/SOAP/MCP、云端 LLM 和调用 MCP 工具的 agent，评估正确率、开发速度、性能和成本。摘录已显示确定性方案达到 100% 准确率且延迟可忽略，直接 LLM 最高 92.9%；其余 agent 比较结果未随摘录提供，因此不能概括 agent 的相对收益。

entries.source_title: Numerical Analysis for a Nonlinear Coupled Thermoelastic System with Acoustic Boundary Conditions
entries.source_excerpt: This paper presents the first $L^2$-norm error analysis for a nonlinear thermoelastic system with acoustic boundary conditions. The model involves three coupled variables: the acoustic potential $u$, the temperature $\theta$, and the normal displacement to the boundary $\delta$, with nonlinearities $|u|^d u$ in the domain and $g(\cdot,u')$ on the boundary, in addition to a nonlocal term $\beta(\int_\Omega\theta dx)\Delta\theta$ in the heat equation. We establish error estimates for the fully discrete problem, using the Crank-Nicolson method for time discretization and finite element method with basis of degree $r \geqslant 1$ for space discretization. We demonstrate that the domain-boundary coupling induces a half-power loss in the spatial convergence order for the variable $u$, and this effect propagates to the remaining variables due to the thermoelastic and boundary couplings, resulting in the final error estimate $\mathcal{O}(h^{r+\frac{1}{2}} + \tau^2)$. entries.title_zh: 带声学边界条件的非线性耦合热弹性系统数值分析
entries.summary_zh: 论文给出含声学势、温度和边界法向位移的非线性热弹性系统首个 L² 误差分析，采用 Crank–Nicolson 时间离散和 r 阶有限元。域—边界耦合使声学变量空间收敛阶损失半阶，并传递到其他变量，最终误差为 O(h^{r+1/2}+τ²)；bootstrap 论证用于控制非线性所需的离散 L∞ 界。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合耦合声学、热传导与弹性 PDE 的有限元研究者。

entries.paper_review: 摘要给出了误差阶、时间格式和关键稳定性论证。

We recall the definitions and main statements, and add two things. entries.title_zh: Ulrich 问题与小 Cohen–Macaulay 猜想近期反例综述及高维推广
entries.summary_zh: 这篇综述整理 2026 年若干预印本对 Ulrich 问题与 Hochster 小 Cohen–Macaulay 猜想的反例，并指出若干障碍可由一个方差恒等式统一理解。作者进一步推广 OpenAI 10 月 6 日稿件中的论证，证明若光滑复 m 维簇 (X,H) 的完备截面环存在小 Cohen–Macaulay 模，则 (K_X²−2c₂(X))·H^(m−2)≤(m+4)H^m；据此给出各维 Hesse 对及其与射影空间乘积的无此类模结论。综述区分了已发表工作、预印本和作者提出的推广，相关结果仍需按原论文核对。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 帮助读者把几项近期反例串联成共同数值障碍，并提供高维推广的可检验条件。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合作为追踪多个交叉领域预印本的路线图。

entries.paper_review: 把局部代数模问题转为高维 Chern 数不等式。

entries.source_title: Hyperwellfoundedness and Eventual Domination
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that a Borel strict partial order is an increasing union of wellfounded Borel partial orders if and only if it admits an (injective) Borel homomorphism to the eventual domination order.
entries.title_zh: 超良基性与最终支配序
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明一个 Borel 严格偏序可写成递增的良基 Borel 偏序并集，当且仅当它存在到最终支配序的单射 Borel 同态。该等价将偏序的可分层良基结构转化为经典最终支配关系中的可测嵌入判据。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把 Borel 偏序分解性质归结为到最终支配序的精确同态条件。

entries.summary_zh: 论文在 Heegner 假设、模二幂满射及上同调排除条件下，选择有限素数使两条扭曲椭圆曲线的二 Selmer 维数为零和一。随后把构造点的 Kummer 类与标准 Kolyvagin 类联系，在内在指标消失等条件下得到模二及更高二幂阶非消失。

entries.source_title: Four colours are needed for closed-neighbourhood conflict-free colouring of all planar graphs
entries.source_excerpt: A colouring of the vertices of a graph is conflict-free with respect to closed neighbourhoods if every closed neighbourhood contains a colour that appears on exactly one of its vertices. The colouring need not be proper. Every planar graph has such a colouring with four colours. Fabrici, Lu\v{z}ar, Rindo\v{s}ov\'a and Sot\'ak conjectured that three colours always suffice. We disprove this conjecture. We give a simple gadget construction that turns every planar graph of chromatic number four into a planar graph with no such colouring with three colours. This also shows that it is NP-complete to decide whether three colours suffice for a planar graph. We also give a planar graph on $25$ vertices that needs four colours. Further, we give critical planar graphs on $25$ vertices with $52$ and with $51$ edges, an infinite family of plane triangulations that need four colours, and an infinite family of critical examples.
entries.title_zh: 平面图的闭邻域冲突自由染色至少需要四种颜色
entries.summary_zh: 闭邻域冲突自由染色要求每个顶点连同其邻点的闭邻域中，至少有一种颜色恰好出现一次，且染色不必是正常图染色。论文反驳“三色总够”的猜想：证明四阶色数平面图可经简单 gadget 扩展成无法三色的平面图，并构造需要四种颜色的 25 顶点例子及若干无限临界族；同时证明判定平面图能否三色为 NP 完全。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合图论读者关注局部唯一颜色约束与平面性如何改变染色阈值及计算复杂度。
entries.pragmatic_review: 小型反例和无限族为检验相关染色猜想提供明确对象。
entries.cynic_review: 结果只针对闭邻域冲突自由条件，不能与正常色数直接等同。
entries.paper_review: 摘要同时给出反例构造与 NP 完全性，复杂度归约细节需看正文。

entries.source_title: SkillEval: Learning Interpretable Ability Profiles of LLMs via Cognitive Diagnosis Models
entries.source_excerpt: Current evaluation of LLMs on benchmarks typically aggregates performance over individual examples into a single scalar score. This approach is overly coarse and ignores the diverse scope of skills covered by benchmark datasets. To address this limitation and better exploit benchmark data, we propose SkillEval, a new evaluation framework that performs cross-model, skill-level analysis. The framework integrates advances from two areas: (1) it leverages the meta-cognitive capabilities of LLMs to automatically discover interpretable skills from questions, and (2) it applies cognitive diagnosis models (CDMs) from psychometrics to estimate per-skill abilities of LLMs. We conduct experiments on 3,811 LLMs evaluated on 9,523 items across five benchmarks spanning diverse domains (MATH, BBH, GPQA, MuSR, IFEval). Compared to the traditional average-based evaluation paradigm, SkillEval produces reliable, more calibrated and informative yet concise model profiles that more accurately predict model behavior on unseen items. We also demonstrate the utility of SkillEval in two downstream tasks: (1) LLM routing, which dynamically assigns each query t
entries.title_zh: SkillEval：用认知诊断模型构建大模型能力画像
entries.summary_zh: SkillEval 针对基准测试把所有题目压成单一分数、掩盖不同技能强弱的问题，提出跨模型的技能级分析框架。它让模型从题目中自动发现可解释技能，再用心理测量学中的认知诊断模型估计各模型在不同技能上的能力画像；这些画像有望区分“总分相近但短板不同”的模型，实际稳定性取决于技能抽取质量。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把基准评测从单一总分拆解为可解释的技能画像，便于定位能力差异。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可辅助模型选择、能力诊断和题库覆盖检查。
entries.cynic_review: 自动技能划分及诊断模型的校准性需通过跨基准实验检验。
entries.paper_review: 结合 LLM 技能发现与认知诊断，解决评测粒度过粗问题。

entries.source_title: affaan-m/ECC
entries.source_excerpt: The agent harness performance optimization system. Skills, instincts, memory, security, and research-first development for Claude Code, Codex, Opencode, Cursor and beyond.
entries.title_zh: ECC：面向 AI 编程代理的工程工作流与工具箱
entries.summary_zh: ECC 自述为 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Cursor 等编程代理提供工程工作流，包含计划、测试、实现、审查、验证和记忆等环节，以及专用代理、Skills、Hooks、规则和安全扫描工具。README 称其在 Claude Code 上支持最佳，并为其他平台提供功能受限的适配；所列代理与 Skills 数量及效果是项目自述，材料未提供独立评测。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 值得关注其将可复用 Skills、记忆与代码审查流程组合进代理工作台的做法；对个人科研代码维护者，适合挑选单项工作流试用，而非假定不同代理平台具有同等功能。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可借用计划、测试、审查和记忆工作流减少重复提示，但功能丰富，个人用户宜先选与自身代理兼容的少数模块。
entries.cynic_review: 项目宣称覆盖多个代理平台和大量 Skills，但明确承认平台能力存在差异，README 的数量和效率描述没有附独立对照证据。
entries.paper_review: 材料介绍了工作流、兼容性和许可信息，但未提供可复现的基准、用户研究或安全扫描有效性验证。

project_insight.translation_zh: 你的代理可以编写代码，但 ECC 为它提供一套协调的工程系统和工具箱：先计划再构建，用测试验证变更，在新的上下文中审查自身工作，记住重要信息，并把反复奏效的做法转成可复用的 Skills 和工作流。项目称其开源部分采用 MIT 许可；目前与 Claude Code 配合最好，并提供原生 Codex 和 Qoder 插件路径，其他平台的适配能力有限。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 为多种 AI 编程代理组织可复用的计划、测试、审查、记忆与安全相关工作流。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先阅读 README 的平台支持矩阵与安装说明，确认当前代理的功能支持范围；从一个低风险仓库和单个工作流开始，逐项检查所安装的 Skills、Hooks 与安全扫描行为，再决定是否启用更多组件。
project_insight.limitations_zh: README 明确表示 Claude Code 支持最佳，其他平台适配受限，不能假设功能一致；代理和 Skills 数量及工作流收益属于项目自述，摘录未包含独立评测。仓库标示 MIT，但材料同时介绍收费托管 GitHub App 和赞助服务；具体组件与服务条款应分别确认。
use_cases_zh: 为个人科研代码库试用计划—实现—测试—审查的固定流程，减少每次从空白提示开始的重复劳动。
将常用的数据处理、文档编写或代码审查步骤沉淀为 Skills，便于在受支持的代理中复用。
检查其代理平台支持矩阵，评估是否能为当前编程代理补充记忆或安全扫描工作流。

entries.source_title: Conservative Finite Element Methods for Kirchhoff-Type Equations
entries.source_excerpt: Authors: Benjamin Dörich , Felix Krumbiegel , Jemal Rogava , Andreas Rupp , Zurab Vashakidze; Subjects: Numerical Analysis (math.NA); This listing provides paper metadata; open the original for the abstract.
entries.title_zh: Kirchhoff 型方程的守恒有限元方法
entries.summary_zh: 论文把三层 Crank–Nicolson 型时间离散、任意次数协调有限元及 Picard 迭代结合，求解二维时变系数 Kirchhoff 型非线性方程。作者给出迭代收敛和时间二阶、空间最优阶误差；离散能精确守恒限于齐次常系数问题，数值例子验证预测阶数。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合非局部非线性波动与守恒数值方法。
entries.pragmatic_review: 误差阶与守恒条件便于验证实现。
entries.cynic_review: 不能把特殊情形能量守恒推广到时变系数。
entries.paper_review: 迭代和全离散误差在一致假设下分析。

entries.source_title: Approximate Matrix Multiplication through Joint Leverage Score Sampling
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we investigate approximate matrix multiplication through random sampling. Specifically, we propose using a non-uniform sampling distribution constructed from the leverage scores of the two matrices, and characterize the associated approximation error in terms of the matrix spectral norm; which is well-known to better characterize the downstream error when the matrix product operator is applied to an input vector. We provide the probability error bounds for the proposed algorithm are also given, and discuss connections to data-oblivious approximate matrix multiplication, and graph sparsification algorithms.
entries.title_zh: 联合杠杆分数抽样的近似矩阵乘法
entries.summary_zh: 论文为随机近似矩阵乘法构造由两个矩阵杠杆分数联合决定的非均匀抽样分布，并以矩阵谱范数刻画近似误差和给出概率误差界。谱范数能更直接反映矩阵乘积作用于输入向量时的下游误差；作者还讨论其与数据无关近似乘法和图稀疏化的联系。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 将抽样概率与两侧矩阵的杠杆结构结合，并提供面向算子误差的保证。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于大型矩阵乘法、低秩计算和图算法中的采样近似。
entries.cynic_review: 实际收益受杠杆分数估计与抽样规模影响。
entries.paper_review: 以谱范数建立误差界，目标比单纯逐元素误差更贴近应用。

entries.source_title: Triangulation, Volume, and Symmetries of the Dihedral Group Analogue of the Permutohedron
entries.source_excerpt: We study the analogue of the permutohedron for the dihedral group, which we call the dihedral permutohedron. We determine the facet structure of the dihedral permutohedron, use the facet structure to construct a triangulation, and determine a nice combinatorial formula for the volume of the dihedral permutohedron. Lastly, we find a family of interesting unimodular affine symmetries of the odd dihedral permutohedron.
entries.title_zh: 二面体群类比的 Permutohedron：三角剖分、体积与对称性
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究二面体群的 permutohedron 类比对象，确定其面结构，并利用这些面构造三角剖分与体积组合公式。作者还找到奇数阶二面体 permutohedron 的一族仿射酉模对称性。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把群作用、凸多面体组合结构与体积计算联系起来，适合组合几何读者。

entries.source_title: Kinetic Mean-Field Planning via Schr\"odinger Bridges: Existence, Penalization, and Consistency Bounds
entries.source_excerpt: We study a mean-field planning problem for a swarm of interacting, non-cooperative agents whose dynamics are stochastic and kinetic. The noise acts on the velocity only, and the interaction (of Cucker-Smale type for instance) enters through the drift. For a fixed flow, the problem reduces to a Schr\"odinger bridge problem, and we first prove the existence of an equilibrium by a Schauder fixed-point argument. Then we replace the hard terminal constraint by a penalty function and show that equilibria of the penalized problems converge, along subsequences, to an equilibrium of the original problem. Since equilibria are not unique in general, we instead quantify the consistency error, which measures how far an equilibrium of the penalized problem is from being an equilibrium of the original one. The rate is of order $n^{-1/2}$ for the relative-entropy penalty. The proof relies on the quantitative stability of entropic optimal transport and on a pointwise linear growth bound on the score of the degenerate reference dynamics, which is of independent interest.
entries.title_zh: 通过 Schrödinger 桥研究动理学平均场规划
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究具有动理学随机动力学的相互作用群体规划问题：噪声作用于速度，Cucker–Smale 型相互作用进入漂移项。固定群体流后，个体问题化为 Schrödinger 桥；作者用 Schauder 不动点证明均衡存在，并以相对熵惩罚放松终端约束，得到惩罚均衡的子列收敛及 n^(-1/2) 一致性误差界。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把熵正则最优输运的稳定性用于非合作群体规划，并给出可量化的惩罚近似误差。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可为带终端约束的群体随机控制提供可控的近似方案。
entries.cynic_review: 均衡一般不唯一，误差界针对近似均衡的一致性而非唯一解。
entries.paper_review: 存在性、惩罚收敛和定量误差分析构成完整结果链。

entries.source_title: $R$-trivial Galois cohomology classes and cohomological $p$-dimension
entries.source_excerpt: Given a prime $p$, a field $F$ of characteristic different from $p$ and a finite $p$-primary Galois module $V$, a Galois cohomology class in $H^n(F,V)$ is called $R$-trivial if it can be connected to $0$ by a class defined over an open subscheme of the projective line. All classes of $H^n(F,V)$ are $R$-trivial if $F$ has cohomological $p$-dimension at most $n$, by the Bloch-Kato conjecture. We show that this bound is sharp: working over fields of iterated Laurent series, we produce, for every $n\geq 1$, a field $F$ of cohomological $p$-dimension $n+1$ and a Galois module $V$ such that $H^n(F,V)$ contains classes which are not $R$-trivial. The module $V$ is a quotient of the permutation module on the affine hyperplanes of an elementary abelian $p$-group, arising as a quotient of the absolute Galois group of $F$. We also describe $R$-trivial classes as sums of corestrictions of cup products involving a Kummer class.
entries.title_zh: R-平凡 Galois 上同调类与上同调 p 维数
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究有限 p-primary Galois 模块 V 的 Hⁿ(F,V) 中可经射影直线开子集上的类连接到零的 R-平凡类；由 Bloch–Kato 猜想，若域 F 的上同调 p 维数不超过 n，则所有此类上同调类均 R-平凡。作者证明这一维数上界是尖锐的：对每个 n≥1 构造上同调 p 维数为 n+1 的迭代 Laurent 级数域，使 Hⁿ 中存在非 R-平凡类，并将 R-平凡类描述为含 Kummer 类的杯积核心striction之和。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合算术几何与 Galois 上同调读者理解 Bloch–Kato 维数条件的边界及反例构造。
entries.pragmatic_review: 尖锐性例子明确说明何时不能期待所有类都可被 R-连接。
entries.cynic_review: 构造依赖特定迭代 Laurent 级数域与模块，应用需核对设定。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出维数尖锐性与类的结构描述，杯积表达细节需读全文。

entries.source_title: Subset sums of power values over Galois rings
entries.source_excerpt: Let $R=GR(p^m,p^{mf})$, where $p$ is prime, $q=p^f$, $m,f\geq1$, $d\geq2$ and $p\nmid d$. We count $n$-element subsets of $P=\{x^d:x\in R\}\setminus\{0\}$, the set of distinct nonzero $d$th-power values, with a prescribed sum. For fixed $m,d,n$ with $n\geq3$, the count equals \[ q^{-m}\binom{|P|}{n}(1+O_{m,d,n}(q^{1-n/2})) \] as $q\to\infty$ through admissible prime powers, uniformly over all targets and with both $p$ and $f$ allowed to vary. For fixed $m,d$, we also classify uniform relative equidistribution at the remaining positive sizes: it fails at $n=1$, and at $n=2$ it holds along an admissible sequence if and only if, for all sufficiently large terms, $\gcd(d,q-1)=1$ and $(m\geq2\text{ or }p\ne2)$.
entries.title_zh: Galois 环上幂值子集和计数
entries.summary_zh: 论文在 Galois 环 R=GR(p^m,p^{mf}) 中，计数由 n 个不同非零 d 次幂值组成且总和为指定元素的子集。固定 m、d 且 n≥3 时，作者给出对所有目标值一致的渐近公式，主项为总子集数按环大小 q^m 均匀分配；并完整描述 n=1 的失败情形及 n=2 何时具有相对均匀分布。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把有限域幂值和的均匀分布研究扩展到高阶 Galois 环，并给出小集合大小的精确边界。

entries.source_title: On the Open Problem in the 2023 Simon Marais Mathematics Competition
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that, for $n \in \mathbb{Z}^+$ not a perfect square, the only pairs of positive integers $\{a, b\}$ for which there exists $r \in \mathbb{R}$ such that $r^a + \sqrt{n}$ and $r^b + \sqrt{n}$ are both rational numbers are those of the form $\{a, a\}$ or $\{g, 2g\}$ (with $g$ odd). This resolves an open question presented in the 2023 Simon Marais Mathematics Competition.
entries.title_zh: 解决 2023 Simon Marais 竞赛中的一道开放问题
entries.summary_zh: 对非平方正整数 n，论文研究何种正整数指数对能让同一实数 r 的两次幂加上 √n 都为有理数。摘要给出完整形式：两个指数相同，或为 g 与 2g 且 g 为奇数，并称由此解决竞赛开放题。

entries.source_title: Sharp zero forcing numbers for the generalized Petersen graphs $P(n,3)$ and $P(n,4)$
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that $Z(P(n,3))=8$ for every $n\ge13$ and $Z(P(n,4))=10$ for every $n\ge18$, with both stabilization thresholds sharp, and give the exact values for all smaller admissible $n$. The first equality proves Krishnan's Conjecture 5; his Proposition 4 supplies its upper bound. The lower bounds use the external boundary of the first forcing sources: ten vertices have boundary at least eight in $P(n,3)$ for $n\ge14$, and sixteen vertices have boundary at least ten in $P(n,4)$ for $n\ge20$. Deletion within an empty column interval reduces these assertions to finite checks, and forts settle the remaining cases. The $k=3$ stabilization theorem has a Lean 4 formalization; the $k=4$ proof uses 89 boundary formulas and 11 fort formulas with separately checked DRAT certificates, together with explicit forcing sequences.
entries.title_zh: 广义 Petersen 图 P(n,3) 与 P(n,4) 的尖锐零强迫数
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明 n≥13 时 Z(P(n,3))=8，n≥18 时 Z(P(n,4))=10，且稳定阈值尖锐，并列出更小可行 n 的精确值。P(n,3) 结果证明 Krishnan 猜想；证明包含下界边界分析、有限归约和 forts，k=3 结果以 Lean 4 形式化，k=4 部分使用独立检查的 DRAT 证书及显式强迫序列。

entries.source_title: Recovering Dirichlet coefficients from even samples
entries.source_excerpt: In this work, we determine the exact case error for recovering a Dirichlet coefficient from finitely many positive even samples with bounded additive errors. For sequences with a bounded tail and an unrestricted initial block, a polynomial estimator is minimax among all recovery maps. Its tail and noise constants admit explicit product formulas. We prove a sharp tail asymptotic on the index scale K^(3/2) and give a terminating procedure for selecting the sample count from a computable error bound.
entries.title_zh: 从偶数样本恢复 Dirichlet 系数
entries.summary_zh: 论文考虑带有有界加性误差的有限个正偶数样本，研究如何恢复 Dirichlet 系数；在尾部有界、初始段不受限的序列类中，证明多项式估计器在所有恢复映射中达到 minimax 最优。作者给出尾误差与噪声常数的显式乘积公式、K^(3/2) 指标尺度上的尖锐尾部渐近，并提供依据可计算误差界终止选择样本数的算法。

entries.source_title: The geometric exceptional set for Fano threefolds
entries.source_excerpt: We study the geometric exceptional set in Manin's conjecture for smooth Fano threefolds. We prove that every adjoint rigid surface with $a$-invariant one on a non-product smooth Fano threefold is normal. This yields a description of the geometric exceptional set in terms of the higher-$a$ locus, anticanonical conics, and del Pezzo fibrations. Zariski density arise only from the latter two contributions. For del Pezzo fibrations, we construct a finite collection of parameter covers which controlling the associated breaking maps. We classify their low-genus components for general smooth Fano threefolds yielding examples with potentially Zariski dense geometric exceptional sets in $22$ of the $105$ deformation families. Extending Batyrev-Tschinkel's example, we construct Fano fourfolds with quartic del Pezzo fibrations and an explicit Fano threefold with two degree-six del Pezzo fibrations, all with Zariski dense geometric exceptional sets. For this threefold, the original form of Manin's conjecture fails on every non-empty open subset for every anticanonical height.
entries.title_zh: Fano 三维簇的几何例外集
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究光滑 Fano 三维簇上 Manin 猜想的几何例外集，证明非乘积 Fano 三维簇中 a-不变量为 1 的伴随刚性曲面必为正规，并据此把例外集描述为高 a-值轨迹、反典范圆锥和 del Pezzo 纤维化贡献，其中 Zariski 稠密性只来自后两类。作者分类一般 Fano 三维簇纤维化参数覆盖的低亏格分支，在 105 个变形族中找到 22 个可能产生稠密例外集的例子，并构造一个使原始 Manin 猜想在任何非空开集、任何反典范高度下都失败的显式三维簇。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合算术几何读者了解 Fano 三维簇上有理点计数何时受几何例外子簇支配。
entries.pragmatic_review: 例外集分类可帮助识别 Manin 型渐近公式需要排除的几何部分。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要区分“可能稠密”族与明确反例，不能把两者都视为猜想已失败。
entries.paper_review: 摘要报告正规性定理、分类和显式反例，参数覆盖细节需读全文。

entries.source_title: Fix, Not Just Resample: Bounded Compiler-Guided Repair in Lean 4
entries.source_excerpt: Automated theorem provers often rely on sampling language models, but proof assistants like Lean reject each failed step with a precise error message --- information that pure sampling discards. To overcome this, we introduce a bounded, online step-level repair module. Our search samples $K$ candidate tactics at each step and repairs a failed tactic at most $R$ times. Instead of discarding failed tactics, we feed the compiler's error message to a pretrained repair model to fix individual rejected steps in place. This approach improves the solve rate over a sampling-only baseline across all tested candidate budgets ($K \in \{1,3,5,8\}$), achieving up to a $32\%$ relative gain and solving $82$ additional theorems on a $1{,}990$-theorem subset of the LeanDojo benchmark. Repair is not free: it trades extra runtime for reachable proofs. But the trade is predictable: repair pays most when sampling is constrained; its return is front-loaded, with the first repair attempt capturing $84\text{--}96\%$ of the total gain; and the gain comes almost entirely from shallow tactic-execution failures rather than structural errors such as type mismatche
entries.title_zh: 修复而非重抽：Lean 4 中有界编译器引导证明修复
entries.summary_zh: 论文针对自动定理证明器只靠语言模型反复采样、丢弃 Lean 编译错误信息的问题，提出有界在线逐步修复模块：每步采样 K 个 tactic，对失败 tactic 最多修复 R 次，并把编译器错误反馈给修复模型原位修改。相对纯采样基线，在 K∈{1,3,5,8} 各预算下求解率均提升；在 LeanDojo 1,990 定理子集上多解出 82 个，最高相对提升 32%，代价是修复额外开销。

entries.source_title: ReAPO: Retry-Aware Policy Optimization for Efficient Exploration in LLM Reasoning
entries.source_excerpt: RLVR improves language-model reasoning, but commonly relies on independent stochastic rollouts for exploration, which can repeatedly sample similar failed strategies. Prior work has seen success with approaches that guide exploration by introducing dependence into the sampling process by including incorrect solutions in the context for subsequent attempts. Still, these methods introduce the additional question of how to assign credit to each attempt. We propose to view the credit assignment through the lens of Stochastic Shortest Paths, a framework in classical reinforcement learning that seeks to minimize the expected cumulative cost to reach a terminal state (in our case, a verified successful response). We show that, under suitable simplifying assumptions, this perspective naturally leads to a simple modification to GRPO, which we call Retry-Aware Policy Optimization (ReAPO). ReAPO allocates additional generation to failed trajectories, allowing successful retries to be reinforced without rewarding preceding failures, and assigns credit in a theoretically principled way to each attempt. Across Qwen3 and OLMo-2 models from 0.6B to 4
entries.title_zh: ReAPO：面向重试的推理策略优化

entries.source_title: The Kemeny-Braess Paradox in Random Graphs
entries.source_excerpt: In 2016, Kirkland and Zeng initiated the mathematical treatment of Braess paradox for random walks on graphs using Kemeny's constant as the measure of travel time. We study this phenomenon for the Erd\H{o}s-R\'enyi random graph $G(n,p)$. An edge in a connected graph is called Kemeny-Braess if its deletion preserves connectedness and decreases Kemeny's constant, while a nonedge is Kemeny-Braess if its insertion increases Kemeny's constant. Let $\bar d=(n-1)p$ be the expected degree of $G\sim G(n,p)$, and assume that $\bar d-\log n\to\infty$, so that $G$ is connected with high probability. We determine the sharp asymptotic thresholds for the existence of both types of paradoxical behaviour. With $C^*=1/(1-\log 2)$, the threshold for Kemeny-Braess edges is $\bar d=C^*\log n$, whereas the threshold for Kemeny-Braess nonedges is $\bar d=2C^*\log n$. Hence, as the expected degree $\bar d$ increases, the connected regime exhibits three phases: first Kemeny-Braess paradox occurs for both edges and nonedges, then only for nonedges, and finally it disappears. In particular, in the dense regime, with high probability $G$ has no Kemeny-Braess edg
entries.title_zh: 随机图中的 Kemeny–Braess 悖论
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究 Erdős–Rényi 随机图中删边反而缩短随机游走平均旅行时间、或加边反而拉长时间的 Kemeny–Braess 现象。在平均度远高于连通阈值的条件下，作者给出尖锐阈值：悖论边阈值约为 C*log n，悖论非边约为 2C*log n（C*=1/(1−log 2)），随平均度上升经历两类皆有、仅非边存在、最终消失三阶段。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合随机图与马尔可夫链研究者理解网络结构如何反直觉地影响混合与旅行指标。

entries.cynic_review: 结论是渐近高概率阈值，有限规模表现需另行分析。

entries.source_title: Constructive Universal Approximation by Infinite-Dimensional Neural Networks via Gaussian-Weighted Ridgelet Transform
entries.source_excerpt: Neural networks whose inputs are functions, as in operator learning, are usually shown to be universal by existence arguments, either by reduction to finite-dimensional networks or by Stone--Weierstrass-type density; these prove that approximants exist but say little about how the parameters depend on the target. We take a constructive route. We extend the ridgelet transform, an integral transform related to the Fourier, Radon, and wavelet transforms, to continuous maps on a separable infinite-dimensional Hilbert space, replacing the Lebesgue measure that is unavailable in infinite dimensions by Gaussian weights with a homogeneous mixture on the direction space. The resulting transform has a Plancherel identity and reconstruction formulas incorporating the frame operator, the correction induced by the weights, and it assigns to each target an explicit coefficient measure, one for every admissible analysis filter. From these representations we obtain uniform approximation on compact sets for all continuous non-polynomial activations of polynomial growth, including ReLU, and, by Monte Carlo sampling of the coefficient, finite-width netw
entries.title_zh: 高斯加权 ridgelet 变换与无限维神经网络的构造性逼近
entries.summary_zh: 论文把 ridgelet 积分变换推广到可分无限维 Hilbert 空间，用高斯权重替代无限维中不存在的 Lebesgue 测度，并推导 Plancherel 恒等式及重构公式。由此对多项式增长的连续非多项式激活（包括 ReLU）给出紧集上一致逼近，并可对显式系数测度做 Monte Carlo 采样构造有限宽网络。

entries.source_title: A Study in Solution Models for SAT using the PBNF-transform
entries.source_excerpt: In this article, we use the PBNF-transform, or Polynomial Boolean Normal Form, described earlier in two articles and now extended to higher arity, to solve Boolean satisfiability problems (SAT), which are part of the P versus NP problem. SAT consists of a statement of conjunctions of clauses, and in our SAT-solving models, we dualize the logical equations, inverting the problem by \emph{multiplying} letters (literals) in the transferred clauses, now phrases: $pqrs\cdots s_{\ell}$, and using a binary iterated composition based on \emph{adding polynomials} for the conjunctions in our solution formula. We obtain Polynomial Boolean Equations, PBE=0, by also renaming the truth value $1\mapsto 0$(T). To find a solution, we look for repeating literals in the clauses to factor out. With reversed literal repetition, we can even reduce the CNF to the sum of the transformed clauses.

entries.source_excerpt: We give explicit binary constant-weight codes that raise the lower bounds on $A(n,6,w)$ in eight cells of Brouwer's table, all now listed there. The first round (9 October 2026) gave four values: $A(27,6,11)\ge 19305$, $A(27,6,12)\ge 24453$, $A(28,6,10)\ge 18642$ and $A(28,6,9)\ge 11154$, together with an explicit $A(24,6,12)$ code of 5566 words, now in the table's list of lost codes. The second round (14 October 2026) gave seven values, listed in the table since 15 October 2026: $A(29,6,10)\ge 27183$, $A(29,6,11)\ge 42042$, $A(29,6,9)\ge 14781$, $A(28,6,10)\ge 19110$, $A(27,6,12)\ge 24804$, $A(28,6,9)\ge 11388$ and $A(27,6,13)\ge 27783$, three of which replace first-round values. Every code is a union of orbits of the semilinear affine group $\mathrm{A\Gamma L}(1,27)$, its index-2 subgroup, or $\mathrm{AGL}(1,23)$, acting on all but at most two coordinates. The orbits were chosen by maximum-weight independent set search on the orbit conflict graph: branch and bound in the first round, iterated local search in the second. entries.title_zh: 借助指定自同构搜索改进二元定重码下界，并构造达到上界的量子码

entries.source_title: Delta N-gram: Forward-Only Continual Writing into a Language Model's Native N-gram Memory
entries.source_excerpt: Our previous analysis found that a model's native hashed N-gram table is where continual updates disturb the base least, but its writes needed backpropagation and changed the pretrained table. We present Delta N-gram, a forward-only write path into that table. The pretrained table T^0 is never modified. Evidence is written into a sparse patch \Delta on the rows it addresses: a 4.1M-parameter writer emits a target and a gate per (position, hash head) event, and a block-averaged delta rule keeps each row a convex combination of its old value and the gated targets. The writer is trained offline on raw text with the pretraining objective; at use time writing takes forward passes only, and clearing \Delta restores the original model. A 0.6B prototype trained to answer questions keeps 16/16 facts after a second write; online gradient writes keep 2--4/16. We study two writers: a plain writer that encodes evidence with the T^0-only model, and a delta writer that reads its current memory while encoding. On Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, the plain writer's memory is document-specific: on 64 held-out news events it lowers continuation NLL by 0.068 nats/tok
entries.title_zh: Delta N-gram：以前向写入稀疏补丁更新模型记忆

entries.source_title: Chaotic CLT using Poisson Fourth Moment Theorem and Graph Theory
entries.source_excerpt: In this article, we consider the parabolic Anderson model and the hyperbolic Anderson model in dimension 1, driven by a time-independent L\'evy noise, which is either white, or colored with integrable coloration kernel $\kappa$. Using a Poisson version of the Fourth Moment Theorem due to D\"obler, Vidotto and Zheng (2018), we prove that the spatial integral of the solution satisfies a central limit theorem. We prove that this result also holds for the hyperbolic Anderson model in dimension $d=2$, if in addition $\kappa$ is bounded. To estimate the fourth cumulant of the projection of the spatial integral on a fixed chaos, we develop a novel technique using graph theory, which allows us to handle some intricate integrals involving the modified contractions.
entries.title_zh: 借助 Poisson 四阶矩定理与图论证明混沌中心极限定理
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究一维抛物型与双曲型 Anderson 模型在时间不变 Lévy 噪声驱动下的空间积分，噪声可为白噪声或具有可积着色核的噪声。作者运用 Poisson 版第四矩定理证明空间积分的中心极限定理；双曲模型在二维也成立，但需额外假设着色核有界，并发展图论方法估计固定混沌阶投影的四阶累积量。

entries.source_title: Two technical questions: floating intellectual property and liability risks of AI agents and users in research
entries.source_excerpt: This was prompted by the recent disclosure that, in June 2026, an artificial intelligence agent developed by OpenAI autonomously hacked into Australia's Medicare system to access non-public data.

entries.paper_review: 可形成可审计系统与研究伦理的问题清单。

entries.source_title: Functional limit theorems for self-interacting random walks
entries.source_excerpt: We consider a wide class of nearest neighbor self-interacting random walks on $\mathbb{Z}$ and show that, under mild conditions, their scaling limits at the process level can be uniquely identified and constructed directly from the augmented joint Ray-Knight theorem for their local times, i.e., the joint convergence of rescaled local time ``curves'' of the walks stopped at certain stopping times together with the merge and absorption times of these ``curves'' to a concatenation of coalescing reflected-absorbed diffusions and their merge and absorption times. We apply our results to polynomially self-repelling walks introduced and studied in the mid-90s by B. T\'oth, and to ``true'' self-avoiding walks with bond repulsion. The first application solves a problem that has been open since T\'oth's work: it gives a construction and first properties of a new family of processes, polynomially self-repelling motions, as scaling limits of polynomially self-repelling walks. These processes were simultaneously and independently constructed from flows of correlated powers of Bessel processes by Y. Yu. The second application strengthens an earlier
entries.title_zh: 自相互作用随机游走的函数极限定理
entries.summary_zh: 论文考察整数线上一类最近邻自相互作用随机游走，利用增强联合 Ray–Knight 定理中局部时曲线及其合并、吸收时刻的联合收敛，直接构造并识别过程级缩放极限。应用包括多项式自排斥游走（构造了此前缺少的多项式自排斥运动极限）和带键排斥的真正自回避游走，并加强后者到真正自排斥运动的收敛结果。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 展示局部时几何如何反推出自相互作用路径的缩放极限，并解决一项长期悬而未决的构造问题。

entries.cynic_review: 结果依赖文中所设自相互作用类别及相应的局部时收敛条件。
entries.paper_review: 把增强 Ray–Knight 收敛反用为过程级极限定理工具。

entries.source_title: Connected graphs with equal independence number and radius
entries.source_excerpt: A classical theorem states that the independence number of any connected graph is at least its radius. In 2007, DeLaVi\~na, Pepper, and Waller proved that every connected graph with equal independence number and radius is traceable. We first give a new short proof of this theorem and then prove two results for graphs of higher connectivity. (1) Every 2-connected graph with equal independence number and radius is Hamiltonian. (2) Every 3-connected graph with equal independence number and radius is Hamiltonian-connected and pancyclic. Several lemmas used in the proofs are of independent interest.
entries.title_zh: 独立数等于半径的图具有更强环结构
entries.summary_zh: 既有定理保证独立数等于半径的连通图存在遍历所有顶点的路径。本文称进一步证明二连通时存在 Hamilton 环，三连通时任意端点间有 Hamilton 路且含各种长度的环，并给出旧结论的短证明。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究图连通性如何控制 Hamilton 性质。

entries.paper_review: 从可迹性提升到泛圈性具有清晰层次。

entries.source_title: Recommendations on the use of AI for PhD students and supervisors
entries.source_excerpt: We provide a proposed set of guidelines for PhD students and their supervisors. Given that PhD students are the most affected, both professionally and psychologically, by the advent of AI in mathematics, such guidelines, even if they may soon be obsolete, could be useful to them, their advisors and graduate schools.
entries.title_zh: 关于博士生与导师使用 AI 的建议
entries.summary_zh: 一组辛几何研究者提出面向数学博士生、导师和研究生院的 AI 使用指南，核心立场是把 AI 作为数学家的工具，同时由数学家决定重要问题，并保留判断结果是否有趣的责任。作者强调博士生在职业和心理上受到 AI 变化的影响尤甚，也说明指南是帮助学生与机构应对变化的实用建议，不试图统一 AI 风险立场；具体做法应结合机构政策与研究任务调整。

entries.pragmatic_review: 把选题和成果价值判断留给研究者，有助于保持训练责任。

entries.source_title: SliMOO: Interpretable Multi-Objective Evolutionary Search for LLM Depth Pruning
entries.source_excerpt: As large language models (LLMs) grow more powerful, their scale makes them costly to serve. Depth pruning offers a practical route to efficiency by directly reducing memory and latency without hardware-specific support. However, we observe that transformer layers exhibit markedly different task-dependent layer contributions, whereas existing depth-pruning methods ignore this heterogeneity and thus tend to optimize for a narrow domain or benchmark rather than preserve broad capability. This suggests that LLM depth pruning should be formulated as a multi-objective optimization problem rather than a single-score ranking problem. We propose SliMOO, an interpretable multi-objective evolutionary search framework for LLM depth pruning. SliMOO first uses single-layer removal probing to construct a task-layer importance map, which provides an interpretable view of task-shared and task-specific layers and serves as a search prior. It then performs a Pareto-aware evolutionary search for pruning masks, where candidates are generated under the guidance of the task-layer prior, scored by their deviation from the dense model on each task, and retain
entries.title_zh: SliMOO：可解释多目标进化搜索剪枝语言模型深度
entries.summary_zh: 深度剪枝可减少大模型服务内存和延迟，但不同 Transformer 层对不同任务贡献不一，单一分数排名容易牺牲宽泛能力。SliMOO 将剪枝表述为多目标优化，采用可解释的进化搜索在压缩、任务保持等目标间探索层组合，避免只针对窄领域优化；实际效益需按模型与任务权重评估。

entries.source_title: AI and Mathematics: Public Good, Credit, and Education
entries.source_excerpt: We should preserve the human ability to understand and explore mathematics, not preserve unsolved problems merely to protect a familiar way of working. The goal should be to enlarge public mathematical knowledge and understanding, whether the discoveries are made by humans, AI, or a collaboration between them. I also discuss competition, credit for AI contributions, and why restrictions on AI in education raise different questions from restrictions on research.

entries.source_title: Derived equivalences and isogenies of supersingular abelian varieties
entries.source_excerpt: We study (twisted) Fourier-Mukai partners of supersingular abelian varieties. We give a simple proof that any two supersingular abelian varieties of the same dimension at least two are derived isogenous, answering a question raised by Li, Lu, and Tang and generalizing the result of Li and Zou. Moreover, in every dimension greater than two, we construct derived-equivalent supersingular abelian varieties whose corresponding positive powers are never isomorphic. We also give conditions under which derived equivalence between two supersingular principally polarized abelian varieties implies that their underlying abelian varieties are isomorphic. In particular, this implication holds in dimensions at most three.

entries.source_title: Think More or Read More? A Token-Budget Theory of Reasoning with Shared Context
entries.source_excerpt: Reasoning systems increasingly improve answers by incorporating additional context into the model's input, from multi-agent debate, where agents read their peers' responses, to self-refinement, where a model revisits its own drafts. In these systems, communication consumes context as one agent's output becomes another's input. We study the regime where token reading and generation draw on one fixed token window, so every token spent reading is a token that cannot be spent reasoning. We develop a \textbf{token-budget theory} that formalizes this trade-off, modeling accuracy as a function of the reasoning budget remaining after reading and aggregating votes with a Condorcet jury model that permits correlated errors. For multi-agent debate, the theory gives a closed-form prediction for the optimal number of agents. This quantity is estimated from single-agent measurements, allowing the optimal group size to be determined without running debate, and the same accounting extends to a heterogeneous set of different models. entries.title_zh: 多想还是多读？共享上下文推理的 token 预算理论

entries.source_title: Margin Certificates for Voting Classifiers under Mixing Dependence
entries.source_excerpt: Margin bounds explain why weighted votes generalize after training error vanishes, but dependent observations require concentration arguments that keep the dependence model and failure budget explicit. We study stationary mixing streams without treating dependence as a formal substitution of an "effective sample size." For a finite base class, we combine independent-block Rademacher theory for stationary $\beta$-mixing processes with a clipped margin loss to obtain an explicit uniform voting-margin certificate, whose dependence penalty is set by the number of approximately independent blocks and the coupling budget $4(\mu-1)\beta(a)$. A black-box transfer theorem shows that any i.i.d. voting-margin guarantee remains valid on a regularly spaced subsequence, with only an additive $\beta$-mixing failure probability. For votes fixed independently of a stationary finite-state reversible Markov stream, spectral concentration gives the cleaner $\sqrt{t_{rel}/n}$ rate, and a sticky-refresh construction shows this exponent is unavoidable. entries.source_title: Normal approximation and self-normalized moderate deviations for the minimal random walk with random step sizes
entries.source_excerpt: We study the minimal random walk with independent positive random step sizes. By separating the movement count from the centered step-size noise, we obtain normal approximations and self-normalized Cram\'er-type moderate deviations under finite-moment assumptions. For the noise, conditioning on the movement count yields Kolmogorov, Wasserstein and Zolotarev bounds. A polynomial moderate-deviation range holds when a recalled stop can lead to movement. At the boundary where this probability is zero, we obtain a logarithmic range and construct a bounded nonsymmetric example excluding a general polynomial range. For the full position, a weighted martingale representation gives limit laws in the different regimes, nonuniform normal approximations and moment-distance bounds without logarithmic losses. Variance concentration also yields self-normalized moderate deviations in the diffusive and critical regimes.
entries.title_zh: 随机步长最小随机游走的正态近似与中等偏差
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究带独立正随机步长的最小随机游走，把移动次数与中心化步长噪声分开，在有限矩条件下建立正态近似和自归一化 Cramér 型中等偏差。是否存在可导致移动的“回忆停步”会改变可达偏差范围：概率为正时可得多项式范围，边界为零时通常只有对数范围，作者还构造有界非对称例子排除一般多项式结论。对整体位置，论文用加权鞅表示获得不同区域的极限定律与矩距离界。

entries.source_title: One Teacher, Many Views: Reducing Reference Sensitivity in On-Policy Self-Distillation
entries.source_excerpt: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) improves reasoning by training a model on its own trajectories with dense token-level supervision from a privileged copy conditioned on a reference solution. Existing methods typically use a single teacher distribution conditioned on the complete reference. We identify a limitation of this formulation: a reference is only one realization of the reasoning process. Although it provides evidence about the answer, it also encodes an ordering, phrasing, and solution path. Full-reference conditioning can therefore produce correct targets that depend excessively on information unavailable to the student at inference. We show that replacing one valid reference with another, while holding the problem and student state fixed, can substantially alter the teacher distribution, a phenomenon we call reference-induced target instability. entries.source_title: Lean4AgenticRL: Advancing Agentic RL with Verifiable Multi-level Process Rewards
entries.source_excerpt: Enhancing the agentic capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) to tackle complex software engineering (SWE) and general terminal-usage problems is a pressing challenge. Current state-of-the-art LLMs often go through large-scale agentic Reinforcement Learning (RL). However, they mostly rely on high-level outcome rewards, with minimal consideration of low-level toolcall and mid-level workflow-stage rewards, which makes the training less effective. To overcome this limitation, we propose **Lean4AgenticRL**, which, to the best of our knowledge, is the first framework that grounds multi-level process rewards in the unified Lean4 formalization schema for open-ended agentic RL. **Lean4AgenticRL** first builds a *problem-specific workflow* system that balances the agent's own capability and controllability during execution, laying the foundation for further verification. Subsequently, our workflow formalization and multi-level reward annotation methods enable agent behavior verification within a general harness system. It provides multi-level rewards to support more effective agentic RL with the workflow-stage-normalized GRPO algorithm. U
entries.title_zh: Lean4AgenticRL：用可验证多层过程奖励推进智能体强化学习

entries.source_title: On the Fragility of Tasks under Composition: Implicit Budgeting in Language Models
entries.source_excerpt: Modern language models are increasingly asked to handle several tasks within a single prompt. Doing so requires solving each task correctly while integrating the resulting answers into a coherent response. In this paper, we identify a fundamental limitation in this process, where models make substantially more errors when tasks are composed, even when they can solve every constituent task reliably in isolation. This degradation cannot be fully explained by the accumulation of independent errors. Across both open-weight models and the frontier model Claude Opus 5, our findings instead point to an implicit thinking budget underlying this effect. In particular, under composition, models use substantially fewer tokens per task than in isolation, even when the full sequence remains well within the context window. Tasks that require longer solution traces in isolation are consequently more $\textit{fragile}$ under composition, i.e., models make more errors on prompts containing these tasks. entries.title_zh: 任务组合下的脆弱性：语言模型的隐式预算
entries.summary_zh: 论文发现语言模型将多个任务合并在同一提示中时，即使每项任务单独都能可靠完成，组合回答错误仍会显著增加，且无法由独立错误简单累积解释。跨开源模型与 Claude Opus 5 的研究指向隐式思考预算：组合场景下每项任务分配的 token 明显少于单项场景，即使总预算充足也如此，说明任务协调本身会挤压单项推理资源。

entries.source_title: Uniformity of the minimal exponent on the GIT boundary of projective hypersurfaces
entries.source_excerpt: Let $X$ be a non-stable (in the sense of GIT) hypersurface of degree $d \ge 3$ in the projective space $\mathbb{P}^{n}$. S. G. Park proved that the global minimal exponent of $X$ satisfies the inequality $\widetilde{\alpha}(X) \le \frac{n+1}{d}$. In this paper, we establish the uniform sharpness of this inequality: we prove that $\widetilde{\alpha}(X) = \frac{n+1}{d}$ holds for a general member $X$ of every irreducible component of the strictly semistable locus. Moreover, a general point of each irreducible component of the GIT boundary $\partial M^{\mathrm{GIT}}$ admits a strictly semistable zero-weight representative with this minimal exponent. By the lower semicontinuity of the minimal exponent on the affine cone and a theorem of Musta\c{t}\u{a}--Popa for general linear combinations of monomials, the problem is reduced to computing the log canonical thresholds, at the cone vertex, of the monomial ideals associated with the maximal strictly semistable supports with respect to a maximal torus and their weight-zero parts. entries.source_title: An explicit elementary proof of no Landau--Siegel zeros
entries.source_excerpt: We give an elementary proof of the absence of Landau--Siegel zeros with the explicit constant $c=1/100$. For every primitive quadratic Dirichlet character $\chi$ of conductor $q\ge3$, each real zero $\beta\in(0,1)$ of $L(s,\chi)$ satisfies $(1-\beta)\log q>c$. The proof combines integer coefficient counting, polynomial congruences, a paired-tail hyperbola estimate, and a logarithmically weighted comparison of positive sums. All required constants are explicit, and one choice of parameters covers every conductor. The argument uses elementary arithmetic and real summation and integration, without separate zero computations for small conductors.

entries.source_title: Norm-Euclideanity in cyclic fields
entries.source_excerpt: Consider a cyclic number field of prime degree $p$. For a fixed degree, there are only finitely many such fields which are norm-Euclidean. When $p=2$ or $3$, these have been completely determined. If instead $p>3$, one can bound the discriminant of such fields from above. We substantially sharpen these upper bounds via an explicit Burgess-type criterion and describe a method for completely resolving other small prime cases.

entries.source_title: A positivity conjecture of Prellberg and Stanton
entries.source_excerpt: We prove the conjecture of Prellberg and Stanton (2003) that $\frac{1-q}{(q^n;q)_m}\genfrac{[}{]}{0pt}{}{n}{m}_{q}$ has nonnegative power-series coefficients for $0 <n$, except when $n$ is even and $m\in\{2,n-2\}$. We obtain a polynomial version by bounding a M\"obius correction by first differences of Gaussian coefficients. The proof uses partitions and quadratic and cubic semi-invariants of binary forms. An extension of this bound proves the Reiner--Stanton--White conjecture on positivity of orbit polynomials for flags of subspaces.

entries.source_title: Generic vanishing for Dolbeault cohomology of mixed Hodge modules on abelian varieties
entries.source_excerpt: We study generic vanishing for the Dolbeault cohomology of mixed Hodge modules, where the differentials in the Dolbeault complex are modified by a one-form. We prove that, on the Dolbeault moduli space of Higgs line bundles, the cohomology support loci of mixed Hodge modules agree with the images of the cohomology support loci of their underlying $\mathscr{D}$-modules on the de Rham moduli space under the map induced by the nonabelian Hodge correspondence. We further apply this result to study Fourier-Mukai transforms of mixed Hodge modules on abelian varieties. We show that the extended Fourier-Mukai transform for bounded complexes of mixed Hodge modules has cohomology sheaves that are flat over the twistor line of $\lambda$-connections. This also gives an extension of Fourier transform of mixed Hodge modules to a compactification of the de Rham moduli space.
entries.title_zh: 阿贝尔簇上混合 Hodge 模的 Dolbeault 上同调一般消失

entries.source_title: Denominators of Hodge integrals and Minkowski numbers
entries.source_excerpt: We prove that the least common denominator of all genus $g$ Hodge integrals is the Minkowski number $T_{2g}$ or, equivalently, the Bhargava factorial $(2g+1)!_{\mathbb{P}}$ associated to the set of primes $\mathbb{P}\subset\mathbb{N}$. As a corollary, we prove a conjecture of Liu-Xu on the multiplicity of $3$ in the least common denominators of certain descendant integrals, and generalise their result on a conjecture of Itzykson-Zuber to Hodge integrals with $\lambda$ classes. Namely, the order of the automorphism group of any pointed stable curve of genus $g'\le g$ divides the least common denominator of all genus $g$ Hodge integrals. We also comment on the use of generative AI via IMProofBench, which played a fruitful part in the development of this (entirely human-written) paper.

entries.source_title: Subgraph probabilities in random intersection graphs
entries.source_excerpt: Since their introduction by Karo\'nski, Scheinerman, and Singer-Cohen in 90's, random intersection graphs have attracted much attention, mostly due to their various applications. In this article, we establish a general result for the probability that a given small subgraph is present in a random intersection graph. Our theorem applies to a broad range of parameters, including regimes that have not previously been considered in the literature. Moreover, it extends known results and situates them within a broader framework, making this approach a convenient tool for comparing the probabilities of graphs in the random intersection graph model. To prove our main result, we develop new proof techniques that, to the best of our knowledge, have not previously been employed in the study of small subgraphs in random intersection graphs. Many special cases and examples are presented as well.
