I am especially interested in whether experienced mathematicians use similar methods, even if they do not describe them as prompts or formal workflows.
entries.title_zh: 有没有真正有效的数学 AI 使用方法？
entries.summary_zh: 作者是一名本科生，分享用 AI 研究数学问题的做法：主动削弱假设、寻找反例，再把结论之间的依赖关系逐步整理；例如连续函数端点异号保证至少有一个零点，而严格递增单独提供至多一个零点。文章强调 AI 可帮助构造模型对照和探索条件，但数学基础、独立学习与证明核查仍不可省；作者也披露 AI 参与草稿组织、例子建议和翻译。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 给出可迁移的研究提问习惯，特别是区分定理中各条件作用与构造反例的过程。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可把 AI 用于探索反例和假设依赖，再由人验证。
entries.cynic_review: 作者明确承认基础可能跟不上探索速度，验证仍是关键。
entries.paper_review: 适合作为数学探索方法的个人经验，而非效果对照研究。

entries.source_title: A critique of the mathematical economy
entries.source_excerpt: We present a theoretical framework to understand mathematics, and the disruptive effect of AI in our field. Treating mathematics as an economy, we borrow ideas from the theory of value to uncover the hidden dynamics of prestige, attribution, and the job market.
entries.title_zh: 对数学经济的批判
entries.summary_zh: 作者提出把数学活动看作一种经济的理论框架，借用价值理论分析声望、贡献归属和学术就业市场，并讨论 AI 对这些机制的扰动。现有摘录没有给出框架定义、经验材料或具体政策结论，因此这是理论分析提案而非实证结论。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合关心数学社会学、学术激励和 AI 影响的研究者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把声望、署名和岗位联系到资源与价值分配结构。
entries.cynic_review: “数学经济”框架是否解释现实，需要概念论证和数据支持。
entries.paper_review: 摘要说明分析视角，具体论证仍需阅读全文。

entries.source_title: Adaptive Local Proper Orthogonal Decomposition via Graph Partitioning and Provable Error-Bounded Lossy Compression for Parametric Series in Finite-Dimensional Function Spaces
entries.source_excerpt: Authors: Roberto Nuca , Matteo Parsani , Lisandro Dalcin; Subjects: Numerical Analysis (math.NA); This listing provides paper metadata; open the original for the abstract.
entries.title_zh: 基于图划分的自适应局部 POD 与有误差界压缩
entries.summary_zh: Nuca、Parsani、Dalcin 的标题把图划分、自适应局部本征正交分解及参数序列有损压缩联系起来。当前仅有作者和数值分析领域信息，没有摘要，无法列出误差界、划分准则或压缩率。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 供降阶模型与科学数据压缩研究者追踪。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可进一步核对误差控制是否适合目标数据。
entries.cynic_review: 标题中的可证明保证需明确范数与前提。
entries.paper_review: 主题相关性明确，技术证据仍不足。

entries.source_title: Central limit theorem for the Smoluchowski--Kramers approximation
entries.source_excerpt: We establish the central limit theorem (CLT) for Smoluchowski--Kramers approximation of Langevin equations with state-dependent, possibly non-symmetric friction and multiplicative noise. To the best of our knowledge, this is the first such result, even in the case of constant friction and additive noise. The result differs in an essential way from classical averaging CLTs and reveals a new two-scale fluctuation phenomenon. The normalized difference process retains a persistent fast component and is generally not tight in $C([0,T];\mathbb{R}^d)$, thus the usual continuous-path CLT cannot hold. We derive an exact decomposition of the normalized difference into an accumulated slow fluctuation and a rapidly relaxing velocity correction. The auxiliary slow fluctuation converges to a linear diffusion driven by both the original Brownian motion and an additional independent Brownian noise whose effective covariance is characterized explicitly through a quadratic Poisson corrector. For every fixed $t>0$, the fast correction converges conditionally to its local Gaussian equilibrium. Consequently, the fixed-time fluctuation limit is identified
entries.title_zh: Smoluchowski–Kramers 近似的双尺度涨落极限
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究含状态依赖摩擦与乘性噪声的 Langevin 方程在过阻尼近似下的误差。归一化误差保留快速速度修正，通常不在连续路径空间紧，作者分离慢扩散与快速局部平衡，并得到固定时刻的高斯混合极限及定量速率。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合多尺度随机动力系统与近似误差分析。
entries.pragmatic_review: 揭示仅看慢变量会漏掉的误差。
entries.cynic_review: 固定时刻极限不等同于路径收敛。
entries.paper_review: 双尺度分解解释经典 CLT 框架为何失效。

entries.source_title: A Non-Split Motohashi Formula for Toric Periods over Number Fields
entries.source_excerpt: We establish a non-split Motohashi formula for toric Eisenstein periods over an arbitrary number field $F$. For a quadratic extension $E/F$, we compare toric Fourier inversion for a product of two Eisenstein series with the $\mathrm{GL}_2/F$-spectral expansion of its Rankin--Selberg kernel. The kernel regularizes the product in a cone of absolute convergence. Eisenstein corrections and contour residues give the geometric and residual terms in the meromorphically continued identity. Suitable test data give twisted first- and second-moment formulas for the completed $L$-functions of everywhere unramified toric characters. Over general $F$ these provide an adelic counterpart of the moment formulas of Duke--Friedlander--Iwaniec that does not use the geometry of Heegner points. In the CM case, we prove the absolute nonvanishing proportion $4.9\times10^{-4}$ for every totally real base field and all sufficiently large CM discriminants, with the threshold depending on the base field and no restriction on the number of ramified primes. We incorporate inverse Euler factors at small ramified primes into the mollifier. Local unit-group tests con
entries.title_zh: 数域上的非分裂 Motohashi 环积分公式
entries.summary_zh: 论文对任意数域 F 建立非分裂的 Motohashi 公式：针对二次扩张 E/F，把两个 Eisenstein 级数乘积的环 Fourier 反演与 GL₂/F 的 Rankin–Selberg 核谱展开联系起来，并用 Eisenstein 修正项和留数处理亚纯延拓。由此得到处处非分歧环特征的完备 L 函数扭曲一阶、二阶矩公式；在 CM 情形，对每个全实基域及充分大的 CM 判别式，证明绝对非消失比例至少 4.9×10⁻⁴，阈值依赖基域且不限制分歧素数个数。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合研究 L 函数矩与 CM 场算术的人，结果把经典矩方法推广到一般数域的 adelic 框架。
entries.pragmatic_review: 非消失比例给出明确的定量应用，但阈值仍需估计。
entries.cynic_review: 定量下界较小且只适用于充分大判别式，适用边界很重要。
entries.paper_review: 摘要明确陈述公式、矩估计与非消失结论，技术假设需阅读全文确认。

entries.source_title: Tmux 和 Claude Code：会话、Send-Keys 以及上限
entries.title_zh: 用 tmux 管理多个 Claude Code 与其他编程代理会话
entries.summary_zh: 这份实用指南把 tmux 用作代理会话管理层：按项目命名可分离会话、安排 pane 布局，用 send-keys 自动输入命令，再通过 capture-pane 读取运行输出，并用状态栏观察任务。作者也讨论并行代理到约四个时遇到的限制，并提醒先检查 Claude Code 是否已有内置能力；它解决的是终端组织与脚本控制，不会自动处理代理之间的代码冲突或权限隔离。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合在本地终端并行运行多个编程代理的人参考，同时避免把会话管理误当成任务协调。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可分离会话和可脚本化输入有助于长任务监控。
entries.cynic_review: 多代理数量增加后，日志阅读和共享文件冲突仍需另行管理。
entries.paper_review: 这是实践指南，文中上限属于作者经验而非通用性能测试。

entries.source_title: Training-Free Prompt Selection for Efficient Reinforcement Learning With Partial Rollouts
entries.source_excerpt: Reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) has emerged as a prominent paradigm for training reasoning models, but its computational cost makes efficient data selection increasingly important. Since training examples contribute unequally to learning, selecting a small, informative subset can offer a more efficient alternative to using the entire data pool. The training-free selection method estimates prompt value with hidden states from complete greedy rollouts. However, in our datasets, $26$--$32\%$ of these rollouts fail to terminate within the generation budget. We introduce LIFT, a training-free data selector that identifies impactful prompts using only partial reasoning rollouts. At its core, LIFT uses Partial Rollout Context Lift (PRCL), a score inspired by pointwise $\mathcal{V}$-information that accumulates token-level log-likelihood ratios between a question-conditioned context and a null context with the question removed. This enables prompt scoring from a short rollout prefix rather than a complete trajectory. Across Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B, prefixes retaining at least 90\% and 95\% of the f
entries.title_zh: LIFT：利用部分推理轨迹做免训练强化学习 prompt 选择
entries.summary_zh: RLVR 数据选择常依赖完整贪心 rollout，但论文在数据中发现 26–32% 轨迹无法在预算内结束；LIFT 因而只用短前缀，以问题条件上下文与空问题上下文的 token 对数似然比累积成 PRCL 分数来筛选有影响力的 prompt。方法在 Qwen2.5-Math-1.5B 和 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-1.5B 上评估，所给摘录未包含完整性能结果。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合减少数学推理 RL 训练数据筛选成本的研究团队。
entries.pragmatic_review: 避免完整 rollout 无法终止时造成的筛选缺失。
entries.cynic_review: 摘要缺少最终收益数值，选择分数与下游训练效果还需核验。
entries.paper_review: 问题、分数设计和测试模型明确，但结果摘录不全。

entries.source_title: Finitely Verifiable Segmentation: Decidability for Every Tokenizer with a Finite-State Verifier
entries.source_excerpt: A segmentation policy assigns to each byte string at most one segmentation into tokens. Call it finitely verifiable when a finite automaton over marked strings, bytes paired with boundary bits, accepts exactly the policy's own segmentations. The automaton judges a proposed segmentation and need not compute one. The paper shows what that hypothesis buys. Four questions that practice settles by folklore become decidable, whether a window certifies a token boundary, whether the boundary gap is bounded, whether a mask keeps generation completable, and whether two policies are equivalent. The last three specialize limitedness, coaccessibility and the equivalence of single-valued transducers. The first refines the synchronizing cut of code theory, and two more ask whether a certified cut, or the cuts of an inventory, let each piece scan alone. The class sits strictly between the online-scannable policies and those with regular domains, and its inner frontier is Choffrut's and decidable in polynomial time. Markings are length-preserving, so the class is exactly the rational segmentation policies, a normal form rather than a restriction, an
entries.title_zh: 有限状态可验证分词策略的可判定性质
entries.summary_zh: 论文以有限自动机验证字节及边界标记，从而判断局部窗口能否认证边界、边界间隙是否有界、生成掩码是否仍可补全及策略是否等价。框架还讨论组合封闭性、逐段扫描与概率源的精确统计，覆盖最大匹配、标准 BPE 和特定 WordPiece，并提供可执行检查。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合 tokenizer、受约束生成与词法分析工具开发。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可把分词边界的经验假设变成可检查条件。
entries.cynic_review: 判定依赖所给验证器和策略类别。
entries.paper_review: 自动机与转导器理论统一多个工程问题。

entries.source_title: AI fusion cuisine: On the latest research article of Jacob Tsimerman
entries.source_excerpt: The most unexpected source of AI-free research.
entries.title_zh: AI 融合料理：谈 Jacob Tsimerman 的最新研究论文
entries.summary_zh: Oliver Bräunling 以 Jonathan Pila 与 Jacob Tsimerman 声明其预印本研究和写作未使用 AI 为切入点，质疑 AI 声明能否准确标记研究思想的来源，因为学者可能通过阅读和交流间接受到 AI 影响。他担心把“AI-free”作为区分可能加剧代际与学术共同体分裂，并强调应关注对年轻数学家的责任；文中也呈现了评论区对此观点的不同回应。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 文章把 AI 使用声明的可操作性与数学共同体中的代际压力联系起来，适合讨论披露规范的边界。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可帮助读者识别“未使用 AI”声明在实际学术交流中的解释难题。
entries.cynic_review: 作者把 AI 声明称为暂时有意义甚至可能是自我欺骗的工具，但这主要是个人判断，评论区也提出了反对意见。
entries.paper_review: 文章讨论的是规范与来源归属，没有对所提预印本的数学内容或其声明作独立核验。

entries.source_title: What the Specification Did Not Say: Specification-Oracle Gaps in Test-Graded Coding-Agent Benchmarks
entries.source_excerpt: Coding-agent benchmarks often describe a task in natural language but grade it with tests taken from the upstream project. Passing those tests can require information the description never states: a constant's name, a module path, an exact message. We call this a specification-oracle gap: where it exists, a benchmark also measures whether an agent reproduces upstream implementation details. We formalise the gap, including the inconsistencies that chains of dependent tasks add, and build a static audit for five languages that classifies every name-, path- and literal-level dependency of every scored test (held-out precision 89.2%, recall 92.9%). On SWE-Milestone (98 graded milestones, 35 published runs), 25 milestones contain a test that depends on an unstated, non-inferable name or path. Build units with such a dependency fail in 80.6% of runs, against 48.4% for comparable units without one, and withholding a single hidden name from the reference stops its unit's tests from compiling in 126 of 128 cases. The leaderboard's ranking is robust to removing the affected tests, but they shift scores within repositories and favour agents that
entries.title_zh: 编码智能体基准中的规格与测试裁判缺口
entries.summary_zh: 论文审计测试是否依赖需求未写明的名称、路径或字面量，并构建五种语言的静态工具。SWE-Milestone 中部分任务存在不可推断依赖，隐藏名称会使参考实现无法编译；删除受影响测试后总排名较稳，但库内分数仍改变，提示测试通过率混入复现上游细节的能力。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合设计更公平的编码任务和验收标准。
entries.pragmatic_review: 需求应写明测试真正要求的外部接口。
entries.cynic_review: 静态审计仍有误报漏报，相关失败率非纯因果估计。
entries.paper_review: 规格与判分器一致性值得纳入基准质量。

entries.source_title: Is it fish love?
entries.source_excerpt: Mathematicians are humans, and humans have emotions. This essay scratches the surface of an intricate issue behind a very simple question: in what ways and to what extent are mathematicians’ reactions to AI driven by emotion?
entries.title_zh: 这算是爱数学吗？
entries.summary_zh: 作者借“吃鱼却说爱鱼”的寓言，区分喜爱数学问题本身与喜爱做出新发现时的成就感，并据此审视不同数学家对 AI 的态度。文章认为 AI 可能扩大探索、同时削弱长期思考、理解和年轻人进入数学的吸引力；作者主张保留理解与扎实验证的习惯，并非简单支持全面放开或全面禁止。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把 AI 争论落到数学实践的动机、学习过程和研究共同体吸引力上，适合与职业制度讨论互补阅读。
entries.pragmatic_review: 提醒教育者同时设计 AI 探索和独立理解的训练。
entries.cynic_review: 文章是个人反思，不能代表数学共同体对 AI 的一致看法。
entries.paper_review: 提供概念框架与价值讨论，没有提出经验性研究。

entries.source_title: Army Cyber Command's ECHOTRIBBLE would turn AI agents into self-spreading cyberweapons
entries.source_excerpt: 据 The Intercept 获取的文件，美国陆军网络司令部（ARCYBER）正在开发代号 ECHOTRIBBLE 的平台，让 AI 智能体自主在网络间移动、识别并清除威胁目标，之后自毁，且须在极少人工监督下运行。
entries.title_zh: 美国陆军网络司令部的 ECHOTRIBBLE 或将让 AI 智能体自主扩散
entries.summary_zh: The Intercept 报道称，美国陆军网络司令部正在开发 ECHOTRIBBLE，使 AI 智能体能在网络间自主移动、寻找并清除目标，之后自毁，并在极少人工监督下运行。当前摘要来自媒体对所获文件的描述，尚不能据此确认系统已部署或具备这些能力。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合关注自主网络行动、军事 AI 治理和监督边界的读者。
entries.pragmatic_review: 涉及高自主网络行动及其监督风险，政策意义突出。
entries.cynic_review: 信息依赖媒体取得的文件，计划、原型与实战能力需区分。
entries.paper_review: 未提供技术规格或官方确认，证据目前属于报道层面。

entries.source_title: Weakly uniform computable categoricity and function composition
entries.source_excerpt: We introduce the definition of a weakly $X$-uniformly $Y$-computably categorical structure, relativizing a definition of Kudinov (1996), and show that this relativized notion is closely related to the 2-dimensional complexity of the pairs of partial functions $(f,g)$ with the property that the composition $g\circ f$ simulates convergent $\emptyset'$-oracle computations. We develop a general theory for computing via composition and use it to prove results about the surprisingly complex weakly uniform categoricity spectrum of the structure $(\omega,S)$ where $S(n)=n+1$. Namely, that $(\omega,S)$ is w.$X$.u.$Y$.c.c. for some $X\not\geq_T\emptyset'$ and $Y<_T\emptyset'$, but $(\omega,S)$ is not w.$X$.u.$Y$.c.c. for any $X<_T\emptyset'$ and $Y\not\geq_T\emptyset'$. We also construct a computably categorical structure that is not w.$\emptyset'$.u.c.c., but is w.$X$.u.c.c. for a set $X$ that is $\leq_T$-incomparable with $\emptyset'$.
entries.title_zh: 弱一致可计算范畴性与函数复合
entries.summary_zh: 作者引入相对化的 weakly X-uniformly Y-computably categorical 概念，并联系到两部分偏函数复合模拟空集跳跃 oracle 计算的复杂度。对后继结构 (ω,S)，证明其弱一致范畴谱存在细致的 Turing 度现象，并构造一个可计算范畴结构：它不是弱一致 ∅′-可计算范畴，却对一个与 ∅′ 不可比较的集合 X 具有相应性质。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合可计算模型论读者理解结构分类的相对化复杂度。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把结构范畴性与函数复合计算能力建立明确联系。
entries.cynic_review: 结论使用多种相对 Turing 度条件，技术范围较窄。
entries.paper_review: 摘要给出定义方向、典型结构和反例型结果。

entries.source_title: Energy of signed graphs and the vertex cover number
entries.source_excerpt: The energy $\mathcal{E}(\Gamma)$ of a signed graph $\Gamma=(G,\sigma)$ is the sum of the absolute values of the eigenvalues of its adjacency matrix $A(\Gamma)$. In this article, we prove that $\mathcal{E}(\Gamma)\geq 2\tau(G)$, where $\tau(G)$ is the vertex cover number of $G$. The case of unsigned graphs, a 1980s conjecture proved only recently, is a special case of this result. Moreover, we completely characterize the equality case: equality holds if and only if every connected component of $\Gamma$ is switching equivalent to an \emph{additive rook graph} $\Rook_N(a,b)$. This graph is constructed on an $N\times N$ board with $a_i+b_j$ vertices on square $(i,j)$. Two vertices are joined by a positive edge if they share only a row, and by a negative edge if they share only a column. As consequences, we obtain a balanced/antibalanced trichotomy for the extremal signed graphs and deduce the characterization of the extremal unsigned graphs. Finally, an example shows that the bound does not extend to the Hermitian adjacency matrices of mixed graphs or to complex unit gain graphs.
entries.title_zh: 符号图能量与顶点覆盖数
entries.summary_zh: 对符号图 Γ，作者证明邻接矩阵能量（特征值绝对值之和）满足 E(Γ)≥2τ(G)，其中 τ 是底层图的顶点覆盖数，并刻画等号成立当且仅当每个连通分量切换等价于 additive rook graph。由此得到极值符号图的平衡/反平衡分类及普通图特例；同时给出该下界不能直接推广到混合图 Hermitian 邻接矩阵或复单位增益图的例子。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合谱图论读者关注谱能量如何界定组合覆盖参数。
entries.pragmatic_review: 证明一般化不等式、刻画等号并明确指出推广失效处。
entries.cynic_review: 结论依赖符号图的切换结构，其他图模型不能直接套用。
entries.paper_review: 数学结论、极值刻画和反例边界都清楚。

entries.source_title: Reconstruction-Optimized Expert Pruning for Mixture-of-Experts Language Models
entries.source_excerpt: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models reduce computation through sparse expert activation, but deployment still requires storing a large number of expert parameters. We study post-training expert pruning using task-domain calibration data as a subset-selection problem: given a pretrained MoE layer, select a fixed number of experts that best reconstruct its original output. Exact subset search is combinatorial and becomes intractable for modern MoE models with many experts per layer. We develop OptEP, a scalable continuous relaxation that directly optimizes differentiable expert-selection variables, followed by a lightweight reconstruction-based update of the retained expert weights. Across multiple MoE architectures and tasks spanning mathematical reasoning and code generation, our approach improves over the strongest existing expert-pruning baselines, with absolute accuracy gains of up to 15.05% on Qwen3-30B-A3B, 14.55% on Qwen3-235B-A22B, 11.06% on GLM-4.5-Air, and 16.20% on Mixtral-8x7B. entries.source_title: RL-IF: Tracking Non-local Training Data Influence for Online Reinforcement Learning
entries.source_excerpt: Online reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved significant success in decision-making tasks, but modern online RL remains highly sensitive to the quality of training experience. Understanding the contribution of individual training instances is therefore central to data-centric RL, with applications ranging from experience selection to policy interpretation. Existing data attribution methods for online RL primarily focus on local influence within a single training round, overlooking the non-local data influence across multiple training rounds. In this work, we formalize data attribution in online RL through a trajectory-level leave-one-out quantity, RL-LOO, which measures how one training sample influences a downstream target after subsequent online updates have taken place. We then derive RL-IF, a first-order estimator that propagates data influence through both optimization effects and policy-induced sampling effects, and provide theoretical guarantees on its approximation accuracy under smoothness assumptions. entries.title_zh: RL-IF：追踪在线强化学习中的非局部训练数据影响

entries.source_title: LSA-PAST: Layer-Specific Adaptation and Prototype Transport for Compositional Incremental Learning
entries.source_excerpt: Class-Incremental Learning (CIL) enables models to recognize new classes over time while retaining prior knowledge, but many real-world problems are compositional, where visual concepts arise from combinations of primitives such as states (i.e., red, shiny) and objects (i.e., shoe, car). Standard CIL methods treat each composition as an independent class, ignoring shared primitives and providing no mechanism to stabilize their representations as new compositions arrive. This causes parameter updates to entangle primitives and induce drift that degrades performance on earlier compositions. Compositional Incremental Learning (composition-IL) formalizes this setting by introducing new state-object compositions across tasks. In this paper, we propose Layer-Specific Adaptation with Prototype-Anchored Adapter-Space Transport (LSA-PAST), a parameter-efficient method tailored to composition-IL. LSA integrates Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) into a frozen ViT with depth-specialized adapters for states, objects, and compositions. entries.title_zh: LSA-PAST：组合增量学习的分层适配与原型迁移

entries.source_title: Anisotropic Representation Dynamics in Transformers
entries.source_excerpt: Small differences between internal representations can shrink or grow as they pass through a Transformer layer, affecting how information is preserved and how sensitive the model is to perturbations. Yet it remains unclear when changes in attention weights can turn a representation difference that would otherwise shrink into one that grows. We develop a \textbf{Mixture-Gated Theory of Anisotropic Representation Dynamics} that separates self-attention into value transport, query gating, and key gating. Our analysis reveals how the geometry of attended representations constrains gating and how interactions between these mechanisms can reverse contraction induced by value transport. We formalize this phenomenon as gating-induced regime switching, where a representation difference contracts under fixed attention routing but expands under full attention. We derive a necessary and sufficient spectral criterion that certifies the existence or absence of switching and identifies switching directions without exhaustive search. entries.source_title: Rethinking SAE Evaluation: An Atomic Interpretable Unit Framework Reveals Hidden Polysemanticity and Redundancy
entries.source_excerpt: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) were originally motivated by discovering monosemantic features, a property that characterizes individual features but does not specify what the learned feature set should look like as a whole. As SAEs have increasingly been adopted for attribution, circuit discovery, and intervention, researchers have begun evaluating metrics that describe global properties of the feature set, such as sparsity, dead feature rates, reconstruction fidelity, and disentanglement, a diverse set that extends far beyond monosemanticity. However, this implicit shift beyond monosemanticity has not been formalized as a clear, well-defined objective that comes before these evaluation metrics. Without such an objective, existing metrics remain ad hoc, with their necessity unjustified. In this work, we formalize this ultimate objective by introducing a new paradigm for SAE evaluation: requiring that SAE features, and more generally dictionary-based decompositions of model representations, form an atomic interpretable unit basis, a coordinate system for semantically meaningful explanation. entries.source_title: Speculative Acceptance Does Not Decay with Position: A Full-Length Diagnostic on Long Chain-of-Thought with Independent Drafts
entries.source_excerpt: The claim that speculative-decoding acceptance rate decays as a chain-of-thought grows longer has become a de facto industry narrative, motivating draft-model co-design and position-aware training. Nearly all direct evidence comes from trained drafters whose offline training length is far shorter than inference, so a purely positional law has never been isolated. We present the first systematic, full-length measurement of acceptance rate as a function of generation position on MATH-500 (all 500 problems), under greedy and sampling decoding, with two independent drafts against DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-7B: a same-family draft (DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-1.5B) and a cross-family draft (Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct), yielding about 1.78M verification rounds. Using within-problem paired tests, we find that after isolating a greedy-decoding repetition pathology, acceptance rate does not decay with position in any of the four configurations within the supported ranges (greedy 0-8K, sampling 0-12K); the second half of each trajectory is slightly but significantly higher than the first. entries.source_title: Bengali Hallucination Detection with Retrieval and Programs: A System Study
entries.source_excerpt: Bengali hallucination detection must distinguish unsupported factual claims from incorrect reasoning, often without a supplied reference passage. We present and characterize an inference-only system that combines response-conditioned query rewriting, hybrid retrieval, and task-specific language-model judging. Six retrieval routes search question-answer and passage collections; a router directs each example to a 27B textual judge or a 14B agent that can compare retrieved answers, reason directly, or generate and execute Python. We characterize the system using version-specific code, saved predictions, execution traces, and corpus metadata from the Olikbochon challenge. Kaggle associates a displayed private macro-F1 of 0.956 with Version 2; its saved run processes 2,516 examples in 220.99 minutes on two T4 GPUs. Of 253 math-routed examples, 88 terminate through candidate matching, while execution traces expose 49 stderr-bearing run events across 35 examples. entries.source_title: A Kleene-inspired sequent system for a minimal logic of evidence and truth
entries.source_excerpt: This paper investigates the proof theory of the logic of evidence and truth LETFm, with the aim of obtaining a sequent calculus consisting only of logical rules, suitable for a simple bottom-up decision procedure. We begin with G1f, a sequent system containing structural rules, which makes explicit the main difficulties in obtaining a fully logical and decidable calculus for LETFm. We then introduce G3f, a G3-style system obtained from by applying Kleene's trick, which absorbs contraction into the logical rules by adding the principal formula of the rule to its premises.

entries.source_excerpt: We show that the problem of deciding whether a simplicial complex is partitionable is NP-complete in dimensions two and higher, answering a 1995 question of Kleinschmidt and Onn.

entries.source_title: The exact Euclidean window of $\mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{14}]$
entries.source_excerpt: Let $R = \mathbb{Z}[\sqrt{14}]$, let $\pi = 4 + \sqrt{14}$, and let $\mathfrak{p} = (2,\sqrt{14}) = \pi R$ be the prime ideal above $2$. Cavallar and Lemmermeyer studied the multiplicative weighted norms $\phi_{t}(x) = |N(x)|(t/2)^{v_{\pi}(x)}$ and asked for which weights $t$ they are Euclidean functions on $R$. We show that the set of these weights, the Euclidean window of $\mathfrak{p}$, is $(\sqrt{5},T]$, where $T$ is the algebraic number \[ T = \sqrt{\frac{8}{104051\sqrt{2} - 55617\sqrt{7}}} = 2.2468286690\ldots = \sqrt{5} + 0.0107606915\ldots. \] Thus the window is nonempty but not open. We also obtain the integer-valued completely multiplicative Euclidean function $2^{v_{\pi}(x)}|N(x)|^{6}$ on $R$.

entries.source_title: Identify, Classify, Act: Per-Instruction Controlled Compliance for LLMs over External Data
entries.source_excerpt: LLMs over external data face a per-instruction tension: a single document or tool return often interleaves legitimate directives with adversarial prompt injections, and the model must follow the former while rejecting the latter. Existing defenses suppress or trust all external instructions, collapsing the safety-utility frontier and forcing a choice between over-refusal and over-compliance. We argue the missing capability is \textbf{per-instruction credit attribution} and formalize it as External-Data Instruction Classification, an identify-classify-act decision over each embedded directive. We propose \textbf{EDIC}, a decomposed reward framework for per-instruction compliance. A scene-grounded pipeline injects mixed beneficial and harmful instructions with counterfactual filtering, while a generative judge is initialized by SFT and refined with GRPO to attribute compliance at the instruction level. The judge then produces a reward that separately encourages beneficial compliance and penalizes harmful compliance for RL training. entries.source_title: PArcK trees can get as hot as you want
entries.source_excerpt: We consider the combinatorial game Partizan Arc Kayles as a generalization of Domineering. An extensive technical search using genetic algorithms found hot positions of temperature exceeding 2. We discuss this search and construct a family of positions with high temperature that includes these graphs and prove that Partizan Arc Kayles has unbounded temperature. We identify an infinite family of second-player win positions as part of our main construction.

entries.source_title: A configurational numerical viscosity for thermodynamically compatible finite volume schemes of compressible multiphase flows
entries.source_excerpt: We consider the fluid subsystem of a variationally derived hyperbolic thermodynamically compatible (HTC) model of compressible multiphase flows. Its total energy is in general not convex in the natural state variables, so a scalar numerical viscosity acting on them need not produce non-negative entropy. Reformulating the equations in terms of the volume fractions separates changes in the amount of each phase from changes in its intrinsic state. This guides the construction of a configurational numerical viscosity in phase variables, in which the energy is convex, while the scheme retains the structure of the HTC model. At the semi-discrete level, the new schemes satisfy: I) local conservation of the phase masses, the mixture momentum and the total energy; II) a cell entropy inequality whose production is non-negative face by face and phase by phase, with no convexity assumption in the evolved variables and no clipping; III) positivity of the partial densities and volume fractions under explicit time-step conditions; IV) exact preservation of contact equilibria; V) equivalence with a scheme for the density-weighted volume fractions. entries.source_title: Triple Products of Correlated Multivariate Hermite Polynomials
entries.source_excerpt: Stochastic Galerkin schemes (SGS) are used to approximate solutions to differential equations with stochastic parameters. In particular, they express the solution with an infinite orthogonal functional basis of the parameter space and derive a deterministic system of PDEs; the solution of this deterministic system can be used to produce a {surrogate} approximation of the original stochastic equations. When the parameters are correlated, the infinite series representation of the solution does not provably converge for all joint distributions; further, classic decorrelating transformations (e.g., Roseblatt) often introduce known numerical instabilities. Rahman (2017) established convergence in probability and distribution for correlated {Gaussian} parameters when the basis functionals are {multivariate Hermite polynomials} (MHPs), where these polynomials are only {weakly orthogonal} with respect to the underlying joint density. entries.source_title: Stationary Half-space Geometric Last Passage Percolation without Random Shift
entries.source_excerpt: We derive exact formulas for the diagonal distribution of half-space geometric last-passage percolation with a two-parameter family of stationary initial conditions throughout the phase diagram. Unlike previous results, our formulas remove the random shift at the origin. Under critical scaling, we obtain new formulas for the half-space stationary KPZ fixed-point distribution at $x=0$ in the high-density and maximal-current phases. In the low-density phase, we derive a new representation and show that it matches the corresponding formula from the stationary log-gamma polymer.

entries.source_title: There is no universal $F_σ$ equivalence relation
entries.source_excerpt: Rosendal proved that any $K_\sigma$ equivalence relation is Borel reducible to $\ell_\infty$. We prove that for every $F_\sigma$ equivalence relation $F$ on a Polish space, there is an $F_\sigma$ real linear subspace $H$ of $\ell_2$ such that the coset relation $x\mathrel{E_H}y$ if and only if $x-y\in H$ has no Baire-measurable reduction to $F$. In particular, there is no $F_\sigma$ equivalence relation universal under Borel reducibility for all $F_\sigma$ equivalence relations. This answers a question of Rosendal.

entries.source_title: Volterra-Skorokhod Reflection and Fluid Limits of Loss Queues
entries.source_excerpt: In the $G_t/G/n/n$ loss queue, a customer blocked at time $u$ remains missing from the system for as long as it would have been served. A fraction $K(t-u)$ of the blocking at $u$ therefore still affects the occupancy at time $t$, where $K=1-G$ is the service survival function. We show that, for every arrival process satisfying a functional strong law of large numbers, the fluid limit of this queue is a reflection with kernel $K$ of the fluid limit of the associated infinite-server queue. The reflection is defined by a one-sided reflection problem on $(-\infty,1]$ in which the regulator is convolved with a memory kernel. We refer to this problem as the Volterra-Skorokhod problem. We show existence and uniqueness of the solution and that the solution map is Lipschitz continuous in the uniform norm and nonanticipating. entries.title_zh: 损失队列流体极限的 Volterra–Skorokhod 反射

entries.source_title: A Central Limit Theorem for Intrinsic Fr\'echet Means on Real Grassmannians
entries.source_excerpt: Subspace-valued data arise in dimension reduction, image-set and video recognition, and signal processing, and the Fr\'echet mean is their standard sample mean [11,9,15,23]. We establish a central limit theorem for the intrinsic sample Fr\'echet mean of i.i.d. observations on the real Grassmann manifold $\mathrm{Gr}(p,n)$, as a specialization of the general theorem of [18]. Unlike prior results which require the distribution to vanish or place negligible mass near the cut locus of the population mean, we allow a continuous, possibly positive density. To enable our results, we derive two properties of $\mathrm{Gr}(p,n)$: the first is that the union of the cut loci of all points within distance $\delta$ of the mean has volume $O(\delta)$. The second is that the Hessian of the squared distance function is integrable. We also give a smooth density on $\mathrm{Gr}(1,2)$ for which the mean is unique but the Fr\'echet Hessian vanishes.

entries.source_excerpt: We consider nonlinear ill-posed operator equations $F(x)=y$ in a Hilbert space, where $F$ is monotone with a Lipschitz continuous Fr\'echet derivative that is self-adjoint near the solution $x^\dg$ (a locally \emph{potential} operator), and only noisy data $y^\delta$ with unknown noise norm $\delta:=\|y-y^\delta\|$ is available. For the nonstationary iterated Lavrentiev regularization \[ x_{k+1}^\delta=x_k^\delta-\bigl(F'(x_k^\delta)+\alpha_kI\bigr)^{-1}\bigl(F(x_k^\delta)-y^\delta+\alpha_k(x_k^\delta-x_0)\bigr), \] all classical stopping rules require $\delta$. We analyze a \emph{noise-level-free} parameter-choice rule of retrospective type, selecting a minimizer $k_*$ of $\theta(k,y^\delta)=\|F(x_k^\delta)-y^\delta\|^2/\alpha_k^2$ over a finite computed window. Under a standard noise condition (necessary in view of the Bakushinskii veto) the rule is well defined and $\alpha_{k_*}^2\ge c\,\delta/\|x_0-x^\dg\|$. entries.source_title: Reusable QUBO-Derived Block-Schur Inverse Factors for Fixed-Operator Finite-Difference PDE Solvers
entries.source_excerpt: Many simulations of partial differential equations require the repeated solution of linear systems whose matrix remains fixed while the righthand side changes. We present a hybrid offline online framework for this setting. The discretized operator is organized into small coupled blocks and reduced through block Schur complements. Instead of expressing the complete PDE solution as one large binary optimization problem, quadratic unconstrained binary optimization is used only to construct reusable local inverse factors. These factors are computed during an offline stage, decoded and stored, and then reused in an ordinary classical block solve for subsequent righthand sides. The optimizer facing problem size is governed by the local block size and chosen numerical precision, rather than by the dimension of the full spatial grid. We develop the mathematical formulation, analyze the accuracy and resource requirements of the binary representation, and examine the method on representative finite difference PDE problems, including execution of the local optimization stage on quantum optimization hardware. entries.source_title: A high-order multi-scale method and its error analysis for nonlocal-in-time fractionally damped wave problems in composite materials
entries.source_excerpt: Significant spatial heterogeneity and nonlocal history-dependent attenuation jointly govern wave propagation in composite materials, making full-scale direct numerical simulation (DNS) computationally prohibitive. This study proposed a high-order multi-scale (HOMS) method for nonlocal-in-time fractionally damped wave problems with highly oscillatory and discontinuous material coefficients. Using a multi-scale asymptotic expansion approach, the macroscopic homogenized equation, and first- and second-order correction terms are derived to construct the high-accuracy HOMS solution. Moreover, a local pointwise error analysis identifies the leading residual eliminated by this HOMS solution and validates its local physical balance preservation. Then, a global energy-norm error estimate establishes the $O(\varepsilon)$-order convergence rate for the HOMS solution. entries.source_title: Structure-Preserving Dimension Reduction and Surrogates for Partially Linear Bayesian Inverse Problems
entries.source_excerpt: Many Bayesian inverse problems are characterized by two parameter vectors with distinct roles. A medium property, operator coefficient, or geometry block enters the forward model nonlinearly, whereas a volumetric, initial condition, or boundary condition source enters linearly. General-purpose nonlinear surrogates must relearn this known source dependence from data and may not preserve the correct source scaling outside the training regime. We introduce a structure-preserving partially linear (SPPL) framework that constructs separate reduced spaces for outputs, (linearly appearing) sources, and (nonlinearly appearing) medium variables and represents the reduced forward map as an affine function of the retained source coordinates, with coefficients that depend on the medium variables. Here, "affine" refers to the retained, mean-centered source coordinates: the physical forward map remains linear in the source, while the affine offset is induced by the source-prior mean and vanishes when that mean is zero. entries.source_title: From Wheel to Jahangir graphs: spectra and energy under structured edge deletion
entries.source_excerpt: The energy of a graph, introduced by Gutman, is defined as the sum of the absolute values of the eigenvalues of its adjacency matrix. In this work we study how the energy of the Wheel graph $W_n$ changes when a specific set of spokes is removed. The resulting graphs are precisely the Jahangir graphs $J_{m,n}$, where m divides n, and which may also be viewed as the Cycle graph $C_n$ together with an additional vertex adjacent to certain vertices of $C_n$ in a cyclic pattern. We determine the spectra of $J_{2,n}$, $J_{4,n}$, and $J_{6,n}$ by exploiting a factorization of their characteristic polynomials arising from equitable partitions. This yields explicit closed formulas for their energies. Moreover, under certain conditions, we establish the following monotonicity chain: \[\mathcal{E}(C_n) \;\leq\; \mathcal{E}(J_{6,n}) \;\leq\; \mathcal{E}(J_{4,n}) \;\leq\; \mathcal{E}(J_{2,n}) \;\leq\; \mathcal{E}(W_n).\]

entries.source_title: CME-SpectrumBench: Can LLMs Analyze Condensed Matter Spectral Data?
entries.source_excerpt: Large Language Models (LLMs) are presently well assessed by expert-level mathematics and physics benchmarks which focus on theoretical, symbolic reasoning. However, we lack experimental benchmarks that evaluate data analysis in frontier research problems, a capability that future domain-specific foundation models must have. To this end, we present CME-SpectrumBench, an expert-designed benchmark consisting of 190 questions that measures how reliably frontier LLMs analyze research-level spectral scientific data in condensed matter experiments (CME). Using simulated CME spectral data, we prompt models to identify structures from 2D intensity arrays in the face of noise and limited instrumental resolution, a test of dense context reasoning. Models are scored by how accurately their numerical answers approach the ground truth. Under direct query, scores generally pale in comparison to handwritten code due to clear failure modes: models can find simple features but struggle to trace patterns or compute derived quantities, and performance typically degrades with increased data resolution and noise/convolution levels. entries.source_title: GIFT: Gradient Informed Filtering for Distillation Augmented Reasoning RL
entries.source_excerpt: Training large language models for complex reasoning tasks relies on two complementary signals: sparse, outcome-grounded reinforcement learning (RL) for correctness, and dense, token-level distillation for guidance. However, complementarity in supervision does not guarantee compatibility in optimization; imitation-focused distillation can conflict with the outcome-driven RL objective, and existing hybrids lack a principled resolution. We propose \textbf{GIFT} (\textbf{G}radient-\textbf{I}nformed \textbf{F}il\textbf{T}ering for Distillation-Augmented Reasoning RL), a novel method that directly addresses the allocation problem of which teacher updates to apply. GIFT performs a token-level geometric analysis, decomposing the distillation gradient into a component \textbf{parallel} to the RL gradient, which measures first-order conflict and provides a \textbf{safety} filter, and a component \textbf{orthogonal} to it, which quantifies novel directional guidance and provides a measure of \textbf{value}. entries.source_title: Batched Contextual Reinforcement II: Does RLVR Need Long Rollout Windows?
entries.source_excerpt: Long rollout windows make reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards (RLVR) expensive, yet simply shortening them can remove the correctness signal: when every single-problem rollout truncates before an answer, group-relative accuracy advantages vanish. As a technical continuation of Batched Contextual Reinforcement (BCR), we study how concurrent rewards relax this dependence on long windows. Concurrent Constraint Reinforcement (CCR) places three independently verifiable problems in one capped training completion. Correct answers completed before truncation retain credit, while a shared budget encourages shorter useful reasoning without an explicit length penalty. We connect this mechanism to conditional reward- and update-variance analyses and study 4B and 8B mathematical reasoning models. Against single-problem GRPO with a 32k window, CCR with an 8,000-token window reduces tokens per training step from 975,464 to 174,957 on 4B and from 793,832 to 165,788 on 8B, saving 82.1% and 79.1%, respectively. entries.source_title: TeCoP: Accelerating Diffusion Large Language Model Decoding via Tentative Context Pipelining
entries.source_excerpt: Diffusion large language models (dLLMs) predict multiple token positions per forward pass, yet block-wise decoders serialize generation and repeatedly recompute stable predictions. We attribute this inefficiency to coupling a prediction's readiness for irreversible commitment with its utility as context. We introduce Tentative Context Pipelining (TeCoP), a training-free decoder that decouples these roles through staggered block-parallel pipelining and draft-and-verify. TeCoP reuses stable but uncommitted predictions as provisional cross-block context, with commitment governed by confidence and stability checks. Across four LLaDA and Dream dLLMs on GSM8K, Minerva MATH, and MBPP, TeCoP reduces number of forward evaluations by up to 87% and achieves up to 7.50-fold throughput without KV caching and 11.77-fold with caching over the uncached original decoder. It outperforms Fast-dLLM and DSB in throughput across all 12 model-benchmark settings, with and without caching, while keeping average cached accuracy within one percentage point of the original decoder.
entries.title_zh: TeCoP：用暂定上下文流水线加速扩散语言模型解码
entries.summary_zh: 块式扩散语言模型每次预测多个位置，但传统解码串行提交各块并重复计算已稳定预测。TeCoP 是无需训练的解码器，将“预测可暂作上下文”与“是否不可逆提交”分开，通过错峰块并行和草拟—验证复用稳定但未提交的预测；在四个 LLaDA、Dream 模型的 GSM8K、Minerva MATH 和 MBPP 测试中，前向评估次数最多减少 87%，速度最高提升 7.50 倍。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 不改模型训练流程，仅调整暂定上下文与提交时机来减少重复前向计算。

entries.source_title: On the classification of threefold flops
entries.source_excerpt: We show that possibly singular threefold flopping contractions are completely classified by their associated derived contraction algebras, considered up to derived Morita equivalence; in contrast to the smooth case the extra derived structure is necessary in general. This extends previous work of the author on simple flops, and follows from a more general theorem about isolated hypersurface singularities. The key new input is to show that derived localisation at a Hochschild class is Morita invariant; this result raises some interesting questions related to the classification of recollements. We also show that derived contraction algebras admit a deformation-theoretic interpretation in families in a general setting that encompasses threefold flops, flips, and divisor-to-curve contractions.
entries.title_zh: 三维 flop 的分类
entries.summary_zh: 论文证明可能奇异的三维 flopping contraction 可由其导出 contraction algebra 在导出 Morita 等价意义下完全分类；相较光滑情形，一般必须保留额外导出结构。关键输入是证明对 Hochschild 类作导出局部化具有 Morita 不变性；作者还给出导出 contraction algebra 在包括 flop、flip 和 divisor-to-curve 收缩的族中的变形论解释。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合双有理几何与导出范畴研究者关注奇异三维变换的分类不变量。
entries.pragmatic_review: 说明奇异情形为何需要导出增强，并扩展到变形族。

entries.paper_review: 主要分类对象与关键不变性结论明确。

entries.source_title: Deflation-Based Spectral Preconditioning for the Conjugate Gradient Method on Perturbed Systems
entries.source_excerpt: We consider sequences of large symmetric positive-definite linear systems in which spectral information from a reference matrix $A$ is reused to accelerate the solution of a nearby system with perturbed matrix $A(t)=A+tE$, where $E$ is symmetric, $\|E\|_F=1$, and $t\geq0$ is the perturbation size. We compare deflated conjugate gradient (deflated CG) with preconditioned CG (PCG) equipped with a scaled spectral preconditioner constructed from the same spectral information of $A$. First, we derive an energy-norm error characterization of deflated CG. We then use perturbation analysis to show that, after one additional PCG iteration, the squared PCG error is bounded, up to terms of order $t^2$, by an explicit multiple of the squared deflated CG error. This result clarifies the role of the scaling parameter in the preconditioner. Experiments show that the scaled spectral preconditioner recovers much of the convergence improvement provided by deflation while requiring fewer products with $A(t)$.
entries.title_zh: 扰动系统共轭梯度法的谱预条件
entries.summary_zh: 论文考虑对称正定矩阵 A 的已知谱信息如何复用于邻近扰动系统 A(t)=A+tE，并比较谱消元共轭梯度与采用缩放谱预条件器的 PCG。作者刻画 deflated CG 的能量范数误差，再证明在额外一次 PCG 迭代后，其平方误差在二阶扰动项之外可由 deflated CG 误差的显式倍数控制；实验表明缩放预条件器能恢复大部分消元带来的收敛改进，同时减少对扰动矩阵的乘法调用。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 给出复用参考谱信息加速近邻线性系统的误差比较，并解释预条件缩放参数的作用。
entries.pragmatic_review: 适合参数扫描或重复求解相近大型正定线性系统。
entries.cynic_review: 误差比较是小扰动展开，实际收益仍依赖谱信息质量和扰动规模。
entries.paper_review: 理论误差界与计算成本实验相互补充。

entries.source_title: No-Regret Revenue Maximization in Sequential Market Making Under Inventory Constraints
entries.source_excerpt: Market makers keep trading efficient by setting bid and ask prices for buyers and sellers. In sequential market making, trades happen independently based on price thresholds, requiring the market maker to maintain balanced, low-risk inventory over T rounds. This paper studies how to maximize revenue with unknown buyer and seller valuations using regret minimization. When the market maker only sees trade success or failure, an algorithm achieves regret and inventory bounds proportional to T to the power of 2/3. When full order book data is available for failed trades, regret and inventory limits improve significantly to the square root of T. We also establish a fundamental trade-off via a lower bound, by proving that tighter round-by-round inventory limits strictly force higher minimum regret.
entries.title_zh: 库存约束下序贯做市的无悔收益最大化
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究买卖双方估值未知时，做市商如何在 T 轮交易中最大化收益并控制库存风险。仅观察交易成败时，算法的 regret 与库存界为 T^(2/3) 量级；失败订单也能看到完整订单簿时可改进至 √T，并证明更紧的逐轮库存限制必然带来更大的最小 regret。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合在线市场机制与算法交易研究者理解信息可见性和风险约束的代价。
entries.pragmatic_review: 把库存限制与收益 regret 的基本权衡刻画出来。

entries.paper_review: 分别给出两种反馈条件下的上界和下界权衡。

entries.source_title: ReuF2F: Benchmarking Coding Agents on Formalized Undergraduate Research Problems
entries.source_excerpt: As AI systems begin to resolve open research problems, reliable verification becomes increasingly important. Formal mathematics provides a trusted framework for mathematical reasoning, enabling agents to produce machine-checkable proofs while conducting mathematical exploration. Existing formal mathematics benchmarks often focus on known results or a small set of prominent open problems, which can become difficult to evaluate reliably once solutions are discovered and widely disseminated. Existing evaluation protocols are also not always aligned with how modern coding agents operate. We therefore introduce ReuF2F, a Lean 4 benchmark of 244 formalized open problems drawn from Research Experiences for Undergraduates (REU), spanning entry-level open research problems across a broad range of mathematical subfields. We expect these less prominent open problems, which tend to attract less attention and may remain unsolved for longer, to be better suited for held-out evaluation of end-to-end open problem resolution in Lean. We adopt a standard coding-agent evaluation setting, placing each problem and its logical negation into a Lean project
entries.title_zh: ReuF2F：形式化本科研究问题的编程代理基准
entries.summary_zh: ReuF2F 是一个 Lean 4 基准，包含 244 个来自本科研究体验项目（REU）的形式化开放问题，覆盖多个数学领域的入门级研究问题。它针对传统形式化数学基准偏重已知定理或少量知名猜想、且现代编程代理评测流程不匹配的问题，提供可机器检查证明的研究型任务集合；基准质量仍取决于题目难度和形式化覆盖。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 把真实本科研究题转成可验证 Lean 任务，扩展形式化数学代理评测。
entries.pragmatic_review: 可用于测量 coding agents 在开放式数学形式化中的能力。
entries.cynic_review: 题目数量与来源多样性有限，不能代表全部研究数学。
entries.paper_review: 基准规模和任务来源明确，强调形式化可核验。

entries.source_title: postgres-ai/postgresai

entries.title_zh: postgresai：面向人类与 AI 智能体的 PostgreSQL 可观测性工具
entries.summary_zh: postgresai 提供 PostgreSQL 健康检查、监控指标和根因分析，并以结构化 JSON 输出供 LLM 或智能体使用；项目资料列出 45 项以上健康检查、Grafana 仪表板、定期报告、Claude Code 插件和 MCP server。资料称 Express checkup 可用 `--no-upload` 生成本地结果，而 Markdown 转换需要上传完整报告 JSON 至 PostgresAI API。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 个人开发者或科研团队维护 PostgreSQL 时，可用它检查查询、索引和配置问题；本地 JSON 模式也适合把诊断结果交给自己的 LLM 分析。

entries.cynic_review: 项目宣传的生产环境经验和诊断安全性来自维护方自述，且完整监控栈需要 Linux、Docker 等环境，托管功能也依赖账户或 API。
entries.paper_review: README 列出 CLI 与 reporter 的覆盖率徽章及生产安全设计，但未在材料中提供独立审计或覆盖率数字，无法据此核验其生产环境表现。

project_insight.translation_zh: postgresai 是面向人类和 AI 智能体的 PostgreSQL 可观测性工具，提供监控、健康检查与根因分析。项目列出结构化 AI 输出、问题跟踪流程、45 项以上健康检查、Active Session History 和专家仪表板。
project_insight.one_liner_zh: 通过 CLI 检查 PostgreSQL 健康状况，并向人或 AI 提供结构化诊断结果的工具。
project_insight.getting_started_zh: 先查看项目文档和许可证；若只想验证诊断流程，可从 Express checkup 入手，使用只读或测试数据库并选择 `--no-upload` 与 JSON 输出。运行数据库准备步骤前先用 `--print-sql` 审阅将执行的 SQL；持续监控则先确认 Linux、Docker 和 PostgreSQL 扩展要求。
project_insight.limitations_zh: 完整监控栈需要 Linux 与 Docker，且需启用 pg_stat_statements；在线控制台功能涉及账户或 API。README 说明 Markdown 转换会将完整报告 JSON 发送至 API，不能与 `--no-upload` 同用。项目展示的生产安全性与实战经验为维护方陈述。
use_cases_zh: 为个人项目或实验室 PostgreSQL 数据库检查索引、查询、膨胀和安全设置。
将本地 JSON 检查结果交给 LLM，辅助定位慢查询或制定后续排查步骤。
若需要持续监控，可评估其 Grafana 仪表板和 MCP Issues 工作流是否适合现有环境。

entries.source_title: The Projective Reed-Muller Code from Quartic Curves in the Projective Plane
entries.source_excerpt: We study the Hamming weight enumerator of the projective Reed-Muller code $\mathcal C_{2,4}$ over $\mathbf F_q$, with $\operatorname{char}(\mathbf F_q)>3$. We determine the geometrically reducible and singular contributions by combining incidence counts with counts of plane linear series on a fixed normalization. The line and conic configurations and the genus zero cases give explicit polynomials. The line-cubic and genus one cases give formulas involving class numbers. The genus two contribution is a finite sum over hyperelliptic models, using their point counts over $\mathbf F_q$ and $\mathbf F_{q^2}$ and their rational Weierstrass points. The remaining smooth contribution is the weighted point count distribution of nonhyperelliptic genus three curves.

entries.source_title: Codimension of Brill-Noether Loci on Abelian Surfaces and the First Segre Invariant
entries.source_excerpt: Let $X$ be an abelian surface of Picard rank 1 with ample generator $H$. We show that, for a Mukai vector $\mathbf{v}=(r,mH,\chi)$ with $r,m\geq 1$ and $\chi\leq 0$, the first Brill-Noether loci $\{E \;|\; H^0(E)\neq 0\}$ in $M_X(\mathbf{v})$ is nonempty of the expected codimension $1-\chi$. As an application, we study the rank 1 Segre invariant on these abelian surfaces. Specifically, for $\mathbf{v}$ a Mukai vector of a $\mu$-stable sheaf of $\mathrm{rank}\geq 2$, we compute the Segre invariant of the general sheaf in $M_X(\mathbf{v})$, and we determine the numbers which arise as the Segre invariant of a sheaf in $M_X(\mathbf{v})$.

entries.source_title: LogicVal:A Logic-Formalized Benchmark for Constraint Satisfaction in Text-to-Image Generation
entries.source_excerpt: Text-to-Image (T2I) generative models have made significant progress in producing high-fidelity images from natural-language prompts. Alongside this progress, numerous benchmarks have been developed to evaluate capabilities such as attribute binding, numeracy, spatial reasoning, and commonsense reasoning. In this work, we propose a new perspective on T2I evaluation by casting it as a constraint-satisfaction problem. We introduce a logical framework that formally specifies the benchmark domain, including objects, attributes, and relations, alongside the constraints that generated images must satisfy. We evaluated four state-of-the-art T2I models across 9 classes of constraints ranging from a single-object-attribute to multi-object relationships constraints involving logical operators ($\forall, \exists, count, \rightarrow$). Our results reveal a substantial gap between single-object and complex conditional multi-object relationship constraint classes, with the best-performing model achieving 98% accuracy on the former and just 53% on the latter. entries.source_title: Germwise singular Fourier--Mukai partnerships
entries.source_excerpt: We study how local behavior on the base controls whether integral transforms induce fully faithful functors or equivalences between singularity categories of proper flat families. By working with \'{e}tale germs, we show (under mild hypotheses) that the loci where this happens are open and are compatible with \'{e}tale base change. Moreover, we give examples, exhibit an autoequivalence of the singularity category which detects regularity of the base, and compute these loci for arithmetic families.

entries.source_title: Nondimensionalization, Variational Inequalities and Uncertainty Quantification in a Morphoelastic Model for Burn Injury Healing
entries.source_excerpt: Mathematical modelling of burn injury healing involves coupling biological processes with mechanical deformation, resulting in computationally stiff, nonlinear partial differential equations that severely limit the scalability of existing numerical solutions. We present a computational framework addressing these challenges. By nondimensionalizing the model and performing scaling analysis, we show that chemotaxis and inertia are negligible, permitting a quasi-static momentum approach. To enforce non-negativity constraints, we implement a Variational Inequality formulation using the Finite Element Method in FEniCSx, and verify it via numerical convergence studies and mass balances. We identify high-order parameter interactions, specifically equilibrium collagen density and signalling dynamics, as the primary drivers of solver stability. A sensitivity analysis of nearly four million simulations reveals that isolated parameter variations predominantly govern the maximum wound contraction. entries.source_title: A functional central limit theorem for the KPZ equation with narrow wedge initial data
entries.source_excerpt: In this article, we consider the Kardar-Parisi-Zhang (KPZ) equation with narrow wedge initial data. We prove a functional central limit theorem for the spatial average of the solution, which solves an open problem from Gu and Pu (2025). Our main tool is Clark-Ocone formula from Malliavin calculus, combined with an in-depth analysis of the increments of the solution. The main step is a moment bound for time increments of the normalized spatial integral. For this, we introduce a new technique, called a ``common-ray'' change of variables. Using the fact that Malliavin derivative of the solution satisfies a Chapman-Kolmogorov relation, we reduce the kernel differences at two times to spatial increments at one common time.

entries.source_title: Epi: Towards a Persistent, Self-Improving Agent for Autonomous Research
entries.source_excerpt: We present \'{E}pi, an autonomous research agent that sustains investigations across model sessions and evolves its methods through accumulated experience. \'{E}pi combines persistent research history, hierarchical memory, branching and independent review to maintain research continuity, learn from experiments, and explore and revisit alternative approaches. Its experiments run across session boundaries, and a fixed verifier evaluates their outputs. \'{E}pi produced 120 record-setting results, comprising 20 numerical bound records across 12 families and 100 construction records across eight families. These include an approximately 84-fold narrower interval for the $n$-queens constant and a more than 3.6-million-fold narrower rigorous interval for the quartic Feigenbaum attractor dimension. Exact dual certificates establish that the Cohn-Elkies linear-programming bound cannot be sharp in dimensions 10 and 11. Beyond numerical improvements, \'{E}pi gives a computer-assisted proof of Tuza's conjecture for split graphs with an eight-vertex clique part and at most three triangle-active neighborhood types, with arbitrary multiplicities. entries.source_title: On the existence of mixed orthogonal arrays of strength two with six factors
entries.source_excerpt: Orthogonal arrays are foundational objects in combinatorial design theory and experimental design theory, with broad applications in computer science, coding theory, and cryptography. In this paper, we investigate the existence for mixed orthogonal arrays of strength two with six factors, and propose several new constructions based on incomplete orthogonal Latin squares, incomplete transversal designs, and $\Sigma$-resolvable transversal designs. As a result, we show that the necessary conditions for the existence of such mixed orthogonal arrays are also sufficient, except for a small number of known exceptions and nine unsettled cases.

entries.source_title: Preserving Reasoning Diversity in Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards via Adaptive Replay
entries.source_excerpt: Reinforcement Learning with Verifiable Rewards (RLVR) improves the reasoning capabilities of large language models, but often reduces the diversity of their reasoning behaviors. We study this phenomenon from the perspective of finite-sample learning dynamics and show that limited on-policy rollouts can progressively suppress semantically distinct but equally rewarded reasoning modes. Once a mode becomes sufficiently under-sampled, standard on-policy RLVR rarely recovers it. Motivated by this observation, we propose TAR, a Targeted Adaptive Replay framework that preserves diverse correct reasoning behaviors already present in the base policy. TAR constructs a compact memory bank of diverse base-model solutions and selectively replays them through an adaptive mechanism that activates only when stored behaviors are being suppressed during RLVR. Across six mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two Qwen2.5 model scales, TAR consistently achieves a better balance between reasoning performance and diversity preservation than existing diversity-preserving post-training methods, while substantially reducing the forgetting of correct base-model

entries.source_title: Robust topology optimization of isogeometric Kirchhoff--Love shells by the Speed Method
entries.source_excerpt: This paper presents a framework for robust topology optimization of Kirchhoff-Love (KL) multi-patch shells using isogeometric analysis and non-matching meshes and provides a CAD-compatible method. The material distribution is optimized via a NURBS-based level set method, enabling accurate boundary representation and seamless export to standard CAD/CAM workflows. The shape derivative is computed using the speed method, yielding a volume-based formulation that avoids boundary approximations and aligns with the isogeometric principle of coarse, high-order discretizations. This eliminates the need for local refinement, adaptive quadrature, or trimming as the descent direction for the compliance and volume objectives are obtained through a biharmonic equation. The framework is extended to robust optimization under uncertainty, accounting for stochastic loading and material properties via Monte Carlo sampling and Gaussian Random Fields. Numerical examples demonstrate the method's efficiency and robustness across single- and multi-patch shells, reproducing literature results with fewer elements than traditional FEM or refined IGA approaches.

entries.source_title: Lean Finder V2: Semantic Search for Mathlib That Disambiguates User Queries
entries.source_excerpt: We introduce Lean Finder V2, a semantic search framework for Mathlib that disambiguates user queries through complementary model-level adversarial training and input-level query rewriting. Human mathematicians and coding agents rarely search Mathlib by providing detailed context. In practice, they query short properties, notation, aliases, or hypotheses, leaving much of the intended mathematics implicit. In contrast, existing Mathlib search engines unrealistically assume context-rich queries. The scarcity of real-world short queries paired with ground-truth Mathlib statements makes this ambiguity even more intractable. We argue that this is essentially a data problem. Through adversarial training, we scale up the generation of labeled short and ambiguous queries, and learn to disambiguate user queries at both model-level fine-tuning and input-level query rewriting. On the human-curated MathlibQR benchmark, our Lean Finder V2 sets a new state of the art, with at least 11% relative improvement over the previous best Mathlib semantic search engines. entries.source_title: MHeatmap: Two-Walk Laplacian Reordering and Mosaic Layout for Rectangular Matrix Visualization
entries.source_excerpt: Weighted rectangular matrices record relations between two types of objects, such as occupations and industries, documents and terms, origins and destinations, or annotated classes and computed clusters. Their heatmaps become difficult to read when arbitrary row and column orders scatter related objects, while equal size cells hide large differences in row and column totals. We present MHeatmap (Mosaic Heatmap), which addresses these problems in two stages. Two-Walk spectral seriation first represents the matrix as a weighted bipartite graph. Ordinary bipartite ordering uses only observed row to column links. Two-Walk also uses length-two walks, so rows that share columns and columns that share rows receive explicit similarity links. Sorting a Fiedler vector of the resulting graph Laplacian gives coordinated row and column orders. The Mosaic layout then partitions a unit square so that row height is proportional to the row total and column width is proportional to the column total, while color represents the observed entry. entries.source_title: Hypercube Richardson varieties from magic words
entries.source_excerpt: Inspired by the recent preprint of Ellenberg, Libedinsky, Plaza, Simental, and Williamson, we study the geometry of Richardson varieties whose associated Bruhat intervals are boolean posets. We define magic words for a Bruhat interval and prove that for intervals with magic words the associated Richardson variety is a tower of $\mathbb{P}^1$-s. We also prove that the Bruhat intervals consisting of the dyadically well-distributed permutations all have magic words. This gives a new proof that they form a boolean poset.

entries.source_title: $a$-numbers of covers in characteristic two: semigroups and Riemann-Roch spaces
entries.source_excerpt: We compute the $a$-numbers of the Garcia-G\"uneri-Stichtenoth curves, the Beelen-Montanucci curves, and the Skabelund covers of Suzuki curves in characteristic two. The proofs use the identity $a(X)=\ell(\tfrac12\operatorname{div}(dt))$ and reduce the calculations to Riemann-Roch spaces on the base curves. We obtain transfer formulas for odd-degree radical covers, with one or several points at infinity, and evaluate them using Weierstrass semigroups and plane sections of the Hermitian curve. For the first two families we also give cyclic models over the projective line and relate the formulas to Elkin's rank formula. We then treat two classes of Artin-Schreier fibre products. A supersingular genus-six family has a-number $3$ at the zero parameter and $2$ elsewhere, although the genera and $a$-numbers of its quadratic quotients remain fixed. entries.source_title: Analysis and approximation for inverse potential problem of space-dependent variable-exponent sub-diffusion in heterogeneous medium
entries.source_excerpt: Anomalous transport in complex heterogeneous medium is often characterized by non-Markovian memory effects and spatially varying trapping properties. From the point of view of continuous-time random walks, such heterogeneity can be described by a position-dependent heavy-tailed waiting-time density $q(t \mid x)\sim C(x)t^{-1-\alpha(x)}$, where $0<\alpha(x)<1$ is the local anomalous exponent. This microscopic interpretation naturally leads to the sub-diffusion with a space-dependent variable exponent $\alpha(x)$. Compared with constant-exponent models, the variable-exponent fractional operators generally do not commute with the spatial Laplacian, which makes both the forward and inverse analysis substantially more delicate. This paper investigates the inverse problem of recovering a spatially dependent radiative or potential coefficient in variable-exponent sub-diffusion from terminal observation data. project_insight.translation_zh: 一个面向编程智能体的 Skill，可将智能体组织成多阶段安全审计流程，并输出经过独立核验的机器可读发现。流程包括：侦察并记录架构与覆盖范围；按覆盖清单分配搜寻任务并检查遗漏；让新的验证者尝试推翻候选问题；将结果写入 findings.json 并按 Schema 校验；由独立智能体核验最终记录中的源码依据；最后根据已验证记录和覆盖台账生成报告。发现分为 confirmed、needs_validation 和 rejected。项目要求使用支持工具调用和并行子 Agent 的编程智能体、Node.js 验证器，以及对目标代码构建与测试进行操作系统级隔离的沙箱；沙箱应禁用外网、使用受限环境并限制资源和写入路径。

entries.source_title: Metric dimension and maximum eigenvalue multiplicity of graph Laplacians
entries.source_excerpt: We study equality between metric dimension and the maximum eigenvalue multiplicity of the Laplacian and signless Laplacian matrices. These quantities are not ordered in general. Using the standard decomposition associated with twin classes, we separate forced multiplicities from quotient-spectrum contributions. We give complete equality classifications for complete multipartite graphs and core--satellite graphs, and enumerate the multipartite equality graphs by order. For graphs formed by attaching at least two leaves to every vertex of a connected core, the metric dimension and the multiplicity of the eigenvalue $ 1 $ are known; we show that this multiplicity is maximal for both matrices, and uniquely maximal except for $ P_3 $. We enumerate this core--leaf family up to isomorphism and obtain a uniform asymptotic formula by order and metric dimension, together with the quadratic exponential growth rate $ 1/18 $. An exact census of connected graphs of orders two through seven identifies the first separating examples and examples without twins. entries.source_title: Summation-by-parts operators for general function spaces: Flux differencing, entropy stability, and accuracy
entries.source_excerpt: Summation-by-parts (SBP) operators are a cornerstone of provably stable high-order methods for hyperbolic conservation laws. For nonlinear problems, the flux-differencing framework of Fisher and Carpenter combines such SBP operators with entropy-conservative two-point fluxes to obtain semi-discretizations that are conservative in the sense of Lax--Wendroff and discretely entropy-conservative or stable. So far, this framework has been developed exclusively for operators that are exact for polynomials. Function-space SBP (FSBP) operators lift this restriction by being exact on a general finite-dimensional function space that can be tailored to the problem at hand. In this work, we extend flux differencing to FSBP operators for general (potentially non-polynomial) function spaces. We prove that, whenever the operator has a diagonal norm and its function space contains the constants, the resulting semi-discretization is conservative in the sense of Lax--Wendroff, semi-discretely entropy-conservative within a single element, and entropy-stable across element interfaces. entries.source_title: Optimal CLT error bounds in the second order Wasserstein metric via Stein's method for weakly dependent sequences
entries.source_excerpt: We use Stein's method to prove general upper bounds on the second order Wasserstein distance in the CLT for general dependent partial sums $S_N=X_1+\ldots +X_N$. Then we use these estimates to provide optimal $O(N^{-1/2})$ rates for a variety of chaotic dynamical systems and $\phi$- and $\psi$-mixing sequences. Our results for $\psi$-mixing sequences are obtained under the fourth moment condition, which matches the best known results in the iid case. This is the first time that optimal CLT rates of any kind are obtained for unbounded weakly stationary variables under general mixing conditions. We then apply this result and obtain optimal CLT rates $O\left((\text{Var}(S_N))^{-1/2}\right)$ for non-stationary $\psi$-mixing sequences without any growth rates on $\text{Var}(S_N)$. We also obtain close to optimal CLT rates for nonconventional sums and some classes of random dynamical systems with non-uniform decay of correlations

entries.source_title: Thinking Hard Above AI
entries.source_excerpt: There are many ways in which AI is generating uncertainty in mathematics. We are not sure how it will impact our jobs, it is raising questions about how it might affect academic training, and it is not clear how it might change the job search process and how we evaluate research. This is by no means an exhaustive list. In this post, I will focus two another related questions, which are: “Is there still any mathematics to be done? And will doing mathematics still be fun and interesting?” I believe that there is, and here I set out to explain why.

entries.source_title: Strict monotonicity of weighted inhomogeneous percolation thresholds under covering maps
entries.source_excerpt: We study Bernoulli bond percolation under weak covering maps for a class of weighted inhomogeneous product measures such that each edge $e$ carries a positive weight $w(e)$ and is open at intensity $\lambda\geq 0$ with probability $1-\exp(-\lambda w(e))$. We prove a strict monotonicity of the weighted critical intensities $\lambda_c$ in the covering compatibility setting under bounded degree, uniform ellipticity, tame fibre and disjoint tree-lifting. While for the weighted uniform connection thresholds $\lambda_{\mathrm{conn}}$, we establish their strict monotonicity for non-injective weak covering maps under bounded degree, covering compatibility, uniform ellipticity, bounded-fibre and disjoint tree-lifting. Moreover, we verify a general-profile theorem on strict monotonicities of the two thresholds $\lambda_c$ and $\lambda_{\mathrm{conn}}$ respectively under explicit compact-interval finite-energy, derivative bounds and aforementioned geometric conditions.

entries.source_title: The Compactness Theorem for Enriched Logic
entries.source_excerpt: The framework of enriched logic extends positive logic (also known as coherent logic) from sets to structures internal to a symmetric monoidal closed category $\mathcal{V}$. This framework was developed by Rosick\'y and the second-named author. The main novelty of this logic is that the arities of the function and relation symbols are now objects in $\mathcal{V}$. We prove the compactness theorem for this enriched logic. That is, a set of $\mathcal{V}$-enriched sequents has a model (internal to $\mathcal{V}$) if every finite subset has a model. To achieve this, we define ultraproducts of enriched structures and prove enriched versions of {\L}os' theorem. We then develop some model-theoretic applications. We start with an enriched version of the model-theoretic method of diagrams, establishing a correspondence between homomorphisms whose domain is some enriched structure $A$ and models of the set $\operatorname{Diag}(A)$ of all enriched atomic formulas with parameters from $A$ that are true in $A$. entries.title_zh: 富逻辑的紧致性定理

entries.source_title: Alp\"oge's counterexample to the JC, Economic Stabilization, and Zhao's Vanishing Conjecture
entries.source_excerpt: In this paper, we apply stabilization techniques which are economic in the number of added dimensions to a slightly tweaked version of Alp\"oge's counterexample to JC(3) and JC(3,7). The first idea which lead to more economic stabilization is to bypass the degree 3 reduction of Bass, Connell and Wright in the construction of a counterexample to HJC(n). We construct counterexamples to HJC(15), VC(28), and HVC(30). On the other hand, we will perform degree 3 reduction after all to obtain counterexamples of low degree. We construct counterexamples to JC(12,3), HJC(18,3), VC(34,4), and HVC(36,4). As an encore, we construct a cubic-linear counterexample to the Jacobian Conjecture in dimension 90. All presented counterexamples to the Jacobian Conjecture (Vanishing Conjecture) are over the (Gaussian) integers.

entries.source_title: A sound pure type system with ranks as sorts and Type-in-Type
entries.source_excerpt: We present a dependently typed pure type system that contains a circular axiom $s : s$ for a certain sort $s$ and is nonetheless strongly normalizing. Girard's paradox is avoided because our sorts are not closed under a $\Pi$-former: function types are placed in sorts according to their rank. Turns out that this system has a unique set of characteristics: it has similar normalization behaviour as STLC (so complexity of normalization is TOWER-complete) while at the same time allowing non-uniform representation of arbitrary elementary recursive functions; furthermore, it has a nontrivial set-theoretical model in ZF+GCH and allows to carry out nontrivial proof developments. Base normalization proof is surprisingly simple (modulo general metatheoretical properties of pure type systems) and has been fully formalized in vanilla Rocq (formerly Coq) without additional axioms.

entries.source_title: The CIDOC CRM Periodic Table: Documentation You Can Test to Support the Adoption of Scientific Research Ontologies for the Humanities
entries.source_excerpt: The CIDOC CRM family is not only a schema for museum collections. Its extensions formalise the apparatus through which research knowledge is produced and justified: CRMsci models scientific observation and measurement, CRMdig the provenance of digital processes, CRMinf inference and belief. Together they constitute a schema for research data, and the obstacle to their adoption is documentary rather than theoretical: four normative documents, four code conventions, and eighty-nine typed links crossing document boundaries. This paper presents the CIDOC CRM Periodic Table, a single-page browser rendering 131 classes and 480 property entries from CIDOC CRM 7.1.3, CRMsci 3.2, CRMdig 5.0 and CRMinf 1.2.1 as one navigable surface, with two inference facilities: a one-step triple builder admitting only the class-property combinations licensed by declared domains, ranges and the subclass closure, and a multi-step path finder enumerating property chains between two classes. entries.source_title: An Asymptotic for Non-Wieferich Numbers
entries.source_excerpt: A cyclic number is a positive integer $n$ such that $\gcd(n, \varphi(n)) = 1$. Erd\H{o}s showed that the number of cyclic numbers up to $x$, $C(x)$, has $C(x) \sim e^{-\gamma}x/\log_3(x)$ asymptotically as $x$ tends to infinity. We define Wieferich numbers to be odd, positive integers $n$ such that $(n, (2^{\ell(n)}-1)/n) > 1$, where $\ell(n)$ is the smallest positive integer with $2^{\ell(n)} \equiv 1 \mod n$. Franco and Pomerance showed that non-Wieferich numbers have density zero among the odd integers. We show that the counting function of $n \leq x$ in the symmetric difference of non-Wieferich numbers and cyclic numbers is $O(x/(\log_3(x))^2)$, under a mild assumption on the counting function of Wieferich primes.
entries.title_zh: 非 Wieferich 数的一个渐近公式
entries.summary_zh: 论文研究奇数 Wieferich 数与循环数的计数关系。作者证明，在一个关于 Wieferich 素数计数函数的温和假设下，二者截至 x 的计数集合之对称差为 O(x/(log₃ x)²)；这把此前非 Wieferich 数密度为零的结果进一步精化为与循环数计数的渐近贴近。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 连接指数同余、素数条件和稀有整数集合计数，适合解析数论读者关注其条件假设。

entries.source_title: Permutation classes need not have proper growth rates
entries.source_excerpt: By the Marcus-Tardos Theorem (formerly the Stanley-Wilf Conjecture), every permutation class other than the class of all permutations has a finite upper growth rate, meaning that the $n$th root of the number of permutations of length $n$ in the class has a finite limit superior. It has long been conjectured that this limit superior is in fact always a proper limit. We disprove this by constructing a permutation class whose upper and lower growth rates differ. The construction uses grid classes with cubic row-column graphs of increasing girth, obtained from Haar graphs of finite 2-groups. The corresponding hereditary property of ordered graphs also disproves an analogous 2006 conjecture of Balogh, Bollob\'as, and Morris. Along the way, we show that every proper permutation class with a D-finite generating function has a proper growth rate. We also establish refined enumerative bounds for grid classes, which lead to a short proof of Albert and Vatter's generalization of Bevan's Theorem on the growth rates of grid classes.
entries.title_zh: 排列类的指数增长率极限未必存在
entries.summary_zh: 论文声称构造计数上、下增长率不同的排列类，否定增长率总存在的长期猜想，并给出有序图的对应反例。构造采用高围长三次图相关网格类，同时证明具有 D-有限生成函数的真排列类仍有增长率。
entries.recommend_reason_zh: 适合关注组合计数极限与反例。
entries.pragmatic_review: 提醒计数研究区分上极限和极限。
entries.cynic_review: 重大反例需核查闭包与构造条件。
